ground upon which the plaintiffs
could ask for a reduction of rent is
that the value of the real property
they occupy has depreciated in value;
that the plaintiffs have produced no
evidence whatsoever to prove depre-
ciation of the property they occupy;
that the order of the Municipal Gov-
ernment only permitted exemption of
rent in the Hongkew area, that is.
north of the Soochow Creek; that the
premises in question are situated
south of the Soochow Creek; that the
plaintiffs demand for two months' rent
exemption is therefore groundless.

Reasons

"A contract when made with the
agreement of the parties thereto is
binding and cannot be altered by
one party without the consent of the
other unless the contract is void or
voidable under the law. This is the
rule laid down in decisions by the
late Ta Li Yuan. In thsi case it is
an undisputed fact that the plaintiffs
agreed to the present rate of rent in
January, 1931. Both parties have car-
ried out the terms of the contract for
the past few years without any con-
troversy. It is quite obvious that
the contract was consummated and
has been binding and as such it can-
not be altered by one party without
the consent of the other. So the
plaintiffs' claim for a reduction of
rent in an amount equal to 40 per
cent. of the original rent on the
ground of general depression cannot
be entertained in law. It is true that
Messrs. Sassoon & Co. have granted a
reduction to their tenants but that
is a different and separate contract
and cannot be binding upon the de-
fendants. It can neither be made a
a precedent to apply to this case.
Where the property rented is real
property either party to the contract
may apply to the Court for increase
or reduction of the rent as the value
of such property should appreciate
or depreciate. This is provided in
Article 442 of the Civil Code. But
under the law of procedure burden
is upon the plaintiff to prove any
fact that is beneficial to his claim.
There has been no evidence to prove
that the real property occupied by
the plaintiffs has depreciated in value
or to prove the extent of such de-
preciation. It is not sufficient just
to allege that the value of the real
property in general has depreciated.
The plaintiffs also ask for exemption
of rent. The Court finds that the
premises rented by the plaintiffs are
located on the southern side of the
Soochow Creek and are not within
the area affected by the order of the
Municipal Government. The plaintiffs
have not asserted such claims for the
last few years and this shows that
they have raised no objection to the
payment of the rent.

"This Court, under the above cir-
cumstances, finds the plaintiffs' claim
to be without reason and has given
its judgment as above under Article
78 of the Civil Procedure."

（印：上海公共租界工部局 / S. B. 登记处 / 编号 S. B. D. 311/22 / 日期 1935年11月11日）
（手写批注：123.80）

租户要求减租诉讼

无证据表明房产贬值：
该区域不受命令影响

广东路六家店铺业主针对其房东宗德租赁代理行（Tsung Teh Rental Agency）提起的减租诉讼判决书全文现已公布。该诉讼最近被第一特区地方法院民事庭驳回，《字林西报》已刊登相关报道。律师赵文基先生代表租户出庭，杨律师（Dr. L. Yang）代表房东出庭。判决书译文如下。

判决书

“原告通过其代理律师请求判决：(1) 鉴于1932年1月的战事，免除原告两个月的租金，共计2,756.64美元；(2) 允许原告自今年7月1日起将租金降至现行租金标准的60%，即每月租金减少51,323美元（原文如此，疑为OCR错误或原文笔误，数值与上下文不符）；(3) 被告承担诉讼费用。

“原告称，吴亚柱（Wu Chia-chu，音译）现占用广东路448号房屋，经营福新利鞋店（Fu Hsin Lih Shoe Store），月租金为339.80美元；原告年尊永（Nien Tsun-yung，音译）占用广东路456号房屋，经营瑞生布庄（Jui Sheng Piece goods hong），月租金为262.24美元；原告张吉三（Chang Chi-san，音译）占用广东路452号房屋，经营顺成布庄（Shun Cheng piece goods hong），月租金为209.79美元；原告邱洪兴（Chiu Hung-hing，音译）占用广东路434号房屋，经营和通鞋店（Ho Tung Shoe Store），月租金为188.81美元；原告倪元耀（Ni Yuan Yao，音译）占用广东路435号房屋，经营崇关（Chong Kuan，音译），月租金为188.81美元；原告王英士（Wang Ying shi，音译）占用广东路430号房屋，经营宏达鞋店（Hung tah Shoe Store），月租金为188.81美元。原告占用上述房屋已超过十年；在此期间，租金曾因市场繁荣而数次上涨；目前租金几乎是最初租金的两倍；原告一直遭受资本家的压迫；近年来普遍出现严重萧条；既然租金在繁荣时期可以上涨，那么在困难时期也应下调；上海房地产价值贬值是众所周知的事实；根据法律，任何一方均可因房地产价值的增减向法院申请增加或减少租金；基于上述理由，原告请求减租。

附近减租情况

“原告还称，邻近物业的其他房东已将租金降低了百分之四十，并有租金收据为证；原告的诉求并非没有先例；虽然被告辩称如果原告觉得租金太高可以搬离，但原告均已在上述房屋内建立了业务，因此几乎不可能搬离这些房屋。原告还主张，由于1932年1月的战事，他们曾停业；根据惯例和市政府的命令，原告应免除两个月的租金；被告拒绝了原告的所有要求，因此原告提起本诉讼。原告提交了四张租金收据、支票簿和报纸以佐证其主张。

“被告代理律师请求驳回诉讼并由原告承担费用，并称原告一直是上述物业的租户；自1931年1月1日起，他们一直按现行费率支付租金，当时双方已同意对该租金进行调整；在此之前可能有过涨租，如果有，也是由前业主实施的，被告并未参与；当租户同意以增加的费率继续租赁时，双方达成了一项合同，未经另一方同意，任何一方不得退出；由于原告未且无法就所要求的减租达成一致，未经被告同意，原告不能改变该租赁条款；由于原告是按月租赁的租户，如果他们认为租金过高且不合理，随时可以通过通知并腾退房屋来终止租赁，不应强迫被告给予减租；原告请求减租的唯一理由是其所占用的房地产价值贬值；原告未能提供任何证据证明其所占用的房产贬值；市政府的命令仅允许虹口地区，即苏州河以北地区免租；而涉案房屋位于苏州河以南；因此，原告要求免除两个月租金的主张毫无根据。

理由

“合同一经当事人同意订立，即具有约束力，除非合同依法无效或可撤销，否则一方未经另一方同意不得更改。这是已故大理院在判决中确立的规则。在本案中，原告于1931年1月同意现行租金标准是一个不争的事实。过去几年中，双方一直履行合同条款，没有任何争议。显然，合同已成立并具有约束力，因此一方未经另一方同意不得更改。所以，原告以普遍萧条为由，要求将租金减少至原租金的40%的请求，在法律上不能予以支持。诚然，沙逊洋行（Messrs. Sassoon & Co.）已向其租户提供减租，但那是另一份独立的合同，对被告没有约束力。这也不能作为适用于本案的先例。如果租赁物为不动产，合同任何一方均可因该财产价值的增值或贬值向法院申请增加或减少租金。《民法典》第442条对此有规定。但在程序法下，举证责任在于原告，需证明对其主张有利的事实。目前没有证据证明原告占用的不动产价值贬值，也没有证明贬值的程度。仅仅声称房地产总体价值贬值是不够的。原告还要求免除租金。本庭查明，原告租赁的房屋位于苏州河南岸，不在市政府命令影响的区域内。原告在过去几年中未曾提出此类主张，这表明他们对支付租金并未提出异议。

“本庭在上述情况下，认定原告的诉求无理，并依据《民事诉讼法》第78条作出如上判决。”

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 7, 1935

ARTICLE 442 OF
CIVIL CODE AND
RENT LOWERING

New Hope in Statement
on Currency Reforms

MORTGAGE SECURITY

Harmful Curb on Supply
and Demand

SPECIAL TO THE "N.-C.D.N."

The statement issued in connection with currency changes on Sunday and published on Monday makes reference to the creation of a special institution by the Government in Nanking to deal exclusively with mortgage business, and that steps would be taken to amend the present legal code so as to improve the security of mortgage deeds, stimulates the hope that the occasion will be availed of to revise Article 442 of the Civil Code under which recent applications to the District Court for reductions in rent have been made.

While it is true that the article in question permits landlords to apply for an increase in rent if the value of the property increases, and is consequently fair to both parties, the fact is that it is an attempt to interfere with the ordinary law of supply and demand, and to provide a method of doing so which it has already been shown is capable of capricious interpretation.

Property as Security

It is here suggested that in addition to making those changes which have already been suggested in connection with mortgages, attention might be given to the matter under review because, as has already been pointed out the existing law and possible methods of its application constitute a serious danger, and an obstacle to what after all is a very necessary business,—the lending of money against property as security.

From reliable sources it is learned that approximately 20 per cent. of built up property is at the present moment vacant. Landlords, in their own interests as well as that of their tenants, have in many instances willingly reduced rentals. Others have probably only to be approached with a good case to secure similar relief, for no landlord desires to keep his properties empty and will accept a lesser rental rather than have no tenants.

Those who are agitating for reductions have not always unimpeachable motives behind their actions, as has already been pointed out. But if a tenant really is unable to pay the rent which is being charged, and the landlord knows that the rental he is charging is so reasonable that he would have no difficulty in securing a new tenant, if the dissatisfied one would vacate the premises surely it is only reasonable to require that the dissatisfied tenant should seek other and cheaper quarters.

Special Circumstances

It is a matter of simple logic to argue that, if the landlord can obtain the same rental from a new tenant, there has in fact been no decrease in the value of the property, but that an order from the court would bring about just such a reduction, and the result upon the mortgageable value of the premises consequently has to suffer proportionate diminution.

The analogy which it has been sought to draw between the Rent Restriction Act in Britain and Article 442 is not a good one. Conditions are not the same. In the case of the former it was a piece of special post-war legislation drafted for the purpose of preventing landlords taking a profiteering advantage of the housing shortage, especially with regard to properties of moderate and low rentals. There is no shortage here and there is all the evidence in the world to prove that landlords have not been profiteering.

There is yet another aspect of the matter to which serious consideration should be given. As the Article has been interpreted in one action it may very well have the effect of granting to the tenant a lease in perpetuity, for it would seem clear that so long as the tenant continued to pay regularly the reduced rent as ordered by the Court, it would be impossible for the landlord to secure a termination of the tenancy.

Term of Tenancy

It might be possible to bring forward a prospective tenant to say he would willingly pay the higher rental, but the fact that he might eventually pay it for only a month would undoubtedly be held by the Court to be no proof of the increase in value of the premises. If the tenant on the other hand agreed to pay the increased rent for a fairly lengthy period, the Court could very well argue that as this involved a lease for a term, and not a monthly tenancy such as covered by the Article, the landlord's application and the arrangement he had come to with a prospective tenant were designed to remove the property from the operation of the Article which is under criticism.

From a municipal point of view the logical operation of Article 442 would be unfortunate, for it places in the hands of a third party, the Court, power to effect reductions which if carried out on the scale some of the agitators desired, would result in considerable diminution in municipal revenue at the very time when such is least desirable.

Litigation Costs

These practical difficulties which the presence of the Article on the statute books creates are by no means all. It is possible for a tenant who does not intend to pay to force landlords to go through lengthy processes of law, to recover outstandings, and even when they have succeeded in their claims they have been faced with the fact that during the lengthy process of litigation, further arrears have accumulated and the same weary process

《字林西报》，1935年11月7日，星期四

民法典第442条
与减租

币制改革声明
带来新希望

抵押担保

对供需的有害限制

《字林西报》专讯

周日发布并于周一刊登的关于币制改革的声明提及，南京政府将设立一个专门机构，专营抵押业务，并将采取措施修订现行法律条文，以加强抵押契据的担保效力。这激发了人们的希望，即借此机会修订《民法典》第442条，近期向地方法院申请减租即是依据该条款提出的。

诚然，该条款允许业主在房产价值增加时申请提高租金，因而对双方均属公平；但事实是，这是一种试图干涉正常的供需法则的行为，且其所提供的实施方法已被证明容易遭到随意解释。

作为担保的房产

在此建议，除了进行前述与抵押相关的变更外，还应关注正在审议的事项，因为正如已指出的那样，现行法律及其可能的适用方式构成了严重的危险，并对以房产为担保的借贷这一非常必要的业务造成了障碍。

从可靠渠道获悉，目前约有20%的建成房产处于空置状态。出于自身及租户的利益，许多业主已自愿降低租金。其他业主可能只需通过合理的沟通即可获得类似的减免，因为没有业主愿意让房产空置，他们宁愿接受较低的租金也不愿没有租户。

正如已指出的那样，那些鼓动减租的人，其行动背后的动机并非总是无可指责。但是，如果租户确实无力支付现行租金，而业主明知其收取的租金如此合理，以至于若不满的租户搬离，他毫不费力就能找到新租户，那么要求不满的租户寻找其他更便宜的住所无疑是合理的。

特殊情况

从简单的逻辑来论证，如果业主能从新租户那里获得相同的租金，那么房产的价值实际上并未下降；但法院的命令却会导致这样的减租，因此房产的可抵押价值必然遭受相应的减损。

有人试图将英国的《租金限制法》与第442条进行类比，但这并不恰当。情况并不相同。就前者而言，那是一项特殊的战后立法，旨在防止业主利用住房短缺谋取暴利，特别是针对中低租金的房产。这里并没有短缺，且有充分证据表明业主并未牟取暴利。

此事还有另一个方面值得认真考虑。根据某一诉讼中对这条款的解释，它很可能产生赋予租户永久租赁权的效果，因为似乎很明显，只要租户继续按法院命令定期支付降低后的租金，业主就不可能终止租赁关系。

租赁期限

或许可以找一位潜在租户出来说他愿意支付较高的租金，但他最终可能只支付一个月的事实，无疑会被法院视为不能证明房产价值的增加。另一方面，如果租户同意在相当长的一段时间内支付增加的租金，法院完全可以辩称，由于这涉及定期租赁，而非该条款所涵盖的按月租赁，业主的申请及其与潜在租户达成的安排，旨在使房产脱离受批评的第442条的约束。

从市政角度来看，第442条的逻辑运作将是令人遗憾的，因为它将实施减租的权力交到了第三方——法院手中，如果按照一些鼓动者所希望的大规模执行，将在市政收入最不该减少的时候导致其大幅缩减。

诉讼费用

该条款存在于法规中所造成的这些实际困难远不止于此。一个打算不付租金的租户完全有可能迫使业主经历漫长的法律程序来追讨欠款，即使业主胜诉，他们也面临这样一个事实：在漫长的诉讼过程中，新的欠租不断累积，同样的疲惫过程

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 5, 1935

COURT DECISION
ON RENTS CUTS
CONFUSES ISSUE

Realtors Perturbed at
Recent Judgment

EFFECT ON MARKET

Peculiar Provision of the
Law Dangerous

SPECIAL TO THE "N.-C.D.N."

Two cases recently decided by the Special District Court judges are creating a great deal of perturbation in real estate circles for they reveal a peculiar provision of law on the one hand, and a diversity of opinion among the judges as to how it should be administered.

Within recent months groups of tenants have come together for the purpose of securing reductions in their rentals. Not because in the main the landlords or their representatives have been unreasonable in the adjustment of rents to the ability of their tenants to pay, but because it was fancied by the originators of the movement that corporate action would secure better results than individual negotiation. These organizations, however, have not always been formed by people with clean bills of health in the matter of the payment of rents, for in a number of instances the leader has been found to be one who, having fallen a long way in arrears, has sought by stirring up this particular form of agitation either to avoid or delay final payments and in any event to obtain a reduction not only of his future rent, but of that which is already owing. There has consequently been added to the existing difficulties of the real estate business, further disadvantages which the state of the law and the decisions of the Courts have done nothing to remove.

Cases in Point

In one of the cases under notice a suit was brought against a group of Chinese tenants by a landlord to recover arrears of rent. The defendants pleaded that as there had been a drop in the value of the property which they occupied the rent should be reduced by 40 per cent. and the judge before whom the case was tried, holding that such a decrease was unjustified, nevertheless compromised by ordering that the defendants should pay 20 per cent. less, making his order operative as from the first of the year. Whatever the future payments may amount to, it is obvious that by such a decision the landlords have been mulcted in two months of the past ten months rentals which were already due.

The decision is founded upon Article 442 of the Chinese Civil Code, which lays it down that:—

In case the thing leased is an immovable, either party may apply to the Court for an increase or reduction of its rent in proportion to the fluctuation of its value, unless the lease is made for a definite period of time.

In the second case a number of tenants sued their landlords for a rental reduction of 40 per cent. on the ground that the market value of the property had depreciated and that the tenants were suffering from an unprecedented depression.

Law of Supply and Demand

The defence contended that the rent had remained the same since 1931; the landlords considered the rental charged was so reasonable that they would have no difficulty in replacing the tenants if they cared to move out. Arguing that the law of supply and demand applied in this case as it did in others, counsel for the landlords submitted that it was insufficient to prove that the values of real estate in general had decreased, but that in order to succeed the tenants would have to show that the property which they actually occupied had depreciated, and also to prove the actual extent of such depreciation. General depression was not under the article in question, a ground for ordering rental reduction. That view was accepted by the Court which refused to grant the plaintiffs the relief which they sought.

Decisions Considered

The result of these two contradictory decisions is to bring about a chaotic condition which obviously requires remedying. The first decision indeed creates a paradox, for if the value of property is to be considered as based upon the income it will bring in from rentals, then it is obvious that the decision of the Court itself has brought about the depreciation. The second, it is contended, correctly interprets the law as it stands and is in all senses the more serious from the point of view of the real estate holder.

In that instance plaintiffs failed because they merely advanced the existence of general depression as proof that the property they were occupying had fallen in value. The Court could accept no such proof, but in deciding in that manner it made permissible the deduction, that if the plaintiffs had been able to prove that the property actually had fallen in value a reduction in rent would have followed under the Article quoted. The proof required is sufficiently strict that a close adherence to the law, should make it well nigh impossible to secure that which the Article is presumably intended to provide, for in the absence of a reduction in the municipal assessment, the value of a property can only be a mere expression of opinion such as a court should be reluctant to act upon.

Principle at Issue

Nevertheless the principle underlying the Article is economically so unfortunate that its repeal or amendment is eminently desirable. So long as it remains upon the Statute Book it is a serious threat to the economic stability not only of Shanghai but of the whole of China. It has the effect of importing a degree of insecurity into transactions involving landed property, which may still further increase the present depression and prolong it indefinitely. For apart from

《字林西报》，1935年11月5日，星期二

法院关于
减租的判决
混淆了问题

房地产界对
近期判决感到不安

对市场的影响

法律的特殊规定
具有危险性

《字林西报》专讯

特区法院法官最近裁决的两起案件在房地产界引起了极大的不安，因为它们一方面揭示了法律中的一项特殊规定，另一方面也显示了法官们在如何执行该规定上存在意见分歧。

近几个月来，各组租户联合起来，旨在争取降低租金。这主要并非因为业主或其代表在根据租户的支付能力调整租金方面不合理，而是因为这场运动的发起者认为，集体行动比个别谈判能取得更好的结果。然而，这些组织的成员在缴纳租金方面并非总是清白的，因为在许多情况下，带头人被发现是一个长期严重拖欠租金的人，他试图通过煽动这种特定形式的 agitation（骚动/鼓动）来逃避或拖延最终付款，并在任何情况下不仅寻求减少未来的租金，还寻求减少已欠的租金。因此，在法律状况和法院判决未能消除现有弊端的情况下，房地产业的现有困难又增添了新的不利因素。

典型案例

在上述一起案件中，一名业主起诉一群中国租户以追讨欠租。被告辩称，由于他们所占用房产的价值下跌，租金应降低40%。审理此案的法官认为这种降幅不合理，但仍作出妥协，命令被告少付20%，并规定该命令自年初起生效。无论未来的付款金额是多少，显而易见的是，通过这一判决，业主被剥夺了过去十个月中已到期两个月的租金。

该判决基于《中华民国民法典》第442条，该条规定：—

租赁物为不动产者，因其价值之升降，当事人得声请法院增减其租金。但租赁定有期限者，不在此限。

在第二起案件中，多名租户起诉业主，要求减租40%，理由是房产市场价值贬值，且租户正遭受前所未有的萧条之苦。

供需法则

辩方主张，自1931年以来租金一直保持不变；业主认为所收租金非常合理，如果租户愿意搬走，他们不难找到替代者。业主的律师辩称，供需法则在此案中如同在其他案件中一样适用，并提出仅证明房地产总体价值下降是不够的，租户若要胜诉，必须证明他们实际占用的房产已经贬值，并证明贬值的具体程度。根据该条款，普遍萧条并不是命令减租的理由。法院接受了这一观点，拒绝给予原告所寻求的救济。

对判决的考量

这两项相互矛盾的判决导致了一种显然需要补救的混乱局面。第一项判决确实造成了一个悖论，因为如果房产价值被认为是基于其带来的租金收入，那么显而易见，法院本身的判决导致了贬值。据称，第二项判决正确地解释了现行法律，并且从房地产持有者的角度来看，在所有意义上都更为严肃。

在该案中，原告败诉是因为他们仅仅提出普遍萧条的存在，作为证明他们所占用房产价值下跌的证据。法院不能接受此类证据，但在做出此类裁决时，它使得一种推论成为可能，即如果原告能够证明房产确实贬值，那么根据引用的条款，减租将会随之发生。所需的证明足够严格，严格遵守法律应使得几乎不可能获得该条款 presumably（据推测）意图提供的东西，因为在市政估价没有降低的情况下，房产的价值只能是一种纯粹的意见表达，法院应不愿据此采取行动。

争议原则

尽管如此，该条款 underlying（ underlying/基础）的经济原则是如此不幸，以至于其废除或修正极为可取。只要它保留在法规中，它不仅对上海，而且对整个中国的经济稳定都是一个严重威胁。它的效果是给涉及土地财产的交易引入了一定程度的不安全感，这可能会进一步加剧目前的萧条并无限期地延长它。因为除了

THE CHINA PRESS, SATURDAY, OCTOBER 26, 1935

Hardoon Plans
10 More Suits
Against Tenants

Actions Will Be Filed
If No Settlement
Can Be Made

With three suits for back rent still to be heard against Hardoon tenants on Nanking Road, 10 more actions of the same nature will probably be filed with the First Special District Court in the near future, a spokesman of the Hardoon estate told a CHINA PRESS reporter last night. It all depends on whether or not some mutually satisfactory arrangements can be made within the next few days, it was stated.

In the meantime, however, the action of the First Special District Court this week in ordering a 20 per cent discount in rentals in connection with action brought by the Lih Dah Realty Company against some tenants on East Seward Road, is causing some concern to the Hardoon people. Despite this ruling, they are prepared to go ahead with their cases, the spokesman stated.

Since starting the rent reduction movement, members of the First Special District Rent Reduction Association, whose places of business are located along Nanking Road, have made little headway in their repeated negotiations with the Hardoon firm. Apparently both parties are sticking to their guns. No sort of compromise has been reached as the parties to the negotiations have advanced almost the same plea for their inability to see eye to eye with each other, to wit: business is bad, and we are all in the same boat.

Although a suit was filed last Saturday against tenants at Nos. 691, 699, and 463, Nanking Road, the Foo Loo Zoo Restaurant, the Heng Teh Lee Clock Shop, and the San Yih Silk Store respectively, for claims totaling $15,797.83, no definite date has been announced by the First Special District Court for hearing. The Foo Loo Zoo Restaurant is said to be nine months in arrears, the other two shop houses four months each.

More than 19 other shop houses on Nanking Road will also be sued for back-rentals as soon as the debtor's judgment on the first three tenants has been handed down, according to information obtained from the Hardoon estate officials.

Other tenants on Nanking Road are alert to the results of the impending suits between the Hardoon estate and their tenants, as this is considered a test case in court. Whatever might be the court decision, the tenants on Nanking Road and elsewhere are anxious that the court take into consideration the circumstances of both debtors and creditors, and pay special regard to the present plight of local business, a spokesman of the First Special District Rent Reduction Association declared yesterday.

《字林西报》，1935年10月26日，星期六

哈同洋行计划
再对十名租户
提起诉讼

若无法达成和解
将提起诉讼

哈同地产公司发言人昨晚告诉《字林西报》记者，鉴于针对南京路哈同租户的三起追讨欠租诉讼尚待审理，近期可能向第一特区地方法院提起另外十起同类诉讼。据称，这完全取决于未来几天内能否达成双方均满意的安排。

然而，与此同时，第一特区地方法院本周在利达地产公司（Lih Dah Realty Company）起诉东熙华德路部分租户一案中，下令租金减免20%，此举令哈同方面感到些许担忧。发言人表示，尽管有此裁决，他们仍准备继续推进其案件。

自减租运动开始以来，营业地点位于南京路沿线的第一特区减租协会成员在与哈同公司的反复谈判中进展甚微。显然，双方都坚持己见。由于谈判各方提出的无法达成共识的理由几乎如出一辙，即：生意不好，大家同舟共济，因此未能达成任何妥协。

虽然上周六已对南京路691号、699号和463号的租户——分别是福禄寿餐厅（Foo Loo Zoo Restaurant）、亨得利钟表店（Heng Teh Lee Clock Shop）和三益丝绸店（San Yih Silk Store）——提起诉讼，索赔总额达15,797.83美元，但第一特区地方法院尚未公布确切的开庭日期。据悉，福禄寿餐厅已拖欠租金九个月，另外两家商铺各拖欠四个月。

据从哈同地产公司官员处获得的消息，一旦法院对首批三名租户作出判决，南京路上其他19多家商铺也将因拖欠租金而被起诉。

南京路的其他租户正密切关注哈同地产与其租户之间即将发生的诉讼结果，因为这被视为一起测试性案件。第一特区减租协会发言人昨日宣称，无论法院判决如何，南京路及其他地方的租户都迫切希望法院能兼顾债务人和债权人的具体情况，并特别关注本地商业目前的困境。

THE CHINA PRESS, THURSDAY, OCTOBER 24, 1935
1/222

Landlords In
City Now Out
On Big Limb

First Special District
Court Orders Realty
Firm To Cut 20%

VERNACULAR PRESS
HAILS DECISION

Property Owners View
Judgment As Of
Grave Import

Coming almost on the eve of the
Hardoon rent case trials, the First
Special District Court has handed
down a decision ordering a 20 per-
cent discount in payment of rents
in passing judgment on a case
brought by the Lih Dah Realty
Company against tenants living at
Hwa Hsing Li, East Seward Road,
a CHINA PRESS reporter learned yes-
terday.

The action was brought by the
realty concern for recovery of back
rents and the claim was undisput-
ed by the defendants, except that
they requested a reduction in ren-
tals on the grounds of depressed
circumstances and lack of business.

Press Flays Up Decision

The vernacular papers have
given considerable space to the
judgment, maintaining that the
court has finally taken cognizance
of the importance of the rental
reduction movement which has
been underway for several months
past. One the other hand, realtors
and property owners interviewed
yesterday afternoon by a CHINA
PRESS reporter are inclined to
view the decision with grave con-
cern.

Some concern was expressed at
the offices of the S. A. Hardoon
Company, who have three similar
actions now pending in the First
Special District Court and expected
to come up for trial before the end
of the current week. This firm
has refused to reduce rents in com-
pliance with demands made upon
it by the First Special District
Rent Reduction Association, and
tenants in arrears, especially the
three defendants in the actions now
pending, have deposited the rental
sums with the court to be held
pending the outcome of the trials.

Attorneys of the Franklin Chiu
Law offices, who represented the
Lih Dah Realty Company in the
suit, expressed an opinion on the
outcome of the case. They stated
that while they were fully aware
of the general depression in this
city, they are inclined to believe
that the slump is general and is
felt by everyone, property owners
along with everybody else.

They therefore took the attitude
that before the Shanghai Munici-
pal Council or any other official
agency could reassess land values,
lower taxes and lower interest rates
on mortgages would have to be
made first. For this reason, they
pointed out, the court ruling lower-
ing rentals means the shifting
of all burdens by a single party,
namely the property owners.

An appeal will be filed against
the judgment, not exclusively for
the benefit of this one case, but
as a test case under existing con-
ditions, attorneys of the Frank-
lin Chiu offices stated.

（印：OFFICE OF POLICE 26 OCT. 1935 SHANGHAI）

Act. Commissioner of Police,
Sir,
Information and
kindly return.
J.L. Evans
D. C. (Sp. Br.)

《字林西报》，1935年10月24日，星期四
1/222

本市房东
如今陷入
极大困境

第一特区
地方法院命令
地产公司减租20%

中文报纸
欢呼该决定

业主视此判决
为事关重大

《字林西报》记者昨日获悉，第一特区地方法院就在利达地产公司起诉居住于东熙华德路华兴里（Hwa Hsing Li）租户一案作出判决，下令租金支付减免20%。这一裁决几乎是在哈同租案审判前夕下达的。

该诉讼由这家地产公司提起，旨在追回欠租。被告对索赔事实并无争议，但他们以市面萧条和生意清淡为由，请求减免租金。

媒体大肆报道该决定

中文报纸用了大量篇幅报道这一判决，认为法院最终认可了过去几个月一直在进行的减租运动的重要性。另一方面，《字林西报》记者昨日下午采访的房地产商和业主倾向于以严重的关切看待这一决定。

S. A. 哈同公司办事处表达了一些担忧，该公司目前有三起类似诉讼在第一特区地方法院待决，预计将在本周结束前开庭审理。该公司拒绝按照第一特区减租协会提出的要求降低租金，而拖欠租金的租户，特别是目前待决诉讼中的三名被告，已将租金存入法院保管，以待审判结果。

代表利达地产公司参与诉讼的邱 Franklin 律师事务所（Franklin Chiu Law offices）律师对该案结果发表了意见。他们表示，虽然他们充分意识到本市的普遍萧条，但他们倾向于认为这种衰退是普遍性的，每个人都感同身受，业主也不例外。

因此，他们采取的态度是，在上海公共租界工部局或任何其他官方机构重新评估土地价值之前，必须先降低税收和抵押贷款利息。为此，他们指出，法院降低租金的裁决意味着将所有负担转移给单方，即业主。

邱 Franklin 事务所的律师表示，将针对该判决提出上诉，这不仅仅是为了这一个案件的利益，而是作为现有条件下的一起测试性案件。

（印：警务处 1935年10月26日 上海）

代理警务处长，
先生，
供阅知，
并请退回。
J.L. Evans
副督察长（特别分部）

“No Cuts, No
Pay” Is Rent
Group Slogan
Nantao Reduction Body
Urges Vigorous Action,
Plan Nanking Appeal
“No reduction, no pay,” is the
slogan adopted by the Rental Re-
duction Movement Committee of
Nantao at a meeting held yesterday
afternoon.
According to the decision, all
tenants and merchants in Nantao
will be notified to cease payment of
house rentals to their landlords
beginning from October and to de-
posit the rentals due the landlords
in specially designated banks. Pay-
ment of the rentals in arrears will
be made only after the landlords
have taken the initiative of reduc-
tion in accordance with the schedule
drawn up by the Rental Reduction
Committee.
It was further decided to sent a
delegation to Nanking to present
to the sixth plenary session of the
Central Executive and Supervisory
Committees of the Kuomintang on
November 1 a petition urging the
central government to issue a de-
cree calling for a general reduction
of house rentals. Other groups in
the foreign settlements of Shang-
hai behind the rental reduction
campaign in Shanghai will be ask-
ed to join in the delegation.

3412
“不减租，
不付钱”是
减租团体口号
南市减租机构
敦促采取有力行动，
计划赴南京请愿

“不减租，不付钱”，这是南市减租运动委员会在昨日下午举行的会议上通过的口号。
根据决定，将通知南市所有租户和商人从10月起停止向房东支付房租，并将应付给房东的租金存入指定银行。只有在房东按照减租委员会制定的时间表主动减租后，才会支付拖欠的租金。
会议还决定派遣代表团前往南京，向11月1日召开的国民党第六届中央执行委员会和监察委员会全体会议提交请愿书，敦促中央政府颁布法令，要求全面降低房屋租金。上海公共租界内支持上海减租运动的其他团体将被邀请加入该代表团。

March 23, 1934. Morning Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

Yesterday the Chapei District Rent Reduction
Movement Committee addressed a letter to the Shanghai Rent
Reduction Movement Committee requesting it to convene a
meeting of sub-committees and units of the Committee in the
immediate future.

The East & West Ziang Shing Li Unit of the First
Shanghai Special District Rent Reduction Movement Committee,
in a letter addressed to the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement
Committee, stated that the unit was inaugurated at 2 p.m.
March 15 and that the schedule of the Committee for obtaining
a reduction in rents is being followed faithfully.

The 19th Sub-Committee of the First Shanghai Special
District Rent Reduction Movement Committee yesterday sent a
letter to the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee
to request that Brandt & Rodgers Co. reduce the rentals
of the houses in Liang Nyi Li (两宜里), Yochow Road, by 40%.

The following letter was received by the Shanghai
Rent Reduction Movement Committee from the Sz Zer Li (师善里
East Seward Road) Rent Reduction Unit :-
"Recently the tenants of the houses in Sz Zer Li
Alleyway, East Seward Road, received a notice from the Shanghai
Water Works Co. stating that unless agreements for water supply
be signed by the tenants, the water supply to the alleyway
would be disconnected. The tenants hold a meeting at which
it was resolved that 6 representatives be sent to make an appeal
to Burkill & Sons Co. and to request that artesian wells
be installed."

On March 14 a lawyer engaged by the landlord of the
houses in the San Tou Li Alleyway (三多里), Dah Chi Road(大志路),
Nantao, sent a letter to the tenants urging them to pay the
rentals for the months of February and March and intimating that
legal action would be taken should the tenants refuse to pay the
arrears.

Yesterday the San Tou Li Rent Reduction Unit sent
a letter to the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee
stating that rentals have been deposited at the Shanghai
Commercial & Savings Bank, West Gate Branch, and would be paid
to the landlord after the dispute had been satisfactorily
settled.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram) :

BRITISH OCCUPY YUNNAN MINING ZONE

On March 26 the Foreign Ministry will issue a statement
regarding the British occupation of Peng Hung (班洪) district
on the Yunnan border.
The Ministry will open negotiations with the British
Authorities upon receiving the report of the investigations made
by officials of the Ministry in conjunction with those of the
Yunnan Provincial Government.

1934年3月23日。晨间译文。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动

昨日，闸北区减租运动委员会致函上海减租运动委员会，请求其在近期召开各分会及下属单位的会议。

上海第一特区减租运动委员会东西祥兴里单位在一封致上海减租运动委员会的信中表示，该单位于3月15日下午2时成立，并正在忠实执行委员会制定的减租时间表。

上海第一特区减租运动委员会第十九分会昨日致函上海减租运动委员会，要求 Brandt & Rodgers 公司将约克路（Yochow Road）两宜里（Liang Nyi Li）的房屋租金降低40%。

上海减租运动委员会收到来自东熙华德路师善里（Sz Zer Li）减租单位的如下信件：
“近日，东熙华德路师善里弄堂的住户收到上海自来水公司的通知，称除非租户签署供水协议，否则将切断对该弄堂的供水。租户召开会议，决议派出6名代表向 Burkill & Sons 公司提出呼吁，并要求安装深井。”

3月14日，南市大志路（Dah Chi Road）三多里（San Tou Li Alleyway）房屋业主聘请的一名律师致信租户，催促他们支付二月和三月的租金，并暗示如果租户拒绝支付欠款，将采取法律行动。

昨日，三多里减租单位致函上海减租运动委员会，称租金已存入上海商业储蓄银行西门分行，将在纠纷得到满意解决后支付给业主。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸（南京电）：

英国占领云南矿区

外交部将于3月26日就英国占领云南边境班洪（Peng Hung）地区一事发表声明。
在收到外交部官员会同云南省政府官员进行的调查报告后，部方将与英国当局展开谈判。

March 21, 1934.    Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

Yesterday the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement
Committee addressed a letter to its various units and
sub-committees ordering them to apply for registration
within three days from receipt of the letter and
advising that unless they comply with the requirement,
no responsibility would be taken by the Rent Reduction
Movement Committee in the event of any dispute arising
The Third Sub-Committee of the Chapei District
Rent Reduction Movement Committee held a meeting yesterday
at which a number of resolutions were passed.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

INDIAN PRINCE COMING TO SHANGHAI.

It was at first reported that Prince "Soo Tan"
(蘇丹) of "Zeu Ver" (柔佛), India, and his wife
would arrive in Shanghai yesterday morning on the
ss. "Fushimi Maru", but owing to fog, the steamer did not
reach port at the appointed time.
According to reports from the N.Y.K., the
steamer will arrive here between 7 a.m. and 9 a.m.
to-day. Local Chinese and foreign officials organs will
detail officials to welcome the couple at the Wayside
Wharf, Yangtsepoo Road.
It is reported that the couple will shortly
leave for Japan by the same vessel.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

RE-ORGANIZATION OF THE FILM CENSORSHIP COMMITTEE.

The Film Censorship Committee, which is under
the direct control of the Central Film Industry Direction
Committee of the Central Propaganda Committee, has now
been re-organized. At 3 p.m. March 20, the Central Film
Industry Direction Committee sent Ico Kong (羅剛), Chief
of the re-organized Film Censorship Committee, to take
over the business of the old Film Censorship Committee
which was jointly organized by the Ministry of Interior
and the Ministry of Education.
It is learned that the office of the re-organized
Film Censorship Committee is located for the time being
at the auditorium of the Ministry of Education, the office
of the former Film Censorship Committee.
The salary of the Chief of the re-organized Film
Censorship Committee is $200 per mensem and that of the
six members of the Committee is $100 or less. The
re-organized Committee may have four to six executive
members as well as clerks and the expenses will be defrayed
by the Committee. Whenever it is found that the Committee
experiences difficulty in meeting the expenses, the Central
Propaganda Committee will request the Government for
financial aid on behalf of the Censorship Committee.

1934年3月21日。晨间译件。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动。

昨日，上海减租运动委员会致函其各分部及小组委员会，命令其在收到信函之日起三日内申请注册，并告知若不遵守此要求，一旦发生任何纠纷，减租运动委员会概不负责。
闸北区减租运动委员会第三小组委员会昨日召开会议，通过了多项决议。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

印度王储抵沪。

此前有报道称，印度“柔佛”（Zeu Ver）的“苏丹”（Soo Tan）王储及其夫人将于昨晨乘坐“伏见丸”号轮船抵达上海，但因大雾，该轮未能按时抵港。
据日本邮船会社（N.Y.K.）报告，该轮将于今日上午7时至9时之间抵达此处。本地中外官方机构将派遣官员前往杨树浦路码头迎接这对夫妇。
据悉，这对夫妇不久后将乘同一艘轮船前往日本。

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：

电影检查委员会改组。

隶属于中央宣传部中央电影事业指导委员会直接管辖的电影检查委员会现已改组。3月20日下午3时，中央电影事业指导委员会派遣改组后的电影检查委员会主任罗刚（Ico Kong）接管由内政部和教育部联合组织的原电影检查委员会的事务。
据悉，改组后的电影检查委员会办公室暂设于教育部礼堂，即原电影检查委员会办公室所在地。
改组后的电影检查委员会主任月薪为200元，六名委员的月薪为100元或以下。改组后的委员会可设四至六名执行委员以及书记员，费用由委员会承担。若发现委员会在支付费用方面遇到困难，中央宣传部将代表检查委员会向政府请求财政援助。

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动。

在上海减租运动委员会闸北区委员会第三分部昨日举行的会议上，决议就居住在满洲路252号的陆暂良（Toh Chao-liang）致函该分部告知断水并请求援助一事，将原信副本送交区委员会请示，并命令调查科查问该案相关情况。

上海减租运动委员会致函小南门陈正昌糖行（Chen Ching Chong Sugar Company）所租房屋的房东，警告称，由于该公司不欠租金，其试图强迫该公司搬离的行为有失公正，除非其停止进一步行动，否则将对由此遭受的任何损失承担责任

March 20, 1934.    Morning Tribune

responsible for any loss thus sustained.

The Rent Reduction Movement Committee yesterday addressed a letter to the Chung Fah Company (中發公司), owners of the San Min Fang Alleyway (三民坊) and Sin Min Fang Alleyway (新民坊) requesting the Company to reduce the rents in accordance with the reduction scale and not to take oppressive action against the tenants.

At 2 p.m. yesterday, the tenants of the South Wen Tuh Li Alleyway (南文德里) of the Second Special District Citizens Federation held a general meeting. A unit of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee was formed and the following resolutions were passed:-
1) That the rents be reduced by 30 per cent and that in case the landlord refuse to accept, the sums be deposited in a bank.
2) That a letter together with copies of the measures for rent reduction be sent to the landlord.
3) That Yuan Chung Kang (袁忠亢) and four others be elected to serve on the committee of the unit.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

FIRE BRIGADE EQUIPMENT

Lawyer Wu Hwa Tai (吳華泰) has addressed the following letter to the Fire Brigades in the foreign Settlements in this locality :-
"The local fire brigades are considered most competent. Recently many high buildings have been constructed. The fire brigades may experience difficulty when extinguishing fires in high buildings.
"If fire breaks out on the ground floor of a high building, the persons residing on the top floors would be unable to avoid danger. Although the fire brigades are equipped with long ladders, when many persons are in danger, they can not all be rescued. Thus "rescue nets" or "safety nets" are required. These nets are made of thick rope. When fire breaks out, these nets can be used and persons residing on top stories can be rescued. The nets are used in foreign countries, but the fire brigades in the foreign settlements in Shanghai are not yet equipped with them. I hereby suggest that henceforth the nets be taken into use."

China Times and other local newspapers:

RICSHA PULLERS SUBMIT PETITION TO S.M.C.

Several thousand ricsha pullers in Shanghai yesterday submitted to the S.M.C. a joint petition the sole purpose of which was to demand that the illegal hire fee on each ricsha be reduced from 140 cents to 80 cents small money. The petition also expressed opposition to the proposals drawn up by the Ricsha Commission.

减租运动委员会昨日致函三民坊（San Min Fang Alleyway）和新民坊（Sin Min Fang Alleyway）的业主中发公司（Chung Fah Company），要求该公司按照减租标准降低租金，不得对租户采取压迫性行动。

昨日下午2时，第二特区市民联合会南文德里（South Wen Tuh Li Alleyway）租户举行大会。成立了上海减租运动委员会的一个分部，并通过以下决议：
1) 租金减少百分之三十，若房东拒绝接受，则将款项存入银行。
2) 将信函连同减租措施副本送交房东。
3) 选举袁忠亢（Yuan Chung Kang）等五人担任分部委员会委员。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

消防队装备

吴华泰（Wu Hwa Tai）律师已向本地外国租界的消防队致函如下：
“本地消防队被认为最为能干。近期建造了许多高楼。消防队在扑灭高楼火灾时可能会遇到困难。
“如果高楼底层发生火灾，居住在顶层的人员将无法躲避危险。虽然消防队配备了长梯，但当许多人处于危险中时，无法全部救出。因此需要‘救生网’或‘安全网’。这些网由粗绳制成。发生火灾时，可以使用这些网，从而救出居住在顶层的人员。国外已使用这种网，但上海外国租界的消防队尚未配备。本人建议今后启用这种网。”

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

人力车夫向工部局提交请愿书

上海数千名人力车夫昨日向工部局提交了一份联合请愿书，其唯一目的是要求将每辆人力车的非法租车费从140分小洋降至80分小洋。请愿书还表示反对人力车委员会拟定的提案。

March 16, 1934. Morning Translation

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

At 3 p.m. yesterday a meeting of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee took place at the office of the First Special District Citizens Federation and was attended by fifteen persons with Chen Chiu Feng (陈九峰) in the chair.
After some discussion, the meeting passed the following resolutions:-
1) That regarding the request submitted by the tenants of the Tung Hai Li alleyway (通海里), a letter be sent to the landlord, and Cha Kia Liang (邱嘉樑) and Chu Pao Lu (朱保盧) be appointed to take the matter up with the landlord.
2) That regarding the complaint filed by the tenants of the San Lin Fang alleyway (三民坊) and the San Lin Fang Alleyway (彩民坊) against their landlord, a letter be despatched requesting him to reduce the rents in accordance with the scale of reduction.
3) That the landlord of the Pa Hwa Li alleyway (宝华里) be requested not to ask his tenants to remove.
4) That the self-governing association organized by the tenants of the San Lin Fang alleyway (三民坊) and San Sin Fang alleyway (二民坊) be dissolved for interfering with the rent reduction movement.
5) That a warning be issued to the landlord of the Markham Li alleyway (麦加里) against increasing the water charges.
6) That a further petition be submitted requesting the Central Kuomintang Headquarters, the National Government and the Executive Yuan to sanction the reduction in rents.
7) That notices be issued to the various units and sub-committees of the Rent Reduction Movement Committee to enforce the reduction measures, and the House Owners Association be notified to this effect.
8) That the local Kuomintang Headquarters and the Bureau of Social Affairs be petitioned to order the abolition of the collection of rents at the end of lunar year.
9) That permission be given for the formation of units by the tenants of the San Tu Li ( ) and other alleyways.

A unit of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee was organized yesterday by the tenants of the Lo Yih Li Alleyway (洛义里), off North Szechuen Road. 15 persons were elected to the Executive Committee of the unit.

The tenants of the East and West Tsiang Hsing Li alleyways (祥兴里), off Tatung Road formed a unit of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee yesterday. Six persons were elected members of the Executive Committee and a number of resolutions were passed.

Yesterday the tenants of the Feng Sung Li alleyway (凤生里), off Lairhead Road, held a meeting in the Lung Shi Tea House on East Broadway Road. Some 100 persons were present. A number of resolutions were passed and nine persons were chosen to compose the executive committee of the unit.

1934年3月16日。晨间译件

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动

昨日下午3时，上海减租运动委员会在第一特区市民联合会办公室召开会议，十五人出席，由陈九峰（Chen Chiu Feng）主持。
经讨论后，会议通过以下决议：
1) 关于通海里（Tung Hai Li alleyway）租户提出的请求，致函房东，并指派邱嘉樑（Cha Kia Liang）和朱保卢（Chu Pao Lu）与房东交涉此事。
2) 关于三民坊（San Lin Fang alleyway）和彩民坊（San Lin Fang Alleyway）[注：原文英文拼写相同，中文译名不同]租户对其房东的投诉，致函要求其按照减租标准降低租金。
3) 请求宝华里（Pa Hwa Li alleyway）的房东不要要求其租户搬离。
4) 解散由三民坊（San Lin Fang alleyway）和二民坊（San Sin Fang alleyway）租户组织的自治协会，因其干扰减租运动。
5) 向麦加里（Markham Li alleyway）的房东发出警告，禁止增加水费。
6) 再次提交请愿书，请求国民党中央党部、国民政府和行政院批准减租。
7) 向减租运动委员会的各分部和小组委员会发布通知，强制执行减租措施，并就此通知房主协会。
8) 请愿本地国民党党部和社会局下令废除农历年底收租的做法。
9) 允许三图里（San Tu Li）及其他里弄的租户成立分部。

昨日，北四川路洛义里（Lo Yih Li Alleyway）的租户组织了上海减租运动委员会的一个分部。十五人当选为该分部执行委员会委员。

昨日，大通路祥兴里（East and West Tsiang Hsing Li alleyways）东西两侧的租户成立了上海减租运动委员会的一个分部。六人当选为执行委员会委员，并通过了多项决议。

昨日，雷赫德路（Lairhead Road）凤生里（Feng Sung Li alleyway）的租户在东百老汇路龙寺茶馆举行会议。约一百人出席。通过了多项决议，并选出九人组成该分部执行委员会。

March 14, 1934. Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :

TENANTS IN TUNG HAI LI ALLEYWAY PROTEST AGAINST INCREASE
IN RENTALS

Some time ago the water supply to the houses in
Tung Hai Li (通海里) Alleyway, Tungchow Road, was disconnected
because the tenants refused to agree to an increase in rentals.
Later the dispute was settled.
The landlord has again demanded an increase of
$2 per month for the water rate, but the tenants declined to
accept the proposal on the ground that the rentals are
high and that the landlords of other terraces in the vicinity
pay the water rates.
At 10 a.m. yesterday the water supply to the
houses in the alleyway was again disconnected. In consequence
of appeals made by the tenants, the hydrants were opened.
When interviewed by a reporter of the Sin Sin News Agency,
a representative of the tenants stated :
"The landlord has frequently disconnected the
water supply. The tenants of the alleyway will hold an
emergency meeting this evening (March 15), and a manifesto
will be issued by the Tenants Federation of the alleyway.
"The houses in the alleyway were built in 1929
and the monthly rental for a shop is $33 and for a
dwelling house $26.
"Since the January 28th Incident only 2½ months
rent was remitted by the landlord of this alleyway whereas
3 and 4 months rent was remitted by the landlords of Shing
Wang Li (兴仁里) and Nyi Shing Li (义兴里) Alleyways.
"In December last year the water supply in the
alleyway was disconnected for several days. Now the water
supply is again disconnected. The rentals of other houses
in the neighbourhood are lower yet water charges are included
in the rent.
"The landlord does not consider the tenants of
this alleyway and has disconnected water supply. The tenants
of the alleyway will unite and protest against the increase."

Meeting of the Rent Reduction Movement Committee

The Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee was
to have held a meeting on March 12 in the Chinese Chamber of
Commerce, North Soochow Road, but the meeting was postponed
until to-morrow at 2 p.m.

A meeting of the Chapel District Committee of the
Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee, took place yesterday.
A number of resolutions including one that propaganda work be
carried out in the vicinity of Kung Wo and Tatung Roads were
passed.

A unit of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement was
formed yesterday by the tenants of the Hai Phong Chien Alleyway,
off Haiphong Road. Liu Zai Chiu (刘载九) and eight others (海防村)
were nominated members of the Executive Committee of the unit.

1934年3月14日。晨间译件。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

通海里租户抗议加租

前因通州路通海里（Tung Hai Li）房屋租户拒绝同意增加租金，该处供水被切断。后纠纷得以解决。
房东再次要求每月增加水费2元，但租户以租金已高且附近其他里弄的房东承担水费为由，拒绝接受该提议。
昨日上午10时，该里弄房屋的供水再次被切断。经租户呼吁，消防栓重新开启。
在接受《申新通讯社》记者采访时，一名租户代表表示：
“房东频繁切断供水。本里弄租户将于今晚（3月15日）召开紧急会议，并将由本里弄租户联合会发布宣言。
“本里弄房屋建于1929年，店铺月租金为33元，住宅月租金为26元。
“自‘一·二八’事变以来，本里弄房东仅减免了2个半月的租金，而兴仁里（Shing Wang Li）和义兴里（Nyi Shing Li）的房东则减免了3至4个月的租金。
“去年12月，本里弄供水曾中断数日。如今供水再次被切断。附近其他房屋的租金较低，且租金中已包含水费。
“房东不顾本里弄租户利益，切断供水。本里弄租户将团结起来，抗议加租。”

减租运动委员会会议

上海减租运动委员会原定于3月12日在北苏州路中国商会举行会议，但会议推迟至明日下午2时举行。

上海减租运动委员会教堂区委员会于昨日召开会议。会议通过多项决议，其中包括在工部和达通路附近开展宣传工作。

昨日，海防路海防村（Hai Phong Chien Alleyway）租户成立了上海减租运动的一个分部单位。刘载九（Liu Zai Chiu）等九人被提名为该单位执行委员会委员。

March 13, 1934. Morning Translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

The Fu Yuan Li(福源里) Branch (Connaught Road) of the Rent Reduction Committee held its inaugural meeting yesterday. Some 50 tenants of the terrace were present. The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That 30¢ be collected from the tenants of each house for committee expenses.
2. That the landlords be requested to reduce the house rents by 40%.
3. That a representative be elected to attend the meeting of the General Rent Reduction Committee.

The Paosan Road Branch(Chapei District) of the Rent Reduction Committee was formed yesterday. 200 persons were present.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That a letter be sent to the landlords advising them to reduce the rentals voluntarily.
2. That 20 cents be collected from the tenants of each house and 40 cents from the tenants of each shop.
3. That the tenants of the various terraces be urged to form rent reduction committees.

The Hotel Trade Association has sent a letter to the Shanghai Real Estate Owners Association stating that the increase of rentals had greatly affected business and that a rent reduction movement has been launched. The owners of hotels were requested to reduce the rentals.

The 17th and the 28th Divisions (Szechuen Road, Boone Road, North Kiangse Road and Purdon Road.) of the Citizens Federation held a meeting at 2 p.m. yesterday in the premises of Yuan Chi Tong(元济堂) to discuss rent reduction affairs
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That a standard of rent reduction be fixed.
2. That a fixed procedure be adopted to govern the organization of rent reduction movement committees.
3. That 12 members together with the executive members of the 17th Divisional Branch Federation be appointed members of the Rent Reduction Committee.

The Chapei District Rent Reduction Committee held a meeting yesterday at which the following resolutions were passed:-
1. That Feng Yi Sien(一先) be requested to withdraw his resignation.
2. That assistance be given to the tenants of those terraces having no rent reduction branch committees.
3. That ten persons be elected members of the Committee.

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动

减租委员会福源里（Fu Yuan Li）分部（康纳特路）于昨日举行成立大会。该里弄约50名租户出席。通过以下决议：
1. 向每户租户收取30分，作为委员会经费。
2. 请求房东将房屋租金降低40%。
3. 选举一名代表参加减租总委员会会议。

减租委员会宝山路分部（闸北区）于昨日成立。200人出席。
通过以下决议：
1. 致函房东，劝其自愿减租。
2. 向每户住宅租户收取20分，向每家店铺租户收取40分。
3. 敦促各里弄租户组建减租委员会。

旅馆业同业公会致函上海房地产业主协会，称租金上涨严重影响生意，且减租运动已经发起。请求旅馆业主降低租金。

市民联合会第17和第28分区（四川路、布恩路、江西北路和珀顿路）于昨日下午2时在元济堂（Yuan Chi Tong） premises 举行会议，讨论减租事宜。
通过以下决议：
1. 确定减租标准。
2. 采用固定程序来规范减租运动委员会的组织工作。
3. 任命12名成员以及第17分区支会联合会的执行成员为减租委员会委员。

闸北区减租委员会于昨日举行会议，通过以下决议：
1. 请冯一先（Feng Yi Sien）撤回辞呈。
2. 对没有设立减租分部委员会的里弄租户提供援助。
3. 选举十人为委员会委员。

March 12, 1934. Morning Translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

The tenants of the various terraces in this locality have organized rent reduction committee branches and have registered their organizations with the Shanghai Rent Reduction Committee.
The 3rd Divisional Branch (Chapei District) of the Rent Reduction Committee held a meeting on March 10 at which the following resolutions were passed:-
1. That efforts be made to settle the dispute between the owners and tenants of the Suan Lung Hotel.
2. That Wu Yu Ling be elected chairman of the mediation committee.
3. That the work of registering the various rent reduction committee branches be continued.

The Chiung An Li Branch (Chekiang Road) of the Rent Reduction Committee was formed sometime ago and a manifesto was issued yesterday.

Meeting of Tenants

The rents of houses on Rue Montauban are considered exorbitant by the tenants who have organized a rent reduction committee and have sent representatives to request the owners to reduce the rentals.
The tenants held a meeting on March 10, at which the following resolutions were passed:-
1. That the committee register with the Shanghai General Rent Reduction Committee.
2. That 70% of the rentals be deposited with banks commencing from January, 1934.

Inaugural Meeting of Nanteo District Committee

The inaugural meeting of the Nantao District Committee of the Shanghai House Rent Reduction Movement Committee took place at 2 p.m. yesterday in the premises of the Sauce Shop Owners Association, City. Over 200 persons representing 80 bodies attended. Tse Sung Yang (朱声扬) and 34 others were elected members of the Executive Committee and the following resolutions were passed :-
1) That the rentals of the houses in the Nantao District be reduced in accordance with the scale devised by the Shanghai House Rent Reduction Movement Committee.
2) That the tenants be instructed to deposit the rentals in a bank pending a settlement of the dispute.
3) That an appeal requesting a reduction of rentals be submitted to the Shanghai City Government.
4) That the tenants be notified to form sub-committees and units of the Nantao District Committee of the Shanghai House Rent Reduction Movement Committee.
5) That the local Tangpu and other political organs be requested to protect house rent reduction organizations.

1934年3月12日。晨间译件

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动

本地各里弄租户已组织减租委员会分部，并向上海减租委员会登记备案。
减租委员会第三分区支部（闸北区）于3月10日举行会议，通过以下决议：
1. 努力解决算龙旅馆（Suan Lung Hotel）业主与租户之间的纠纷。
2. 选举吴玉麟（Wu Yu Ling）为调解委员会主席。
3. 继续开展各减租委员会分部的登记工作。

减租委员会琼安里（Chiung An Li）分部（浙江路）已于此前成立，并于昨日发布宣言。

租户会议

蒙托邦路（Rue Montauban）的房屋租金被租户认为过高，租户们已组织减租委员会，并派代表请求业主降低租金。
租户于3月10日举行会议，通过以下决议：
1. 委员会向上海减租总委员会登记。
2. 自1934年1月起，将70%的租金存入银行。

南区委员会成立大会

上海房屋减租运动委员会南区委员会成立大会于昨日下午2时在市内酱园业主协会会所举行。代表80个团体的200余人出席。朱声扬（Tse Sung Yang）等35人被选为执行委员会委员，并通过以下决议：
1) 南区房屋租金按照上海房屋减租运动委员会制定的标准进行降低。
2) 指示租户在纠纷解决之前将租金存入银行。
3) 向上海市政府提交请求减租的请愿书。
4) 通知租户组建上海房屋减租运动委员会南区委员会的下设分会和单位。
5) 请求当地塘沽及其他政治机关保护房屋减租组织。

March 11, 1934.
Morning Translation.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY No. D 3482/3 Date 11 / 3 / 34）

China Times and other local newspapers:

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

In connection with the rent reduction movement, the meeting which was to have been held by the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee at 2 p.m. yesterday has been postponed. The Committee yesterday sent a further letter to the Real Estates Owners Association requesting it to make a reduction in house rentals.
At a meeting held yesterday by the Mediation Committee of the 3rd Branch of the Chapei District Committee of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee, the following resolutions were passed:-
1. Regarding the unlawful increase in the rent of the Song Loong Hotel (双龍旅館), the landlord be requested to attend a mediation meeting to be convened by this Committee.
2. That Woo Ngoh-lin (吳玉麟) be appointed chairman of this Committee.
It is understood that the Nantao District Committee of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee will hold its inaugural meeting at 2 p.m. to-day in the premises of the Shanghai General Labour Union on Foh Yeu Road, Nantao.
The following officials have been appointed by the First Special District Committee of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee to attend meetings to be held by various Units of the Committee:-
1. Chow Fu-chwang (周輔璋) to attend the inaugural meeting of the Lingching Li (臨青里) Unit on Lingching Road, to be held at 2 p.m. March 11.
2. Liu Zoong-ying (刘仲英) to attend a general meeting of the 17th Branch to be held at 2 p.m. March 11. Questions regarding the rent reduction movement will be discussed.
3. Chow Fu -chwang to be present at the inaugural meeting of the Voong Sun Li ( ) Unit on Broadway to be held at 7 p.m. March 11.

Society Evening News dated March 10:

RICSHA PULLERS TO GO ON STRIKE.

The Ricsha Trade Association has expressed its opposition to the recommendations of the Ricsha Committee of the S.M.C. The Ricsha Pullers Union has also lodged a protest against these recommendations.
French and Japanese newspapers report that ricsha owners are inciting the ricsha pullers to go on strike in order to obstruct the Council's measures to improve the conditions of ricshas.
An officer of the Ricsha Trade Association yesterday denied that the owners were instigating a strike, but declared that a strike might take place should the protest of the pullers and the owners be ignored by the S.M.C.

减租运动。

关于减租运动，上海减租运动委员会原定于昨日下午2时举行的会议已延期。委员会昨日再次致函房地产业主协会，请求其降低房屋租金。
在上海减租运动委员会闸北区委员会第三分部调解委员会昨日举行的会议上，通过以下决议：
1. 关于双龙旅馆（Song Loong Hotel）非法涨租一事，请房东出席由本委员会召开的调解会议。
2. 任命吴玉麟（Woo Ngoh-lin）为本委员会主席。
据悉，上海减租运动委员会南区委员会将于今日下午2时在南市福州路上海总工会会所举行成立大会。
上海减租运动委员会第一特区委员会已指派以下官员参加委员会各单位举行的会议：
1. 周辅璋（Chow Fu-chwang）出席临青里（Lingching Li）单位于3月11日下午2时在临青路举行的成立大会。
2. 刘仲英（Liu Zoong-ying）出席第17分部于3月11日下午2时举行的大会。会议将讨论有关减租运动的问题。
3. 周辅璋出席荣顺里（Voong Sun Li）（原文不清）单位于3月11日晚7时在百老汇路举行的成立大会。

3月10日《社会晚报》：

人力车夫将罢工。

人力车业同业公会对工部局人力车委员会的建议表示反对。人力车夫工会也对这些建议提出抗议。
法文和日文报纸报道说，人力车车主正在煽动人车夫罢工，以阻挠工部局改善人力车状况的措施。
人力车业同业公会的一名官员昨日否认车主正在煽动罢工，但宣称如果工部局无视车夫和车主的抗议，罢工可能会发生。

March 10, 1934. Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

At 2 p.m. yesterday, the First Special District Citizens Federation held a meeting of representatives from its branches. After some discussion, the following resolutions were passed:-
1) That a letter be sent requesting the law court to deal severely with Wu Yung An (吴永安) for forging the seal of the Association and collecting money from tenants without the authority of the Association.
2) That Zee Chao Chow (□□□), a secretary of the 32nd Branch be detailed to attend court to give evidence against Wu Yung An.
3) That rent investigation forms be distributed to various units of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee.
4) That tenants of various streets and alleyways be urged to form rent reduction movement units and all shops be asked to join the movement.
5) That assistance be rendered to all tenants in disputes over rent reduction.

The 14 houses on Avenue Edward VII rented by Yuan-Feng (源丰) and others belong to Algar & Company, Ltd. Recently the tenants received a notification from the landlord stating that as from January 1, 1934, the water charges would be increased by $6.00 a month.
Upon receipt of the notice, the tenants wrote a letter to the 12th Branch of the First Special District Citizens Federation requesting assistance.
In compliance with the request, the Branch yesterday despatched a letter to the landlords asking them not to increase the water charges.

The Third Sub-Committee of the Chapei District Committee of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee held a meeting yesterday. The following resolutions were discussed and passed:-
1) That Wei Tse Chow (魏子秋) and others be appointed members of the Preparatory Committee.
2) That a warning be sent to those committee members who are neglecting their duties at the office of the sub-committee.
3) That 5,000 copies of a manifesto and slogans and 4,000 copies of registration forms be printed for distribution during the membership campaign.

A meeting of the Nanking Road Street Union and of the First Branch of the First Special District Citizens Federation took place on the evening of March 8.
A number of resolutions including one that tenants of the houses belong to one landlord hold meetings under the supervision of the Branch were passed.
It is understood that further meetings will be convened by the Union and the Branch to-day and tomorrow and an announcement of the measures for a rent reduction will be made after the meetings.

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动

昨日下午二时，第一特区市民联合会召开各分部代表会议。经讨论后，通过如下决议：
1) 致函法院，请求对吴永安伪造本会印章及未经本会授权向租户收款之行为予以严惩。
2) 指派第三十二分部秘书 Zee Chao Chow (□□□) 出庭作证，指控吴永安。
3) 向上海减租运动委员会各单位分发租金调查表。
4) 敦促各街道里弄租户组建减租运动单位，并邀请所有商店加入该运动。
5) 为所有涉及减租纠纷的租户提供援助。

源丰等承租的爱德华七世路（Avenue Edward VII）14幢房屋属 Algar & Company, Ltd. 所有。近日租户收到房东通知，称自1934年1月1日起，每月水费增加6.00元。
接到通知后，租户致函第一特区市民联合会第十二分部请求援助。
应此请求，该分部昨日致函房东，要求其不要增加水费。

上海减租运动委员会闸北区分委员会第三小组委员会昨日召开会议。讨论并通过如下决议：
1) 任命魏子秋等人筹备委员会委员。
2) 向在小组委员会办公室怠忽职守的委员发出警告。
3) 印制宣言及标语5,000份、登记表4,000份，以便在招募会员期间分发。

南京路街联会与第一特区市民联合会第一分部于3月8日晚举行会议。
通过了多项决议，其中包括一项决议：同一房东名下房屋的租户应在该分部的监督下举行会议。
据悉，该街联会与分部将于今日和明日召开进一步会议，并在会后公布减租措施。

March 9, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

At a meeting held yesterday by the Standing Committee of the Chapei District Rent Reduction Movement Committee, the following resolutions were passed:-
1. That Chiang Yien-ching (蔣燕卿), Ho Ih-poo (胡一彼) and Chang Sin-mei (張梓楣) be despatched to give directions at the meetings to be held by the Units of the Chapei District Rent Reduction Movement Committee formed by the tenants of the Tuh Zung Li (德顺里) alleyway on Changan Road, the Por Yih Li (普益里) alleyway on Kung Woo Road, the Yung Nien Li (永里) and the Chang Sun Li (長森里) alleyways on Yue Kong Road and the San Yang Li (三陽里) alleyway on West Paoshing Road.
2. That Chang Sin-mei be detailed to attend the general meeting to be held on March 11 by the West Paoshing Road Sub-Committee.
3. That the 3rd Branch of the Chapei District Rent Reduction Movement Committee be inaugurated under the direction of Wei Chi-cheu (魏志秋).
4. Regarding the request of the Sang Loong Hotel (双龍旅館) on Kung Woo Road for assistance, the 3rd Branch is to mediate on the basis of the principles of rent reduction drawn up by the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee and submit a report on the result of the mediation.
5. That the Organization Department deal with the dispute over an increase in house rentals at Pang Ka Za (邦家宅).

Sin Wen Pao and other local newspapers:

MEETING OF SHANGHAI DRAMA DISCUSSION SOCIETY.

At a meeting held yesterday by the Preparatory Committee of the Shanghai Drama Discussion Society, about 40 persons representing the Public Safety Bureau, the Social Bureau and dramatists circles were present. Pan Kung-chan, Chief of the Education Bureau, presided.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That all experts of dramatic plays be recommended as members of this Society.
2. That a date for the formal inauguration of this Society be fixed after a petition for approval has been submitted to the Shanghai City Government.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

TROUBLE BETWEEN A POLICEMAN & FISH HONG COOLIES:

At 6 a.m. yesterday the ss. Ning Shing entered port and berthed at the Ning Shing Wharf, Nantao Bund.

减租运动。

在闸北区减租运动委员会常务委员会昨日举行的会议上，通过如下决议：
1. 派遣蔣燕卿、胡一彼、張梓楣前往长安路德顺里、共和新路普益里、岳恭路永里和長森里以及西宝兴路三陽里的租户所组成的闸北区减租运动委员会各单位举行的会议进行指导。

上海戏剧讨论社会议。

March 8, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers :

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

At a meeting of the Executive Committee held yesterday by the 3rd Branch of the Chapei District Committee of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee, about 13 persons were present and the following resolutions were passed:
1) That as soon as this Branch is formally inaugurated, the Secretariat submit a report to the Chapei District Committee of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee for purposes of record.
2) That Wei Chi-cheu ( 魏志秋 ), Woo Ngoh-ling ( 吳玉麟 ), Woo Zoong-dah ( 吳仲達 ) and 6 others be nominated members of the "Mediation Committee" which is to be instituted and attached to the Branch.
3) That a meeting of the Standing Committee be held every Thursday and a joint meeting of various sections of the Branch every Monday.
4) That Woo Ngoh-ling, Lo Shih-wen ( 羅嗣文 ) and Chang Shih-shen ( 張禕僧 ) be appointed representatives to attend a meeting to be held by the Chapei District Committee.
It is reported that the following subordinate organizations of the Chapei District Committee of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee have been established:- the Paoshan Road ( 寶山路 ) Sub-Committee, the Kung Woo Hsin Road ( 共和新路 ) Sub-Committee, the Paoshing Road ( 寶興路 ) Sub-Committee, the Dah Yang Jao ( 大洋橋 ) Sub-Committee, the Poo Yih Li ( 普益里 ) Unit on East Jukong Road, the Hshun Tung Ii ( 順通里 ) Unit at Hoong Tseng ( 虹鎮 ), etc. These organizations have already submitted petitions to the District Committee for purposes of record.
At a meeting held at 6 p.m. yesterday by the 14th Branch District Citizens Federation, about 20 persons representing the residents and merchants on Avenue Edward VII, Shantung Road, Chiaotung Road and Kin Loong Ka Street ( 金隆街 ) were present. The following resolutions were passed:-
That, in accordance with the outlines governing the organization of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee, a Branch of the First Special District Committee be inaugurated on the following lines:-
a) The entire body of executive members of the 14th Branch District Citizens Federation be nominated members of the Branch of the First Special District Committee.
b) An Investigation Section to be established and Shao Yung-nan ( 邵南 ) be appointed chief of the Section and Yih Zai-chun ( 葉在春 ) and Wong Chih-ching ( 王志卿 ), members of the Section.
c) A meeting of tenants of this District within the jurisdiction of the Branch be held on March 20 at which the rent reduction movement will be discussed and the inauguration of this Branch announced. A report for purposes of record will also be submitted to various public organs.
Yesterday a meeting was held at No. 12 Hoo Chen Miao Ka Street ( 火神廟街 ), Nantao, under the auspices of Chu Sun-yang. The following resolutions were passed:-

减租运动

在上海减租运动委员会闸北区分委员会第三分部昨日举行的执行委员会会议上，约有13人出席，并通过如下决议：
1) 本分部正式成立后，秘书处应立即向上海减租运动委员会闸北区分委员会提交报告备案。
2) 提名魏志秋、吳玉麟、吳仲達等6人为拟设立并附属于本分部的“调解委员会”委员。
3) 常务委员会每周四举行会议，本分部各科联席会议每周一举行。
4) 任命吳玉麟、羅嗣文、張禕僧为代表，出席闸北区分委员会举行的会议。

第十四分区市民联合会于昨日下午6时举行会议，约有20人出席，代表爱德华七世路、山东路、交通路和金隆街的居民和商人。通过如下决议：
依照上海减租运动委员会组织大纲，按以下方式成立第一特区委员会分部：
a) 提名第十四分区市民联合会全体执行委员为该分部委员。
b) 设立调查科，任命邵南为科长，葉在春、王志卿为科员。

March 8, 1934. / Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

Yesterday the Various Schools Rent Reduction
Movement Committee sent the following letter to the Real
Estate Owners Association :-
"Lost schools in this locality are accommodated
in leased premises. As the rentals are high, the
development of culture has been affected. This committee
has been formed to promote the cause of education.
"At the third meeting held by this committee
it was resolved that your association be requested to
notify the houseowners of school premises to reduce the
rentals."

China Times and other local newspapers :

SHANGHAI FIRST SPECIAL DISTRICT CITIZENS FEDERATION TO
HOLD MEETINGS

The Shanghai First Special District Citizens
Federation will call a meeting at 2 p.m. March 10 in the
premises of the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce, at which members
of the Executive and the Supervisory Committees will be
elected. A notice to this effect has been issued to
representatives of various district branches, and the local
Tangpu and other political organs have been requested to
detail officials to supervise the function.
It is reported that the Federation will convene
a joint meeting of various public bodies at 2 p.m. today
in the Chamber's premises at which all important problems
will be discussed.

China Times and other local newspapers :

PRECAUTIONARY MEASURES IN CHINESE CONTROLLED TERRITORY

Upon being secretly informed to the effect that
the communists would call a meeting at a certain deserted
part of Zia Too Road (斜土路), Nantao, and would hold
a demonstration to-day, the "International Women's
Commemoration Day" and also one of the commemoration days
of the Communist Party, General Wen Hoong-en, Chief of the
Public Safety Bureau, instructed his subordinates, the
Inspection Office, the Detective Corps and various divisions
and sections of the Bureau to take strict precautionary
measures on this occasion.
Extra police will be posted at the intersections
of Chinese controlled territory and the Settlement, and
detectives will be stationed along the Fong Pang Jao (方浜桥),
West Gate.
It is reported that the Settlement and the French
Authorities will also detail Chinese and foreign detectives
for observation duty in the Settlement and French Concession.

减租运动

昨日，各校减租运动委员会向房地产主协会发送如下信函：
“本地许多学校租用校舍。由于租金高昂，文化发展受到影响。本委员会旨在促进教育事业。
“在本委员会第三次会议上，决议请求贵会通知校舍业主降低租金。”

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

上海第一特区市民联合会将举行会议

上海第一特区市民联合会将于3月10日下午2时在上海总商会会所召开会议，选举执行委员会和监察委员会成员。已向各区分部代表发出通知，并请求当地塘沽及其他政治机关派员监督此次会议。
据悉，该联合会将于今日下午2时在商会会所召开各公共团体联席会议，讨论所有重要问题。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

华界预防措施

据密报，共产党人将在南市斜土路某偏僻地段召开会议，并于今日——即“国际妇女节”及共产党纪念日之一——举行示威游行，公安局局长温洪恩将军指示其下属督察处、侦探队及局内各科股在此 occasion 采取严格预防措施。
在华界与租界交界处增派警力，并在方浜桥、西门沿线部署侦探。
据悉，租界当局和法租界当局也将派遣中外侦探在租界和法租界内进行观察监视。

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

Yesterday the 16th Branch of the First Special
District Citizens Federation and the Canton Road Sub-
Committee of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee
addressed a letter to the Mayor of the City Government of
Shanghai which reads as follows :-
"Following the 28th January Incident, the local
market has been on the decline. A great many business
houses have closed down. Trade depression may partly
account for this state of affairs, but the principal
reason is the high rentals.
"House owners frequent daily luxurious hotels,
dancing halls, cinemas and sing song girl houses. As
these places are expensive, this privileged class of people
sometimes may be in financial difficulties. With a view
to securing more money, the house owners seek to increase
the rents of their houses.
"During the present period of acute trade
depression, if all classes of people do not cooperate, the
result will be ruin.
"In response to the request of our members,
we would ask you to express your opinion concerning a
reduction in rents so that we may follow your advice and
disputes between landlord and tenant may be avoided."

The 17th Branch of the First Special District
Citizens Federation has decided to convene a meeting at
2 p.m. on March 11 for the purpose of discussing the
rent reduction movement.

At 3 p.m. yesterday the tenants of Elgin,
Cunningham, Boundary and Shansi Roads held a meeting
at the Hung Hsing Lou Restaurant on Elgin Road. A
number of resolutions including one to form 6 units
of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee were
passed.

Yesterday the tenants of Tatung and Kung Wu
Roads in Chapei held a meeting at which officers were
elected to take charge of organizing a preparatory rent
reduction committee.

减租运动。

昨日，第一特区市民联合会第十六分会及上海减租运动委员会广东路小组委员会致函上海市政府市长，内容如下：
“自‘一·二八’事变以来，本地市况日渐萧条。大量商号倒闭。贸易衰退虽可部分解释此状况，但主要原因在于租金高昂。
“房东每日频繁出入豪华旅馆、舞厅、电影院及妓院。因这些场所消费昂贵，此特权阶层人士有时亦会陷入财务困境。为获取更多资金，房东试图提高房屋租金。
“在当前贸易严重衰退时期，若各界人士不合作，结果将是毁灭性的。
“应本会会员之请求，恳请阁下就减租一事发表意见，以便我等遵循阁下建议，避免业主与租户之间发生纠纷。”

March 6, 1934.    Morning Tra[nslation]

Min Pao (Comment):-

RENT REDUCTION

Most residents in Shanghai are complaining against the high house rentals. It is claimed that the greater part of the yearly income of most tenants goes to the landlords. Although we can not ascertain whether or not this is true, it is evident that the house rent is too high. Middle class and low class people experience great hardship in paying the rents. However, landlords, for the most part, have not made much profit from the house rents.

For the past few months, various trades have suffered from the depression, hence the agitation for a reduction in rentals. No doubt, we have to sympathize with the tenants because they are suffering. The landlords must not expect high profits during the present depression.

It is doubtful whether the present rent reduction movement will be successful. It depends on the landlords who ought only to demand reduced rentals during the present difficult times. Even if the rent reduction movement were successful, it would be only a temporary relief to the citizens. Until the S.M.C. can reduce the assessed land value, the landlords, owing to the heavy land tax, will never be willing to reduce the rentals over a long period.

Furthermore, not only will the S.M.C. not agree to the low assessment, but land owners also do not expect it. To attain the object of a reduction in rents by means of this process is not a sound scheme. Rents are high, because the cost of land is prohibitive. When land owners determine their rents, they have to take into consideration the cost of land, land tax, construction outlay, water charges. Of these items of expenditure, the land cost is the most important and because of the high price for land, land tax is also high. Therefore, in solving the problem of a rent reduction, special attention should be paid to the land cost. Since it is impossible to expect a low assessment, the hope for a rent reduction for houses situated in locations where the price for land is exorbitant, should not be entertained.

According to our opinion, the only way to lessen the burdens of the people is to build houses for them in places where the land is cheap. Before starting to build houses in these suburban areas, the first thing that should be done is to provide transport facilities. The people responsible for these enterprises should be the City Government and Chinese bankers. These are places outside the Concession and Settlement limits that can be developed, but the reason why these regions have not been developed is chiefly because no ample transport facilities have been provided, not because the supply of dwelling houses in the present residential area is sufficient for the demand.

《民报》（评论）：

减租

上海大多数居民抱怨房屋租金高昂。据称，大多数租户的年收入的绝大部分都流向了房东。虽然我们无法证实这是否属实，但显然房租过高。中下层民众在支付租金方面承受巨大困难。然而，房东从房租中获利大多并不多。

过去几个月，各行各业受经济衰退之苦，因此引发了减租 agitation（煽动/运动）。无疑，我们要同情遭受苦难的租户。房东不应期望在当前衰退期间获得高额利润。

目前的减租运动能否成功尚存疑问。这取决于房东，他们在当前困难时期只应要求降低租金。即使减租运动成功，对市民而言也只是暂时的缓解。在工部局（S.M.C.）降低土地估价之前，由于土地税沉重，房东绝不会愿意长期降低租金。

此外，不仅工部局不会同意低估价，土地所有者也不指望如此。通过此过程实现减租目标并非良策。租金高昂是因为地价过高。土地所有者在确定租金时，必须考虑地价、土地税、建筑支出及水费。在这些支出项目中，地价最为重要，且因地价高昂，土地税也相应较高。因此，在解决减租问题时，应特别注意地价成本。既然不可能指望低估价，就不应抱有希望降低那些位于地价极高地段房屋租金的想法。

依我方观点，减轻民众负担的唯一途径是在地价低廉的地方为他们建造房屋。在这些郊区开始建房之前，首要之事是提供交通设施。负责这些事业的应是市政府和中国银行家。这些是位于租界范围之外可供开发的地区，但这些区域尚未开发的主要原因主要是未提供充足的交通设施，而非现有居住区的住房供应足以满足需求。

March 6, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :

MEETING OF CHAPEI BRANCH OF THE SHANGHAI RENT REDUCTION
MOVEMENT COMMITTEE

At 2 p.m. yesterday the Chapei Branch of the Shanghai
Rent Reduction Movement Committee held a meeting at which
more than 30 persons were present and the following
resolutions were passed :-
1) That assistance be rendered to Soo Pao Yung (沙宝荣)
of Wen Siao Li (文孝里); Zung Cheo Foo (陈作坡) of No.29
Sz Zer Li (師寿里), Chin Yur Road; the Hung Tseng (虹鎮)
Sub Committee and the tenants of the Tuh Shing Li (德兴里),
Sin Min Road.
2) That the Iah Tung (又统) & Wong Wu (共和) sub-
committees be notified regarding the appointment of two
members named Nyi Zai Ziang (嚴瑞祥) and Wang Siao Dee(王小弟);
3) That members of the Standing Committee of the Branch
be warned after being absent five times.
4) That the Rent Reduction Movement Committee formed
by the local educational bodies be approved.
5) That 30,000 copies of handbills contributed by
Loo Tseng Sung (杜椿蓀) and Wui Tse Chiu (魏惠秋) urging
the people to form units of the Branch be distributed.
6) That the Pao San Road First Sub-Committee be
recognized.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :

SILVER SMITHS DECLARE HUNGER STRIKE

The local silver smiths declared a "go-slow" strike
as a protest against the reduction of wages. At a meeting
held by the Social Bureau it was resolved that the workers
and their employers devise an amicable settlement within a
week. One week has passed and no decision has been reached.
Yesterday the owners of silver works sent a petition
to the Bureau of Social Affairs stating that they are unable to
accept the workers' demands.
Twelve smiths organized a "hunger strike group" and at
10 a.m. yesterday they proceeded to the Silver Shops Guild off
Great East Gate, Nantao, where they started a hunger strike.
A piece of white cloth bearing the inscription "Hunger Strike
Group of the Silver Shops Trade Workers Union as a Protest
Against the Reduction of Wages" was placed on the gate of the
guild and a manifesto was issued by the workers.
Upon learning this, the Social Bureau and the local
Tangpu yesterday despatched representatives to advise the
hunger strikers to abandon their project but without result.

上海减租运动委员会闸北分会会议

昨日下午2时，上海减租运动委员会闸北分会举行会议，出席者三十余人，并通过以下决议：
1) 向文孝里的沙宝荣（Soo Pao Yung）、金沙江路师寿里29号的陈作坡（Zung Cheo Foo）、虹镇小组委员会以及新民道德兴里的租户提供援助。
2) 通知又统（Iah Tung）及共和（Wong Wu）小组委员会，任命严瑞祥（Nyi Zai Ziang）和王小弟（Wang Siao Dee）两名成员；
3) 对缺席五次的常务委员会成员提出警告。
4) 批准由当地教育机构组成的减租运动委员会。
5) 分发由杜椿蓀（Loo Tseng Sung）和魏惠秋（Wui Tse Chiu）捐助的三万份传单，呼吁民众组建分会单位。
6) 承认保三路第一小组委员会。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

银匠宣布绝食罢工

本地银匠为抗议减薪，宣布实行“怠工”罢工。在社会局召开的会议上，决议由工人与雇主在一周内达成和解。一周已过，仍未达成决定。
昨日，银楼业主向社会局递交请愿书，称无法接受工人的要求。
十二名银匠组织了“绝食团”，并于昨日上午10时前往南市大东门外的银业公所，开始绝食罢工。一块写有“银业职工工会绝食团抗议减薪”字样的白布悬挂在公所大门上，工人们并发布了一份宣言。
社会局及当地塘浦（Tangpu）获悉此事后，昨日派遣代表劝告绝食者放弃此举，但未果。

March 4, 1934. Morning Translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

FORMATION OF RENT REDUCTION COMMITTEE BRANCHES

The 22rd Divisional Branch of the Citizens Federation yesterday called a meeting of leading merchants on Hupeh, Kiangsi, and Hankow Roads in the Yic Bin Lou Restaurant(悦賓樓), Tah Hsing Ka(大新街), Hupeh Road. The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That members of the Executive Committee of the 33rd Divisional Branch of the Citizens Federation be elected to form a Rent Reduction Committee.
2. That five representatives be appointed.
3. That Chao Pan San(趙本善) be elected to urge the formation of Rent Reduction Committee Branches in various terraces within the 33rd Division area.
4. That the rentals of houses from January, 1934, be deposited with the banks pending a settlement of the dispute.
5. That measures devised by the Shanghai District Rent Reduction Committee be adopted.

The Pao Hwa Li(寶華里) Branch of the 6th Divisional Branch of the First Special District Citizens Federation held its inaugural meeting at 2 p.m. yesterday. 200 persons attended. Nine persons were elected as members of the Executive Committee. The following resolutions were also passed:-
1. That the Tuk Woo Company(德和洋行), owners of this Terrace, be requested not to compel the tenants to remove before March 31; and that the public be requested to render assistance.
2. That the Tenants Association of this Federation be abolished.
3. That membership fees be collected.

The Ping Kiang Li(平江里) Branch of the 5th Division of the Second Special District Citizens Federation held its inaugural meeting on March 1. More than 50 persons attended. Fifteen men were elected as members of the Committee.

The 9th Divisional Branch of the Second Special District Citizens Federation held a meeting at 3 p.m. yesterday in the premises of the Branch on Route Dupleix, French Concession, at which 40 members of the Executive Committee took their oath of office.

组建减租委员会分会

市民联合会第二十二分区昨日在湖北路大新街悦宾楼召集湖北路、江西路及汉口路的商界领袖开会。通过以下决议：
1. 选举市民联合会第三十三分区执行委员会成员组成减租委员会。
2. 指派五名代表。
3. 选举赵本善（Chao Pan San）督促在第三十三分区辖区内的各里弄组建减租委员会分会。
4. 将1934年1月起产生的房屋租金存入银行，待纠纷解决后再行处理。

第一特区市民联合会第六分区宝华里分会于昨日下午2时举行成立大会。出席者200人。九人当选为执行委员会成员。还通过了以下决议：
1. 请求该里弄的业主德和洋行（Tuk Woo Company）不要强迫租户在3月31日前搬离；并请求公众提供援助。
2. 废除本联合会的租户协会。
3. 收取会员费。

第二特区市民联合会第五分区平江里分会于3月1日举行成立大会。出席者五十余人。十五人当选为委员会成员。

第二特区市民联合会第九分区于昨日下午3时在法租界霞飞路（Route Dupleix）的分会会所举行会议，四十名执行委员会成员宣誓就职。

March 1, 1 34. Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers :

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

Yesterday the tenants of the Shao Sung Li
Alleyway (赵嵩里) off Avenue du Roi Albert, the Yu Ching Li
Alleyway (裕庆里) off Rue Pere Hue, the Lih Chung Li
Alleyway (立中里), Yochow Road, the Chu San Li Alleyway
(舟山里) off Musen Road and the Zia Zi Road, Nantao,
formed units of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement
Committee, and registered with the Committee. An
application was also submitted yesterday by the tenants of
the Kiu Sing Li Alleyway (久兴里) off Boulevard des Deux
Republiques for registration with the main Committee.
It was ascertained that committees for Hankow
Road, Shansi Road and other roads and alleyways held
meetings yesterday and that some important resolutions
were passed.

China Times and other local newspapers :

MEMORIAL SERVICE FOR DR. WU CHAO CHU

Friends and relatives of the late Dr. Wu Chao
Chu, member of the Central Executive Committee of the
Kuomintang, who died in Hongkong some months ago, have
decided to hold a memorial service at 2 p.m. April 1 in the
auditorium of the Administration Building of the Shanghai
City Government in the Civic Centre. Mayor Wu Te-chen,
Dr. Ts i Yuan Sie, Wang Shiao-lai, chairman of the Chinese
Chamber of Commerce, Ling Kong-hou, banker, Sun Fu,
President of the Legislative Yuan, Wang Ching Wei,
President of the Executive Yuan, Dr. H.H. Kung and others
have been elected to serve on the preparation committee
to make arrangements for the service.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

MEETING OF THE SHANGHAI GENERAL LABOUR UNION

The 2nd meeting of the Executive Committee
of the Shanghai General Labour Union took place yesterday
and Li Loong Nan (李龙南) presided. It was decided
to form a "Labourers' Military Training Class" (工友军事训练班)
with Tse Shuel Van (朱学范), Chow Chi Kwai (周起葵) and
Li Hwa (李华), committee members of the Union, in charge.

Sin Wan Pao (Nanking Telegram):

NEW BRITISH MINISTER TO PRESENT CREDENTIALS ON MARCH 6

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has secured the
approval of the Chairman of the National Government to the
suggestion that Sir Alexander Cadogan, new British Minister
to China, will present his credentials at 11 a.m. March 6.

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动

昨日，阿尔贝特国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）赵嵩里、倍尔路（Rue Pere Hue）裕庆里、扬州路立中里、慕尔根路（Musen Road）及霞子路舟山里、以及南市霞子路的租户，组成了上海减租运动委员会的各分部，并向委员会进行了登记。昨日，两共和国路（Boulevard des Deux Republiques）久兴里的租户也向总委员会提交了入会申请。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

吴稚晖博士追悼会

国民党中央执行委员吴稚晖博士数月前在香港逝世，其亲友决定于4月1日下午2时，在市中心上海市政府行政大楼礼堂举行追悼会。市长吴铁城、蔡元培博士、商会主席王晓籁、银行家凌鸿勋、立法院长孙科、行政院长汪精卫、孔祥熙博士等人已当选为筹备委员会委员，负责安排追悼事宜。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

上海总工会会议

上海总工会执行委员会第二次会议于昨日举行，由李龙南主持。会议决定成立“工友军事训练班”，由该会委员朱学范、周起葵和李华负责。

《新闻报》（南京电通社）：

新任英国公使将于3月6日呈递国书

外交部已获得国民政府主席批准，同意新任驻华英国公使亚历山大·卡多根爵士（Sir Alexander Cadogan）于3月6日上午11时呈递国书。

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

The Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement
Committee yesterday sent a letter to the House-Owners
Association requesting that the rent reduction be
affected at an early date, because the prosperity of
Shanghai depends upon the reduction. A circular notice
relating to measures for a reduction in house rentals
was attached to the letter.

Meeting of the Chapei District Rent Reduction
Movement Committee.

At a meeting held at 2 p.m. yesterday by
the Standing Committee of the Chapei District Rent
Reduction Movement Committee, the following resolutions
were passed:-
1. That the Organization Department detail officials
to direct the affairs of the Yien Foh Li (頤福里)
alleyway Unit of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement
Committee.
2. That the Organization Department issue a seal
to the Iah Yang Jao (大洋桥) Sub-Committee recently
inaugurated.
3. That, regarding the reports from Wong Wei-en
(王維恩) of the Hshun Foong (運丰) Shop at Hoong
Tseng (虹鎮) to the effect that the house owner is
oppressing the tenants and requesting immediate assistance,
a meeting of the Executive and the Supervisory Committees
be held to discuss the matter.
4. That the Secretariat despatch a letter to the
main committee requesting further supplies of propaganda
material.

The tenants of the San Ming Fong (三民坊)
and the Sin Ming Fong (新民坊) alleyways, Yangchow
Road, yesterday held a meeting at which units of the
Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee were formed.
Chia Chi-cheu (賈志秋) presided at the meeting and
representatives of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement
Committee were present.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That permission to join this Unit be given to the
tenants of the Dah Tuh Li (大德里) and the Siang An
Li (相安里) alleyways.
2. That measures for a rent reduction drawn up by
the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee be

(曹志秋) and three others be elected committeemen of

1934年3月2日。晨间译件。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动。

上海减租运动委员会昨日致函业主联合会，请求尽早实施减租，因为上海的繁荣取决于减租。随信附有一份关于降低房屋租金措施的通告。

闸北区减租运动委员会会议。

闸北区减租运动委员会常务委员会于昨日下午2时举行会议，通过以下决议：-
1. 组织部派遣官员指导上海减租运动委员会颐福里分部的事务。
2. 组织部向最近成立的大洋桥分委员会颁发印章。
3. 关于虹镇运丰商店王维恩报告称业主压迫租户并请求立即援助一事，召开执行委员会和监察委员会会议讨论此事。
4. 秘书处致函总委员会，请求提供更多宣传材料。

昨日，扬州路三民坊和新民坊的租户举行会议，成立了上海减租运动委员会的分部。贾志秋主持会议，上海减租运动委员会的代表出席了会议。
通过以下决议：-
1. 允许大德里和相安里的租户加入本分部。
2. 遵守上海减租运动委员会制定的减租措施。
3. 选举陆芝馨、曹志秋等三人为本分部委员。
