February 28, 1934. Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

There are over 20 houses in Soo Sung Li Alleyway
(沙遜里), Shantung Road. The houses are the property
of Sassoon Company and were built in the 11th Year of
the Republic of China.
At 2 p.m. yesterday the tenants of the alleyway
held a meeting at which representatives from the Shanghai
House Rent Reduction Movement Committee and the 14th
Branch of the Shanghai House Rent Reduction Movement
Committee were present. After discussion the following
resolutions were passed :-
1. That a unit of the Shanghai House Rent Reduction
Movement Committee be formed and that the unit be
registered with the superior organs.
2. That a joint letter be addressed to the landlord
requesting that 10% of the present rent be reduced.
3. That the Shantung Road Branch of the Shanghai House
Rent Reduction Movement Committee be requested to
render assistance.
4. That in case of necessity Legal Advisors be engaged.

Yesterday the tenants of the houses on Kin Loong
Kar (金隆街), Tar Keu Jao (帶鉤橋), Shantung Road,
held a meeting at the Yu Chuen (裕川) Shop, Kin Loong Kar.
Members from the Shanghai House Rent Reduction Movement
Committee and the 14th Branch of the latter Committee
attended. After discussion it was decided that
a unit of the Shanghai House Rent Reduction Movement
Committee be formed.

The houses in the Markham Li Alleyway (麥根里)
off Markham Road belong to Credit Foncier d'Extreme-Orient
and number about 160. The tenants are mostly of
coolie class and many of them are unemployed as a result
of the late Sino-Japanese hostilities.
Commencing from August of last year, the landlord
notified the tenants to pay $2 per month for water charges,
but the tenants opposed this measure. The dispute
was finally settled by the law court which gave a verdict
in favour of the tenants.
Yesterday the tenants again received a notification
from the landlord, stating that unless the water charges
in arrears amounting to $10 per house were paid within 20 hours,
the water supply would be disconnected and the law court
would be requested to permit the eviction of the tenants who
failed to pay the arrears.
Upon receipt of the notice, the tenants decided
to convoke a meeting of their representatives for the
purpose of devising ways and means of dealing with the
situation.

1934年2月28日。晨间译件。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动

山东路沙逊里有房屋20余幢。这些房屋属沙逊洋行所有，建于民国十一年。
昨日下午2时，该里弄租户举行会议，上海房屋减租运动委员会代表及该委员会第十四支会代表出席。经讨论，通过以下决议：-
1. 成立上海房屋减租运动委员会分部，并向上级机关登记。
2. 联名致函房东，要求将现有租金减少10%。
3. 请求上海房屋减租运动委员会山东路支会提供协助。
4. 如有必要，聘请法律顾问。

昨日，山东路带钩桥金隆街的住户在金隆街裕川商店举行会议。上海房屋减租运动委员会成员及该委员会第十四支会成员出席。经讨论，决定成立上海房屋减租运动委员会分部。

麦根路麦根里的房屋属于东方汇理银行（Credit Foncier d'Extreme-Orient），约有160幢。租户多为苦力阶层，其中许多人因近期的中日战事而失业。
自去年8月起，房东通知租户每月缴纳2元水费，但租户反对这一措施。纠纷最终由法院解决，判决有利于租户。
昨日，租户再次收到房东通知，称除非在20小时内付清每户拖欠的10元水费，否则将切断供水，并请求法院准许驱逐欠费租户。
收到通知后，租户决定召开代表会议，以商讨应对局势的办法。

February 27, 1934.    Morning Translation

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

Yesterday the Chapei Rent Reduction Movement
Committee held a meeting and after discussion the following
resolutions were adopted:-
1) That the committee be designated "The Chapei
District Committee of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement
Committee."
2) That the regulations governing the formation
of the district committee containing 14 articles be approved
and printed.
Before the meeting dissolved, Lawyers Chow
Yung-ting (周永定), Sun Shiac-tsiang (沈孝祥) and Tu Cho-
ming (杜作民) explained the status of the committee from
the legal point of view and offered advice as to the manner
in which the movement was to be conducted.

A meeting of the tenants of the Teh An Li Alley-
way (德安里), North Soochow Road, took place yesterday
at the premises of the Jen Tze Primary School (仁慈小学).
A unit of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee was
formed and the following resolutions were passed:-
1) That opposition be offered by all the tenants
to the demand of the landlord that they should remove from
the premises.
2) That in the event of litigation arising from
disputes between the tenants and the landlord, the situation
be dealt with by all the tenants.
3) That should any tenant be found opposing the
rent reduction movement, he will be considered as a public
enemy and dealt with accordingly.
4; That Ich Yung-tang (陸榮棠) and ten others be
elected to serve on the committee of the unit.
5) That two committee members attend the office
every day.

Considering that the rents are too high, the
tenants of the Chiun Yang Li Alleyway (春陽里) and of
business premises in the vicinity of East Yuhang and
Yochow Roads some time ago convened a meeting and a unit
of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee was formed.
Yesterday representatives of the unit proceeded
to the office of the 5th Branch of the First Special
District Citizens Federation and applied for registration.

Some time ago, the property of a number of
tenants of the Si Cheng Li Alleyway (西成里), Rue Brenier
de Lontmorand, French Concession, was sealed up by the law
court at the request of the landlord. All the tenants were
enraged at the action and later formed a unit of the
Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee to deal with the
landlord.
Yesterday the unit issued a manifesto setting
forth acts of oppression by the landlord and soliciting
assistance from the people and in addition circulated a
notification to all the tenants regarding the measures for
a reduction in rent.

1934年2月27日。    晨间译件

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动

昨日，闸北减租运动委员会举行会议，经讨论通过以下决议：-
1) 将该委员会定名为“上海减租运动委员会闸北区委员会”。
2) 批准并印发包含14条条款的区委员会组建章程。
会议结束前，律师周永定、沈孝祥和杜作明从法律角度解释了委员会的地位，并就如何开展运动提供了建议。

昨日，北苏州路德安里的租户在仁慈小学 premises 举行会议。成立了上海减租运动委员会分部，并通过以下决议：-
1) 全体租户反对房东提出的搬离要求。
2) 若租户与房东之间发生诉讼纠纷，由全体租户共同应对。
3) 如发现任何租户反对减租运动，将其视为公敌并予以相应处理。
4) 选举陆荣棠等十一人为分部委员。
5) 每日派两名委员到办事处值班。

鉴于租金过高，春阳里及余杭路和扬州路附近商铺的租户此前曾召开会议，成立了上海减租运动委员会分部。
昨日，该分部代表前往第一特区市民联合会第五分会办事处申请登记。

此前，法租界白莱尼蒙马浪路（Rue Brenier de Lontmorand）西成里部分租户的财产应房东请求被法院查封。所有租户对此行动感到愤怒，随后成立了上海减租运动委员会分部以对付房东。
昨日，该分部发表宣言，列举房东的压迫行为，呼吁民众援助，并向所有租户 circulated 了一份关于减租措施的通知。

With a view to obtaining full control of the
postal administration, the Ministry of Communications
has ordered the various people's letters delivery
concerns throughout the country to close within one year.
According to an official of a local "letter
delivery bureau", the letters delivery trade has sent
a joint petition to the Authorities requesting them to
cancel the order.

RAILWAY STATION MASTER ASSAULTED
On February 24, the employees of the Nan
Ziang Railway Station sent a report to the Ministry of
Railways, the various Tangpu and the various newspaper
offices stating that Koo Ker Cheng(顾子成), station
master at Quinsan Railway Station, had been seriously
assaulted by soldiers. The Authorities were
requested to punish the assailants.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

Yesterday the Shanghai Schools Rent Reduction
Movement Committee sent the following letter to Mayor
Wu Te-chen :
"As a result of world depression and national
rural bankruptcy, the Shanghai market has been greatly
affected, and the 3,000,000 citizens are suffering
hardships. The prices of materials have been
lowered, but the house rent increases day by day.
The greater part of the income of the citizens goes
towards paying the high house rent. Therefore
following the inauguration of the rent reduction
movement, the residents throughout Shanghai have joined
the movement.
"About one thousand schools in Shanghai
rent premises. The headmasters are unable to extend
their work in consequence of the high rentals.
Education is a social necessity and it is essential
that the rents of schools premises be reduced."

昨日，上海学校减租运动委员会向市长吴铁城发出如下信函：
“由于世界经济萧条及国内农村破产，上海市场受到极大影响，三百万市民生活困苦。物价虽已下跌，但房租却日益上涨。市民收入的大部分用于支付高昂的房租。因此，自减租运动发起以来，上海各地居民纷纷加入该运动。

Date 25 / 2 / 34

February 25, 1934.    Morning Translation

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

The Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee
yesterday despatched the following letter to its
Legal Advisors Group:-
"To discuss legal procedure in connection with
the rent reduction movement, a meeting of the Legal
Advisors Group is to be held at 2 p.m. February 26
at which members are requested to be present."
The Committee yesterday distributed booklets
entitled "Explanation of Rent Reduction Measures" to
various branches of the Committee. The book contains
the following statements:-
1. That the rents be reduced in accordance with
the scales already approved.
2. That the reduction in house rentals be enforced
for four years, because consequent upon the January 28
War, trades have suffered depression and it is feared
that trade will be restored to normal conditions only
after a period of four years.
3. The lunar calendar has been abolished
by the Chinese Government. Therefore, the rents should
be paid monthly according to the solar calendar.
4. That municipal rates remain as before, because
these rates are used for municipal reconstruction and
the protection of citizens and therefore, they cannot
be reduced.

Meeting of the Citizens Federation.

About 20 persons attended a meeting held
yesterday by the 7th District Branch of the First Special
District Citizens Federation. The following resolutions
were passed:-
1. That in compliance with the request of citizens
in various alleyways and terraces of this district,
units of the Branch be formed.
2. That regarding the prosecution instituted by the
owner of houses in the Wei San Li (山里) alleyway,
Wayside District, against the tenants for non-payment
of rent, officials be detailed to make an investigation.
3. That citizens of this district be notified to
adopt from January the measures for rent reduction drawn
up by the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee,
and that in the event of the house owner refusing to
accept the reduced rents, the money be deposited in a
bank.

At a meeting held by about 60 residents of the
Markham Li (麥根里) alleyway on Markham Road, it was
resolved to organize a Preparatory Committee of the
Markham Li Alleyway Unit of the First Special District
of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee. Chang
Zai-tong and 6 others were appointed members of the
Preparatory Committee. A petition was submitted yesterday
to the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee for

1934年2月25日。上午译文

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动

上海减租运动委员会昨日向其法律顾问组发出如下信函：
“为讨论与减租运动相关的法律程序，定于2月26日下午2时召开法律顾问组会议，请各位成员出席。”
委员会昨日向各分支委员会分发了题为《减租办法说明》的小册子。书中包含以下声明：
1. 租金应按照已批准的等级进行减免。
2. 房屋租金减免执行期为四年，因为受一·二八事变影响，商业遭受萧条，预计贸易需四年时间才能恢复正常状况。
3. 中国政府已废除农历。因此，租金应按阳历按月支付。
4. 市政捐税维持原状，因为这些税款用于市政重建和保护市民，故不能减免。

市民联合会会议。

约20人参加了昨日举行的第一特区市民联合会第七分部会议。通过下列决议：
1. 应本区各里弄及街坊市民的要求，成立分部下属各单位。
2. 关于西区卫山里（Wei San Li，音译）巷弄房东因租户欠租而提起的诉讼，指派官员进行调查。
3. 通知本区市民自一月起采用上海减租运动委员会制定的减租办法，若房东拒绝接受减后的租金，则将款项存入银行。

在麦根路（Markham Road）麦根里（Markham Li，音译）巷弄约60名居民举行的会议上，决定组织上海减租运动委员会第一特区麦根里巷弄单位筹备委员会。张在通（Chang Zai-tong，音译）等六人被任命为筹备委员会委员。昨日已向上海减租运动委员会提交请愿书备案。

February 24, 1934. Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

MEETING OF THE SHANGHAI FIRST SPECIAL DISTRICT
RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT COMMITTEE.

At a meeting held at 3 p.m. yesterday by
the Standing Committee of the Shanghai First Special
District Rent Reduction Movement Committee, about 20
persons, including Yih Chi-chong (葉其昌), Wong Hoong-
hwei (王鴻輝) and Chen Kiu-foong (陳九峰), were
present and the following resolutions were passed:-
1. That, regarding the letter from the 10th Branch
to the effect that water rates for houses in the Yang
Shih Fong (養施坊) alleyway has been increased, a
letter of protest be sent to Algar & Co.
2. That the public in this District be informed
of the measures for rent reduction and units are to be
established by various alleyways and registered with
the Branch concerned.
3. That in reply to the letter from the 7th Branch
reporting an increase in water rates in houses in the
Loong Chung Li (同春里) alleyway, a letter of protest
be sent to the Doong Chong (同昌) Rent Collection
Office.
4. That a notice be issued to branches of this
District requesting residents of various alleyways to
complete the formation of units within two weeks.
5. That regarding the report from the 9th Branch,
a letter be sent to the owner of houses in the Ziang
Shing Li (祥鑫里) alleyway with the request that
the demolition of the houses be postponed and another
letter be addressed to the Shanghai Municipal Council
requesting that no demolition licence be issued.
6. That a general meeting of residents in this
District be held.
7. That regarding the sealing up of houses in the
Sie Chen Li (西成里) alleyway by the house owner,
a letter be sent to the Shanghai Second Special District
Rent Reduction Movement Committee requesting assistance.

Meeting of Principals of Local Schools.

At a meeting held yesterday by the Shanghai
Schools Rent Reduction Movement Committee in the premises
of the Shanghai Educational Association, the following
resolutions were passed:-
1. That a letter be addressed to Mayor Wu Te-chen
asking his opinion of the rent reduction movement.
2. That various schools in the Second Special District,
at Nantao and Chapei be asked to form rent reduction
movement committees.
3. That the House Owners Association be requested
by letter to notify the owners of premises of various
schools to voluntarily grant a reduction in the rents
of school premises.

2. 向本区公众宣传减租办法，由各里弄成立单位并向相关分部登记。

2. 请第二特区、南市及闸北的各学校成立减租运动委员会。
3. 致函业主协会，请其通知各学校校舍业主自愿减免学校校舍租金。

February 24, 1934.    Morning Translation.

（批：D 3482/3）

Yesterday a petition was submitted by the
Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee to the local
Tangpu, the Bureau of Social Affairs and various law
courts, which reads as follows:-
"Since the 28th January Incident, the market
has become depressed and unemployment has been on the
increase. It is hard to foretell what calamity will
befall the people in this city should conditions
continue as they are now.
"Of all remedies for the present precarious
situation, rent reduction is considered the most
efficacious.
"The relationship between landlord and tenant
should be friendly for one's misfortune is the other's
misfortune. There are, however, a few landlords who
disregard the interests of the people during the present
period of acute depression and increase the rents. If
the increase is not paid, they request the law court to
seal up property or serve notice to the tenants to
remove.
"Of 3,000,000 people in this city, nearly 80
percent of them are tenants. These people are hardly
able to pay for their clothes and food. How can they
pay high rents? Hard pressed, a number of people have
become bankrupts and in some cases have committed suicide.
"This Committee was inaugurated in compliance
with the request of the people and was sponsored by
various legal public organizations. It has been registered
with the local Tangpu.
"At a meeting of representatives of all public
organizations, measures to secure a reduction in rent
have been drawn up and a resolution has been passed that
Municipal Rates remain as before and landlords pay Muni-
cipal Rates on all vacant houses.
"We would request you to enforce the resolution
and to forbid landlords from demolishing the houses or
increasing the rents."

The following notification was issued yesterday by
the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement to the people of
Shanghai:-
"All tenants should pay rents in accordance with the
following measures approved at a meeting of representatives
of various public organizations:-
1) Reduction to be enforced from January 1934.
2) Should landlords refuse to accept the reduced rents,
the sums are to be deposited in banks.
3) Tenants who have owed rents for the last year should
clear off the arrears in instalments within a period of one year.
4) Tenants and sub-tenants are to be accorded equal
treatment in rent reduction.
5) Scales of reduction:-
10% reduction on rental for houses built before 1924.
20% " " " " " " 1925 to 1927.
30% " " " " " " 1928 to 1930.
40% " " " " " " between 1931 and
1933.

1934年2月24日。上午译文

（批：D 3482/3）

昨日，上海减租运动委员会向本地各塘浦、社会局及各法院提交请愿书，内容如下：
“自一·二八事变以来，市场萧条，失业人数增加。若现状持续，难以预料本市人民将遭遇何种灾难。
在应对当前危急局势的所有补救措施中，减租被认为是最有效的。
房东与房客的关系应当友好，因为一方的不幸即是另一方的不幸。然而，有少数房东在当前严重萧条时期不顾民众利益，增加租金。若不支付增加的租金，他们便请求法院查封财产或通知租户搬离。
本市三百万人口中，近百分之八十是租户。这些人几乎无力支付衣食费用。他们如何能支付高昂的租金？在重压之下，许多人破产，甚至有人自杀。
本委员会顺应民众要求而成立，并由各法律公共团体赞助。已在本地塘浦登记。
在各公共团体代表会议上，制定了确保减租的措施，并通过决议：市政捐税维持原状，房东须为所有空置房屋缴纳市政捐税。
恳请阁下执行该决议，并禁止房东拆除房屋或增加租金。”

上海减租运动委员会昨日向上海市民发布如下通告：
“所有租户应按照各公共团体代表会议批准的下列办法支付租金：
1) 减租自1934年1月起执行。
2) 若房东拒绝接受减后的租金，款项应存入银行。
3) 去年欠租的租户应在一年内分期还清欠款。
4) 租户与转租户在减租方面享有同等待遇。
5) 减租等级：
1924年以前建造的房屋，租金减免10%。
1925年至1927年建造的房屋，租金减免20%。
1928年至1930年建造的房屋，租金减免30%。
1931年至1933年间建造的房屋，租金减免40%。”

February 23, 1934. Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

Yesterday a meeting of the Executive Committee
of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee took place
at 2 p.m. at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, North Soochow
Road. Some 20 members were present and Chang Yee Fang (張賢芳)
presided. After discussion, the following resolutions were
passed:-
1) That rents be paid in accordance with the scales
of reduction passed at the Second Meeting of representatives
of tenants, reduction to be enforced from January 1934. In
case landlords refuse to accept reduced rents, the sums should
be deposited in a bank.
2) That a notice to this effect be inserted in the
press for the information of all the tenants.
3) That a report be made to the Administrative, Party
and Judicial Organs.
4) That regarding rents owed by tenants for last year
payment be made by instalment.
5) That tenants and sub-tenants be treated equally.
6) That a warning be issued in case a committee
member fails to attend committee meetings.
7) That regarding the letter from the Chapei Rent
Reduction Movement Committee requesting approval to the change
of the name of the Committee to "The Shanghai Northern District
Rent Reduction Movement Committee," the former designation
be retained.
8) That a reply be given together with copies of
regulations to the . . Chamber of Commerce of Chu Chi
(諸暨), Chekiang.
9) That a letter be addressed to the Hung Mo: Company
(鴻懋公司), owners of the Tsiang Shin Li Alleyway (祥鑫里),
Tatung Road, requesting them to postpone the demolition of
the houses and the First Special District Citizens Federation
be requested to write to the Shanghai Municipal Council asking
the Municipal authorities to prevent the owners from demolishing
the houses.
10) That a letter be addressed to the Chien Yu Rent
Collection Office concerning a reduction in rents for the
houses in the Chien Yu Kang Alleyway (建康坊), Small North
Gate.
11) That a letter be sent to Algar & Company, owners
of the Yang Tze Fang Alleyway (養慈坊), Yochow Road, concerning
an increase in water rate.

Yesterday a notification was issued by the First
Special District Citizens Federation informing its branches
that all rent investigation forms which are to be filled in
by tenants are to be distributed and collected by the Rent
Reduction Movement Committee and that Yu Zung Yee (虞仲威),
a member of the Rent Reduction Movement Committee, will be
publicly reprimanded for falsely using the name of a sub-
committee of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee.

1934年2月23日。晨间译件。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动

昨日，上海减租运动委员会执行委员会于下午2时在苏州北路中国商会举行会议。约20名委员出席，由张贤芳主持。经讨论，通过以下决议：-
1) 租金应按照租户代表第二次会议通过的减租标准支付，减租自1934年1月起实施。若房东拒绝接受减后的租金，应将款项存入银行。
2) 在报刊上刊登以此为目的的通告，以便全体租户知悉。
3) 向行政、党部和司法机关提交报告。
4) 关于租户去年所欠租金，应分期支付。
5) 租户与二房东应受到平等待遇。
6) 若委员会委员未能出席委员会会议，应发出警告。
7) 关于闸北减租运动委员会来信请求批准将委员会名称改为“上海北区减租运动委员会”一事，决定保留原名称。
8) 向浙江诸暨（Chu Chi）(音译) 商会复函，并附寄规章副本。
9) 致函大同路祥鑫里（Tsiang Shin Li）(音译) 的业主鸿懋公司，要求其推迟拆除房屋；并请第一特区市民联合会致函上海工部局，请求市政当局阻止业主拆除房屋。
10) 致函小北门建康坊（Chien Yu Kang）(音译) 的建业收租处，要求降低该弄堂房屋的租金。
11) 致函扬州路养慈坊（Yang Tze Fang）(音译) 的业主阿尔加公司（Algar & Company），交涉水费上涨事宜。

昨日，第一特区市民联合会发布通知，告知其各分会，所有需由租户填写的租金调查表均由减租运动委员会分发和收集；减租运动委员会委员虞仲威因冒用上海减租运动委员会下属分会名义，将受到公开谴责。

February 23, 1934. Morning Translation.

D 3482
Austin

The Hankow Road and Shensi Road Rent Reduction Movement Sub-Committee yesterday distributed rent investigatic forms to the tenants in the district. The forms will be returned to the sub-committee within three days.

At a meeting held by the tenants of East and West Kwang Foh Li Alleyways(东西廣福里), King Zer Li Alleyway (金寿里), Poo Ching Faung Alleyway (普慶坊) and Dong Tuh Li Alleyway (同德里)in Canton Road, the following resolutions were passed :-
1. That units of the Shanghai House Rent Reduction Movement Committee be formally established.
2. That members be appointed to manage the affairs of the units.
3. That a manifesto be issued.
4. That the landlords be requested to reduce the rentals in accordance with the scale approved by the Shanghai House Rent Reduction Movement Committee.
5. That all rents be deposited at a bank pending a settlement of the dispute.
6. That the tenants be instructed not to pay rents privately to the landlords.
7. That the units be registered at the Shanghai House Rent Reduction Movement Committee through the 11th Branch of the Committee.

General Sun Chuan Fan, former Commander-in-Chief of the Five Province Federal Army, is the owner of some 200 houses in Si Chen Li (西城里), Rue Brenier de Montmorand, French Concession. The Yi Pin Bank (義品銀行) controlled the leasing of the houses.
Recently, General Sun found that there were 13 tenants who had not paid rentals for 2 or 3 months. These tenants were not warned but their houses were sealed up by the Court. This procedure aroused the indignation of the other 200 tenants in the terrace, who organized a Tenants Federation to oppose the landlord. Lawyer Wu Kai Seng was retained.
Yesterday a number of the tenants in the terrace received a warning from the owner intimating that their houses would be sealed up. The tenants intend to issue a manifesto to denounce General Sun and to solicit help from the public.

At 3 p.m. yesterday the Chapei Rent Reduction Movement Committee held a meeting at which Yu Lai Kan(游南崗) presided. The following resolutions were passed :-
1. That the Hung Tseng (虹鎮) and Tah Yang Jao (大陽桥) Branches be permitted to register with the Committee.
2. That the Public Safety Bureau be notified regarding white banners bearing slogans on the rent reduction movement which will be displayed on Paakhan Road, Tatung Road and Hung Foong Road.
3. That Lawyers Chou Shia An (周芝庵) and Sung Shiao Ziang (沈孝祥) be retained as Legal Advisors of the Committee.
4. That a joint meeting the Legal Advisors Group, the Executive Committee and the Control Committee be convened.

D 3482
奥斯汀

汉口路与陕西路减租运动分会昨日向该区租户分发了租金调查表。表格将在三天内交回分会。

在广东路东西广福里、金寿里、普庆坊和同德里的租户举行的会议上，通过了以下决议：-
1. 正式成立上海住房减租运动委员会的各分部。
2. 任命人员管理各分部事务。
3. 发表宣言。
4. 要求房东按照上海住房减租运动委员会批准的标准降低租金。
5. 在纠纷解决之前，所有租金存入银行。
6. 指示租户不得私下向房东支付租金。
7. 各分部通过委员会第十一支会向上海住房减租运动委员会注册。

前五省联军总司令孙传芳将军是法租界孟莫兰路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）西城里约200栋房屋的业主。义品银行控制着这些房屋的租赁。
最近，孙将军发现有13名租户已两三个月未付租金。这些租户未受警告，但其房屋被法院查封。这一程序激起了该里弄其他200名租户的愤慨，他们组织了租户联合会以反对房东。聘请了律师吴凯声。
昨日，该里弄的一些租户收到业主的警告，暗示他们的房屋将被查封。租户打算发表宣言谴责孙将军，并向公众寻求帮助。

昨日下午3时，闸北减租运动委员会举行会议，由游南岗主持。通过以下决议：-
1. 准许虹镇和大阳桥(音译) 支会向本委员会注册。
2. 就将在白克路、大同路和鸿丰路(音译) 展示的带有减租运动标语的白色横幅一事，通知公安局。
3. 聘请周芝庵和沈孝祥(音译) 律师担任委员会法律顾问。
4. 召开法律顾问组、执行委员会和监察委员会联席会议。

meeting of the Executive Committee of the 21st Branch

Sub-Committee of the 7th Branch of the First Special
District Citizens Federation has been established. The
tenants of Pah Foh Li (百福里), San Zer Li (山德里),
Yoong Zung Li(永成里) and Pah Loh Faung (百祿坊) on
Broadway have formed four units of that sub-committee.

The tenants of the Si Cheng Li Alleyway(西成里),
Rue Brenier de Montmorand, French Concession, held a
meeting yesterday at 3 p.m. at the premises of the 4th
Branch of the Second Special District Citizens Federation
on Rue Eugene Bard, at which about 100 persons were present.
After discussion, the following resolutions were passed:-
1) That a unit of the Second Special District
Rent Reduction Movement Committee be organised.
2) That Ko Shun Chee (柯申池) and ten others be
nominated officers of the unit.
3) That a manifesto giving details of the oppression
of the landlord be issued.
4) That all illegal lease contracts be cancelled
and notice be issued to all the tenants not to sign any
further contracts or to pay rents.
5) That a letter be addressed to the landlord
repudiating the lease contract and asking him to reduce
the rents in accordance with the scales passed by the
Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee.
6) That in case of a dispute arising, a petition
be presented to the Administrative and Party authorities.
7) That all rents be deposited with the Continental
Bank pending a settlement of the dispute.
8) That Lawyer Wu Kai-shin (吳凱聲) be engaged
as legal adviser to the unit and a counter action be
brought against the landlord for damages resulting from
the sealing up of property by the law court at the instance
of the landlord.
9) That a covenant be signed by all the tenants.
10) That a demand be presented to the landlord for
the dismissal of the present rent collector.

减租运动

上海减租运动委员会执行委员会将于今日下午3时举行会议。

继第一特区市民联合会第二十一支会执行委员会第二次会议通过决议后，汉口路与山西路住房减租分会于昨日正式成立。新分会办事处位于汉口路356号。许荣辉、李樸山、王志甫和毛英伯被提名为该分会在上海减租运动委员会的代表。

第一特区市民联合会第七支会的百老汇减租运动分会已成立。百老汇路上的百福里、山德里、永成里和百祿坊(音译) 的租户组成了该分会的四个分部。

法租界孟莫兰路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）西成里的租户于昨日下午3时在尤金·巴德路（Rue Eugene Bard）第二特区市民联合会第四支会址举行会议，约有100人出席。经讨论，通过以下决议：-

2) 提名柯申池(音译) 等十人为分部干事。
3) 发表详细揭露房东压迫行为的宣言。
4) 取消所有非法租赁合同，并通知所有租户不再签署任何新合同或支付租金。

6) 若发生纠纷，向行政和党部当局请愿。
7) 在纠纷解决之前，所有租金存入大陆银行。
8) 聘请吴凯声律师为分部法律顾问，并就房东申请法院查封财产所造成的损失，对房东提起反诉。
9) 所有租户签署公约。
10) 向房东提出要求，解雇现任收租员。

February 21, 1934. 2 Afternoon Translation.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

B.A.T. FACTORY REFUSES TO ISSUE SCHOOL ALLOWANCE.

Owing to the refusal on the part of the British
American Tobacco Factory, Pootung, to issue allowance in
arrears for the months of August and September 1933 and
for the spring term 1934, the school for children of
workers of the Factory cannot carry on normal operations.
The B.A.T. Factory Workers Union has appealed to the Bureau
of Education and the Bureau of Social Affairs.
Deputies of the Shanghai City Government and the
Bureau of Education have been sent to make an investigation
and to persuade the Factory authorities to issue allowance
to the school forthwith.

Sin Wen Poo and other local newspapers :

MEETING OF SILVER-SMITHS

With reference to the "go-slow" strike of local
silver-smiths as a protest against a reduction of wages,
the strikers held a meeting yesterday at which the
following resolutions were passed:-
1. That members of the "Go-slow Strike Committee" be
urged to accelerate their activities.
2. That three representatives be sent to attend the
mediation meeting to be held on February 23 under the
auspices of the Bureau of Social Affairs.
3. That another meeting be called for February 26.
4. That a letter be addressed to Yuen Ang Fong (宋杏芳)
refusing his request that his employees should resume
work.

C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3482
Date 20 / 2 / 34

February 20, 1934. Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

The Executive Committee of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee will hold the third meeting at 2 p.m. Thursday February 22, at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. A notification has already been issued to the members.

The Frist Special District Citizens Federation will hold the 9th meeting of the Executive Committee at 2 p.m. to-morrow, while the First Special District House Rent Reduction Movement Committee will convene the first meeting of the Executive Committee at 2 p.m. Feb. 23.

Some time ago, the various schools in the city formed a sub-committee of the Rent Reduction Movement Committee with an office in the premises of the Shanghai Educational Association.

The Si Cheng Li Alleyway (西成里), Rue Chapsal, French Concession, belongs to General Sun Shan Fang (孙传芳), a former Tuchun, and the rents were formerly collected by the Credit Foncier d'Extreme-Orient on his behalf. Since December last year, the rents have been collected by the I Yuan Company (义元公司). With a view to standing well with the landlord, the company sues every tenant who owes three months' rent.

At the end of the last lunar year, there were thirteen tenants who were unable to clear off the arrears and yesterday the property of these 13 tenants was sealed by the law court.

All the tenants of the alleyway became enraged at the action of the landlord and decided to organize a tenants association to deal with the situation. They are now applying to the Rent Reduction Movement Committee for assistance.

The houses in Son Tou Li Alleyway (三多里), Dah Chi Road, Nantao, are the property of the Lih Yih Land Estate Company (礼益地产公司). The rent for each house is $32 per month, excluding water and electric charges.

On January 31, the tenants wrote to the company requesting a reduction in the rent, but no reply has been received.

On February 16, the tenants held a meeting at which Chang Loong Hai (张龙海) presided. It was resolved that a unit of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee be formed and that 5 persons including Chang Loong Hai be appointed members of the unit. It was also decided to deposit the monthly rentals at the West Gate Branch of the Shanghai Commercial & Savings Bank pending a settlement of the question.

Lawyers Mai Ngoh Chang (梅鹤章) Wang Zung Kuan (汪永宽) and Wang Dah Ding (黄达平) have been retained as legal advisers of the unit.

减租运动

上海减租运动委员会执行委员会将于2月22日（星期四）下午2时在上海总商会举行第三次会议。通知已发给各委员。

第一特区市民联合会将于明日下午2时举行执行委员会第九次会议，而第一特区房屋减租运动委员会将于2月23日下午2时召开执行委员会第一次会议。

前一段时间，市内各学校组成了减租运动委员会的一个分会，办事处设在上海教育会会所内。

法租界霞飞路（Rue Chapsal）西成里（Si Cheng Li Alleyway）系前督军孙传芳将军（General Sun Shan Fang）的产业，租金以前由东方汇理银行（Credit Foncier d'Extreme-Orient）代为收取。自去年十二月起，租金由义元公司（I Yuan Company）收取。为了讨好房东，该公司对每一位欠租三个月的租户提起诉讼。

去年农历年底，有十三名租户无力清偿欠款，昨日这十三名租户的财产被法院查封。

里弄所有租户对房东的行为感到愤怒，决定组织租户协会以应对局势。他们现在正向减租运动委员会申请援助。

南市大池路（Dah Chi Road）三多里（Son Tou Li Alleyway）的房屋属礼益地产公司（Lih Yih Land Estate Company）所有。每栋房屋月租32元，不含水电费。

1月31日，租户致函该公司请求减租，但未获回复。

2月16日，租户举行会议，由张龙海（Chang Loong Hai）主持。会议决议成立上海减租运动委员会的一个分部，并任命张龙海等五人为分部成员。还决定在问题解决之前，将每月租金存入上海商业储蓄银行西门分行。

已聘请梅鹤章（Mai Ngoh Chang）、汪永宽（Wang Zung Kuan）和黄达平（Wang Dah Ding）律师担任该分部的法律顾问。

C. S. S. REGISTRY
No. D 3482
Date 19 / 2 / 34

February 19, 1934.    Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

Since the formation of the Shanghai Rent Reduction
Movement Committee, many tenants have applied for registration
and a number of foreign organizations including White Russian,
Indian & Japanese have also written to the Committee pledging
support and applying to participate in the movement. Even
British and American residents, who have the welfare of the
public at heart, have written encouraging the Committee.
It is ascertained that the Japanese Merchants
Association held a meeting at 3 p.m. yesterday at the Japanese
Residents Club. Rent reduction was discussed and a resolution
that a committee to study rent reduction be formed was passed.
Regarding the White Russian Association, it is learnt
that a meeting will be convoked to discuss the question of
rent reduction in a few days.

In the Special Districts, there are about 1,000
private schools and most of these schools are housed in
rented premises. As the rents are high, these schools find
it hard to extend their work. Yesterday these institutions
held a meeting and about 300 schools were represented. A
rent reduction sub-committee was formed and 23 persons
including Koo Yu Jen (戈友仁) and others were elected to
serve on the sub-committee and 7 persons including Ting Ngc
(丁鶴 ) and others were elected members of the Standing
Committee. Hsu Wei Ling (徐惠氏) and one other were nominated
to represent the sub-committee on the Shanghai Rent Reduction
Movement Committee.

At a meeting held yesterday by the 26th Sub-Committee
(Kiangsi Road) of the First Special District House Rent
Reduction Movement Committee the following resolutions were
passed:-
1) That a manifesto be issued.
2) That citizens be instructed to participate in the
rent reduction movement.
3) That handbills and leaflets regarding the rent
reduction movement be distributed.
4) That rent investigation forms be distributed.
5) That Wang Han Liang (王漢良) and Zing Teng San
(鄭東山) be nominated to direct the rent reduction movement.
6) That letters bearing on the rent reduction movement
addressed to the sub-committee be sent to : No. 71 Kiangsi
Road.

China Times and other local newspapers:

PUBLIC UTILITY BUREAU WILL REQUEST TENDERS FOR CONSTRUCTION
OF A WHARF

With the completion of the Administration Building in
the Civic Centre, further construction work will be undertaken.
The Civic Centre is near the Whangpoo River, but there is no
large wharf in the vicinity. Therefore, the various bureaux
of the City Government have decided to construct a wharf
and an advertisement will be issued by the Bureau of Public
Utility requesting tenders for the construction, which is
scheduled to commence at the beginning of next month.

1934年2月19日。上午译件。

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动

自上海减租运动委员会成立以来，许多租户申请登记，包括白俄、印度人和日本人在内的多个外籍团体也致函委员会，表示支持并申请参与该运动。甚至关心公共福利的英美居民也写信鼓励该委员会。

据悉，日本商工协会昨日下午3时在日本人俱乐部举行会议。会议讨论了减租问题，并通过决议成立一个研究减租问题的委员会。

关于白俄协会，获悉将在数日内召集会议讨论减租问题。

在各特区，约有1000所私立学校，其中大多数校舍均为租赁。由于租金高昂，这些学校难以扩展业务。昨日这些机构举行会议，约有300所学校派代表参加。会议成立了减租分会，选举戈友仁（Koo Yu Jen）等23人担任分会委员，并选举丁鶴（Ting Ngc）等7人担任常务委员。徐惠氏（Hsu Wei Ling）及另一人被提名为该分会在上海减租运动委员会的代表。

在第一特区房屋减租运动委员会江西路第二十六分会昨日举行的会议上，通过了以下决议：
1) 发表宣言。
2) 指示市民参与减租运动。
3) 分发有关减租运动的传单和小册子。
4) 分发租金调查表。
5) 提名王漢良（Wang Han Liang）和鄭東山（Zing Teng San）指导减租运动。
6) 凡寄给该分会的关于减租运动的信件，请寄至：江西路71号。

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

公用局将招标建造码头

随着市中心行政大楼的完工，将进一步开展建设工程。市中心靠近黄浦江，但附近没有大型码头。因此，市政府各局决定建造一座码头，公用局将刊登广告，征求建设投标，工程计划于下月初开始。

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

PREPARATIONS FOR DIRECT UNIVERSAL COMMUNICATION.

The Chinese National Telegraphic Bureau of the

SHANGHAI-CANTON-HONGKONG-PHILIPPINE ISLANDS AIR SERVICE
PROPOSED.

The Chinese National Aviation Corporation has
sent deputies to undertake negotiations for the establishment
of a Shanghai-Canton-Hongkong-Philippine Islands Air Line.

The Shun Pao publishes the following comment
in its extra issue:-

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

The people of the favoured classes are always
cunning, and can deal effectively with any movement
which affects their interests. For instance, the
recent rent reduction movement has spread throughout
Shanghai; those who possess estates feel that their
interests are at stake, and immediately, they begin
to protect their interests by suspending the construction
of new houses, thereby endangering the livelihood of
300,000 workers. These workers will naturally be
utilized to oppose the rent reduction movement, and
the Rent Reduction Movement Committee is faced with
a difficult problem. A dispute has now arisen between
the workers whose employment is threatened and the
Rent Reduction Committee, and the real estate owners
have withdrawn from the "battle-field".

Hoping to settle this dispute for the welfare
of the citizens, we, the spectators, express the
following opinions:-

It is common knowledge that the house rent in
Shanghai is higher than in other parts of the country;
and it is also a fact that the livelihood of local
citizens has been seriously affected by the world
economic depression and the Shanghai Sino-Japanese
hostilities. Hence, the rent reduction movement
receives general approval. For the sake of the
future of our three million local citizens, the
movement must continue. But, ignoring the general
situation, the local house owners have dexterously
used the masons and carpenters to oppose the movement.

At present, the most suitable measure to solve
this problem is to petition the City Government to
prevent the house owners from suspending construction
work, and the masons labour unions should be urged
and assisted by society to fight against the
suspension of work instead of against the rent reduction
movement.

《顺报》在其增刊中发表如下评论：

减租运动

特权阶层的人总是狡猾的，并能有效应对任何影响其利益的运动。例如，最近的减租运动已蔓延至整个上海；拥有地产的人感到他们的利益受到威胁，立即开始通过停止新建房屋来保护他们的利益，从而危及30万工人的生计。这些工人自然会被利用来反对减租运动，减租运动委员会面临着一个难题。现在，就业受到威胁的工人与减租委员会之间发生了争执，而房地产业主已退出“战场”。

希望为了市民的福祉解决这一争端，我们作为旁观者表达以下意见：

众所周知，上海的房租高于全国其他地区；而且，当地市民的生计受到世界经济萧条和上海中日敌对行动的严重影响，这也是事实。因此，减租运动得到普遍认可。为了我们三百万本地市民的未来，该运动必须继续。但是，本地房主无视总体形势，巧妙地利用泥瓦匠和木匠来反对该运动。

目前，解决这一问题最合适的措施是 petition 市政府，防止房主停止施工，并应 urged 和 assisted 社会促使泥瓦匠工会对抗停工，而不是对抗减租运动。

（批：D.2482）

MOVEMENTS OF NOTABLES

General Tai Chi, former Shanghai-Woosung
Garrison Commander left Hongkong on Feb.14 and arrived in
Shanghai on Feb.16. He left for Soochow by express train
at 3 p.m. yesterday to meet his wife and son there.

Sun Fo, President of the Legislative Yuan,
accompanied by Admiral Chen Shao-kwen, Liu Vec Tse, Vice
Minister of Industry and Fang Hsunh Pai, Vice Minister
of Home Affairs, arrived by train in Shanghai at 8 a.m.
yesterday.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

In consequence of the Sino-Japanese Hostilities
in Shanghai, business in Dah Yang Jiao, (大陽橋), Chapei,
has become very poor and a great number of stores have closed
down.
With a view to alleviating the burdens of the
residents, a meeting to discuss rent reduction was held
yesterday by tenants of the district at the Teh Hsin Feng
Alleyway. Some 100 persons attended. A number of
resolutions authorizing the formation of a sub-committee
of the Rent Reduction Movement Committee, the issue of a
manifesto, etc. were passed.

Sin Wen Pao and other local newspapers (Peiping telegram):

SINO-BRITISH NON-AGGRESSION PACT.

With reference to the report that the Chinese
Government and the British Government are about to conclude
a non-aggression pact, a spokesman of the British Legation
declares that the Legation has not yet received any report
about the matter. It is possible that after the arrival
in China of Sir Hugh Cadogan, new British Minister to China,
the Sino-British Non-Aggression Pact will be discussed
when the Sino-British Commercial Pact is revised.

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

COLLECTION OF LAND TAX.

The Shanghai City Government has decided to
commence the collection of land tax of the Fah Hwa (法華)
and Poo Soong (蒲淞) Districts from March 1, as the Bureau
of Land has already completed the assessment of the land
values in these two districts.

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

With reference to the activities of the Rent
Reduction Movement Committee, about 300,000 handbills
bearing slogans on the movement were distributed and
posted yesterday. The following are some of the slogans:-
1. To promote the prosperity of Shanghai, rents
must be reduced.
2. 3,000,000 people in Shanghai are supporting
the rent reduction movement.
3. To maintain the people's livelihood, a reduction
in rents is necessary.
4. To reduce rents is to relieve the distress of
the people.

In connection with the rent reduction movement,
many foreign organizations have applied for participation.
The Russian Residents Association and the Japanese Merchants'
Association have already set up special committees to study
the question of rent reduction.
The Russian Residents Association has declared
that it will request a reduction in rent in accordance with
the measures proposed by the Chinese organizations; while
the Japanese Residents Association has decided to convene
a meeting on February 18 to discuss rent reduction.
Regarding the British and American residents,
as most of them are owners of houses, they hold an indiffi-
rent attitude towards the movement, but other foreign
organizations have expressed sympathy and are applying to
participate.

China Times (Comment):

PUBLIC SAFETY

Some days ago, an omnibus of the China General
Omnibus Company ran onto the pavement, damaged five rickshaws
and wounded four persons one of whom succumbed to his
injuries. The Municipal Police charged the driver with man-
slaughter through neglect of duty, but the driver argued that
when he found that the brake was not in order, he sent a
telephone message to his Company, but instead of changing the
car, the Company only despatched a fitter to repair the brake.
Whether the driver should be held responsible
for the accident or not will be left for the court to decide.
For the sake of public safety, we should pay attention to
the public utilities question. If an accident happens
through the fault of a driver or fitter, the Company should
still be held responsible.
Some time ago, a railless tram car was involved
in an accident when the floor board collapsed and injured
passengers. The Company is obviously responsible for that
accident.
Many accidents have occurred. If the law court
were to mete out severe punishment to guilty persons as a
warning, if the S.M.C. conducted a strict inspection of the car
before permission is given to operate them, and if the
residents protest strongly in connection with these accidents,
the street will not be so dangerous.

减租运动

关于减租运动委员会的活动，昨天分发并张贴了约30万份印有该运动标语的传单。部分标语如下：-
1. 为促进上海繁荣，必须减租。
2. 上海三百万民众支持减租运动。
3. 为维持民生，必须减租。
4. 减租即是缓解民众疾苦。

关于减租运动，许多外国组织已申请参与。俄国侨民协会和日本商人协会已设立特别委员会研究减租问题。
俄国侨民协会声明，将按照中国组织提出的措施要求减租；而日本侨民协会已决定于2月18日召开会议讨论减租事宜。
至于英美侨民，由于大多数人拥有房产，他们对该运动持冷漠态度，但其他外国组织已表示同情并申请参与。

《时报》（评论）：

公共安全

日前，中华汽车公司的一辆公共汽车冲上人行道，撞坏五辆黄包车，致四人受伤，其中一人伤重不治。工部局警务处以玩忽职守致人死亡罪指控司机，但司机辩称，当他发现刹车失灵时，曾电话通知公司，但公司仅派修理工修理刹车，而未更换车辆。
司机是否应对事故负责，将由法庭裁决。为了公共安全起见，我们应关注公用事业问题。如果事故是因司机或修理工的过失造成，公司仍应承担责任。
前段时间，一辆无轨电车因地板塌陷发生事故，致使乘客受伤。公司显然对该事故负有责任。
事故频发。如果法庭严惩责任人以儆效尤，如果工部局在批准运营前对车辆进行严格检查，如果居民就这些事故强烈抗议，街道就不会如此危险。

February 13, 1934. Morning Translation

China Times:-

PROPOSED INCREASE IN RATES

Recently, the S.M.C. has attempted to increase the municipal rate on account of the increase of the educational grant issued to Chinese schools.
With regard to this matter, Chu Yu Chang (朱予蒼), yesterday sent the following letter to the Chinese Ratepayers Association of the International Settlement:-
"Shanghai has been seriously affected by the world depression and the January 28 Incident. Unexpectedly, on January 31, 1934, when the S.M.C. was discussing educational affairs, the Finance Department of the Council proposed that the municipal rate be increased 16% in order to facilitate the educational administration. The living conditions of the people are not considered.
"During the present rent reduction movement, can the municipal rate again be raised and the heavy burdens of the citizens be increased? If the proposal of the Finance Department of the S.M.C. be approved, it means that the dispute between the house owners and the tenants will become more complicated. So, the house owners should also take action although the rate is paid by the tenants alone.

DEAD BODY OF FOREIGNER DISCOVERED IN WHANGPOO RIVER

At 9.30 a.m. yesterday the Chinese Water Police discovered the dead body of a foreigner in the Whangpoo River.
The finger prints of the dead man revealed that he was a Russian named Korline Gingunshin(?) or Jingolsky and Police records show that he had 16 convictions.

MAINICHI

JAPANESE AUTHORITIES OPINION ON THE JAPANESE CONCESSION IN SOOCHOW

According to Chinese sources both the authorities of Kiangsu and Soochow sent a letter to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs at Nanking requesting the restoration of the Japanese Concession in Soochow to China, but the Japanese Government has not received any official letter from the Nanking Government.
A spokesman of the Japanese Foreign Office stated that the concession in question was obtained through the Sino-Japanese treaties of 1896 and 1897 and it was agreed that the concession could be restored after 30 years, and provided the concession was not then returned, the treaty would be valid for another 30 years.
February 2, 1926 was the date when the Peking Government should have applied for the restoration of the concession or the revision of the treaty but the Peking Government could not do so, owing to the advance of the revolutionary troops towards Peking. At present Japan will not return the concession.

JAPANESE ARRESTED

JAPANESE SENTENCED

Yesterday at the Japanese Consular Court the following Japanese were sentenced:- Y. Itashima 5 months for theft, S. Aoki, 6 months for fraud, L. Toriyama, 8 months for assault.

China Evening News and other local newspapers:
JAPANESE CONCESSION AT SOOCHOW.
Despite the fact that the Soochow Hsien Government recently submitted a demand for the retrocession of the Japanese Concession at Soochow, the Central Government has not yet taken up the matter with the Japanese authorities.
Information secured from diplomatic sources shows that the Japanese Concession at Soochow was established in 1896. According to the Peking Agreement concluded between China and Japan, the Concession rights will be withdrawn after thirty years, and if the two parties do not desire the retrocession of the Concession or a revision of the Agreement at the time of expiration, the Agreement will be effective for a further period of thirty years. It is now eight years since the Agreement expired (1926) and it is unlikely that the Japanese Concession will be returned to China at the present time.

After re-organization, the Central Government will dispatch the 19th Route Army to Anhwei and Kiangsi to participate in the bandit-Communist suppression campaign. General Tai Chi will retire in Soochow in the near future.

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 7, 1934

Landlords Uneasy As Rent
Reduction Talk Grows

Chinese Schools Join Move Begun By Settlement
Tenants; Meetings By Several Co-operating
Groups Scheduled During The Week

The rental reduction movement, begun in a small way by Chinese tenants who claimed to have suffered from the 1932 hostilities and from the general depression, is daily gaining momentum, according to reports, and considerable uneasiness prevails among foreign and Chinese landlords and property owners, who are as yet unable to accurately gauge the strength which is behind the protests. Following the suit of the Chinese Real Estate Owners Association in meeting on Monday to consider the situation, it is learned that several foreign groups in the Settlement and the French Concession will also gather soon to view conditions and possibly to take some action.

At the meeting on Monday the Chinese property owners association passed resolutions to notify the Shanghai City Government of their decision to reject demands for reduced rentals, but on the other hand it was decided not to increase rentals. Representatives were assigned to attend the meeting of the Water Charges Research Committee of the Shanghai Municipal Council on Thursday. The Research Committee is composed of foreigners and Chinese.

Schools Join Movement

It was also learned yesterday that representatives from more than 60 Chinese middle schools decided to back the reduction movement after a meeting held on Monday. It was decided that rentals for school buildings should be withheld from the beginning of February pending a final settlement of the matter. Representatives from nine schools were elected to serve on a special committee which will co-operate with the Settlement Rental Reduction Committee. At a meeting called for to-morrow the principals of all the schools participating will meet with the committee to discuss further steps.

The Chapei committee, co-operating with the central organ, decided on further action at a meeting also held on Monday and attended by 20 representatives. It was decided to cancel all leases, to move for an equal relief for sub-tenants and to submit requests to the landlords for a reduction in rentals.

With meetings of the First Special District Citizens Federation, the Settlement Committee and other groups scheduled during the next two days, and with the S.M.C. meeting called for Thursday, it is expected that more accurate measurements of the amount of agitation will be available.

《字林西报》，1934年2月7日，星期三

随着减租呼声高涨，房东感到不安

中国学校加入由租界租户发起的运动；几个合作团体计划在本周举行会议

据报道，由中国租户发起的减租运动日益高涨，这些租户声称受到1932年战事和普遍经济萧条的影响。外国和中国房东及业主中普遍存在相当大的不安情绪，他们目前尚无法准确评估抗议活动背后的力量。继中国房地产业主协会周一开会审议局势之后，据悉，租界和法租界的几个外籍团体也将很快集会，审视情况并可能采取某些行动。

在周一的会议上，中国业主协会通过决议，通知上海市政府他们决定拒绝减租要求，但另一方面决定不增加租金。已指派代表参加周四上海工部局水费研究委员会的会议。该研究委员会由外籍人士和华人组成。

学校加入运动

另悉，六十多所中国中学的代表在周一举行会议后，决定支持减租运动。决定从二月初起扣留校舍租金，直至此事最终解决。选举九所学校的代表组成一个特别委员会，将与租界减租委员会合作。在定于明天召开的会议上，所有参与学校的校长将与委员会会面，讨论进一步步骤。

闸北委员会与中央机构合作，也在周一举行的会议上决定了进一步行动，有20名代表出席。决定取消所有租约，争取次承租人获得同等救济，并向房东提交减租请求。

鉴于第一特区市民联合会、租界委员会及其他团体的会议安排在未来两天内举行，且工部局会议定于周四召开，预计将对动荡程度有更准确的衡量。

February 7, 1934. Afternoon Translation

Lin Pao (Editorial):-

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

Consequent upon the present rent reduction movement, the Shanghai Real Estate Owners Association held a special meeting to discuss the situation. It was resolved that all members of the Association be notified not to construct any new buildings and that the Waterworks Company be requested to introduce a rule stipulating that the water charges be paid half by the house owners and half by the tenants. At the same time, the Water Rate Investigation Committee of the S.I.C., with a view to settling the water rate dispute, called a meeting of representatives of the Chinese and foreign real estate owners, and the difficult situation of the Shanghai tenants was explained to them. Lately, the house owners have endeavoured to evade the responsibility of providing water for the tenants.

The tenants have demanded a reduction in rents because of the present trade depression. However, the house owners maintain that high rentals have resulted from the increase of land value and the high cost of construction materials entailing only modest profits for the property owners. We know that the house owners at least make some profit from the rentals, otherwise they would be unable to pay the land tax, water rate, insurance fees and the interest on the money they borrow for construction purposes, but for the owners to demand high profits, during the present economic crisis is intolerable.

As a rule, the water rate is included in the rent. Formerly, 5% of rentals was appropriated for the payment of the water rate, but lately, the rate has increased. This rate is collected by the house owners from the tenants, and the owners pay the rates to the Waterworks Company. But do the house owners hand all the money for the water rate paid by the tenants to the Waterworks Company? House rents have increased, and consequently, the percentage for water rate has increased also. This is a question of doubt regarding the payment of the water rate.

The Waterworks Company is a commercial concern, and is certainly entitled to its profit. But the Company is also a public utility enterprise and investigations to ascertain the actual profit made by the Company would prove worthwhile. It is learned that the Waterworks Company has been extremely prosperous during the past few years, and the shares have increased in value. There is no reason for the Company to increase the profits. Regarding the advisability of installing water meters, a doubt also arises.

林宝（编辑）：

减租运动

鉴于当前的减租运动，上海房地产业主协会召开特别会议讨论局势。会议决议通知全体会员不得建造任何新楼房，并请求自来水公司制定规则，规定水费由房主和租户各承担一半。同时，工部局水价调查委员会为解决水价纠纷，召集了中外房地产业主代表开会，向他们解释了上海租户的困难处境。近来，房主们一直试图逃避为租户提供用水的责任。

租户因当前贸易萧条而要求降低租金。然而，房主们坚持认为，高租金是由于土地价值上涨和建筑材料成本高昂所致，这仅给业主带来微薄的利润。我们知道，房主至少从租金中获得了一些利润，否则他们将无法支付地税、水费、保险费以及为建房借款所产生的利息，但在当前的经济危机期间，业主索要高额利润是不可容忍的。

通常，水费包含在租金内。以前，租金的5%用于支付水费，但最近费率有所上涨。该费用由房主向租户收取，然后由房主支付给自来水公司。但是，房主是否将租户支付的所有水费都交给了自来水公司？房租上涨了，因此水费的百分比也随之增加。这是一个关于水费支付的疑点。

自来水公司是一家商业机构，当然有权获得利润。但该公司也是一家公用事业企业，进行调查以查明该公司的实际利润将是值得的。据悉，自来水公司在过去几年中极其繁荣，股票价值也有所上升。该公司没有理由增加利润。关于安装水表的适宜性，也产生了疑问。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 6, 1934
99-5

Agitation For Reduction Of
Rentals Is Increasing

Chinese Sponsoring Movement Busy Co-ordinating
Forces To Bring Pressure On Landlords;
District Bodies To Combine Efforts

Although the agitation by Chinese in Shanghai for reductions in house and shop rentals started in a small way, it has been steadily fostered until, to-day, it is assuming important if not dangerous proportions. Just what definite steps will be taken by those behind the movement to secure their objects is not yet clear, but the manner in which the agitation has spread within the last few days indicates that there is more than a spasmodic movement on the part of a considerable section of the Chinese community for some measure of relief from what they regard as unusually high rentals.

Claiming that the Sino-Japanese hostilities of 1932 caused heavy financial losses to a large section of the local community, loss of business and even considerable property, the Chinese who started the movement for lower house and shop rentals have secured considerable support from a wide section of their countrymen in all walks of life. The Shanghai First District Citizens' Federation is now lending support to the movement and instructions have been issued to various branches actively to co-operate in any general movement for securing lower rentals. These branches of the Citizens' Federation have taken the place of the former Street Unions which were responsible for the conduct of affairs in different city regions and which were held responsible for the welfare of Chinese residents in the respective districts. Many of these are now actively organizing their members for some sort of mass action against high rentals. Tenants have been circularized in these areas and forms have been sent out asking for particulars regarding ownership of property, rental charges, rates paid and other data regarding the letting and subletting of houses and shops. Chinese lawyers have been engaged by different districts and are now working on plans which are to be co-ordinated for use in the general movement when it commences.

No Definite Plans

So far there has been no indication as to the nature of the general movement or when it will commence, but it has been hinted that in an attempt to force landlords to lower their rents, tenants will be instructed to refuse payment until such time as adjustments are made in the scale of charges. If this suggested scheme is carried out and is supported by any large body of tenants in different parts of the city, the possibility of serious trouble is not being overlooked by local officials, especially if any attempt is made to evict tenants.

The Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee is at present the organizing body behind the agitation and is now actively engaged in forming sub-committees in various branch districts of the Citizens' Federation. As an indication of the trend of developments, the Chinese press reports a meeting of tenants in an alley off East Seward Road where, recently, the landlords increased the rent by 30 per cent. It has been decided by these tenants under instructions from the Rent Reduction Movement Committee to stop all payments of rents to landlords until a reduction of 20 per cent. is granted. The tenants have been instructed to pay their usual rents to the Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank until such time as the decrease is granted.

A general meeting of representatives from various district branches of the Citizens' Federation is to be held within the next day or two at which proposals are to be considered and a definite policy and line of action mapped out.

《字林西报》，1934年2月6日，星期二
99-5

要求降低租金的骚动日益加剧

华人发起的运动正忙于协调力量向房东施压；
各区团体将联合行动

尽管上海华人要求降低住房和店铺租金的骚动起初规模较小，但经过持续推动，如今已发展到具有重要甚至危险影响的程度。运动幕后人士为达成目标将采取哪些具体步骤尚不清楚，但过去几天骚动蔓延的方式表明，相当一部分华人社群并非一时冲动，而是确实希望从他们看来异常高昂的租金中获得某种程度的缓解。

发起降低住房和店铺租金运动的华人声称，1932年的中日敌对行动给当地大部分社群造成了严重的经济损失、业务损失甚至相当大的财产损失，因此他们获得了社会各界广大同胞的大力支持。上海第一区市民联合会目前正支持该运动，并已向其各分会发出指示，要求在争取降低租金的任何总体行动中积极合作。这些市民联合会分会已取代了以前的街道联合会，后者曾负责不同城市区域的事务管理，并对各自区域内中国居民的福利负责。其中许多分会现在正积极组织其成员，针对高租金采取某种形式的集体行动。这些区域的租户已收到通告，并发放了表格，要求提供有关房产所有权、租金金额、已付税费以及其他有关房屋和店铺出租及转租情况的数据。各区已聘请中国律师，他们目前正在制定计划，以便在总体运动开始时协调使用。

暂无具体计划

截至目前，尚无迹象表明总体运动的性质或开始时间，但有暗示称，为迫使房东降低租金，租户将被指示拒绝付款，直到收费标准得到调整为止。如果这一建议的方案得以实施，并得到全市各地大量租户的支持，地方官员并未忽视发生严重麻烦的可能性，特别是如果试图驱逐租户的话。

上海减租运动委员会目前是这场骚动背后的组织机构，正积极致力于在市民联合会的各个分支区成立小组委员会。作为发展趋势的一个迹象，中文报纸报道了在东熙华德路（East Seward Road）附近一条弄堂举行的租户会议，那里最近房东将租金提高了30%。根据减租运动委员会的指示，这些租户决定停止向房东支付所有租金，直到获得20%的减租为止。租户已被指示将 usual rents（常规租金）存入上海商业储蓄银行，直到获得减租为止。

市民联合会各区分支机构的代表全体会议将在未来一两天内举行，届时将审议提案，并制定明确的政策和行动方针。

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

Yesterday at 2 p.m. a meeting of principals of
the various schools in Shanghai took place at the Ai
Chung Girls School (愛群女校) on Dah Chi Road. Some
60 persons were present. The following resolutions
were passed:-
1) That the rent for the school premises be reduced
in accordance with the decision of the Shanghai Rent
Reduction Movement Committee.
2) That a committee be formed to supervise the
proceedings in connection with rent reduction.
3) That the reduction in rent be effective from
February 1934.
4) That lawyers be retained as legal advisers to
the committee.
5) That the committee join the Shanghai Rent Reduction
Movement Committee.
6) That the office of the committee be located in the
premises of the Shanghai Educational Association.
7) That schools which have not yet registered be
notified to do so.

At a meeting of the Chapei Rent Reduction Movement
Committee held yesterday and attended by some 20 persons,
the following resolutions were passed:-
1) That all lease contracts be cancelled.
2) That the sub-tenants also benefit by a reduction
in rents.
3) That requests first be submitted to the landlords
to reduce the rents
4) That the Rent Reduction Movement Committee be
requested to canvass views from all quarters and to petition
the Legislative Yuan at Nanking to amend Articles 440
and 450 of the Civil Code.

Yesterday a notification was issued by the First
Special Citizens Federation to its branches informing them
that the 5th meeting of the Rent Reduction Movement
Committee of the First Special District will be held at
2 p.m. on Thursday, February 8 and that measures to proceed
with the rent reduction movement will be discussed.

At a meeting held yesterday of the 35th Branch of
the First Special District Citizen's Federation, the follow-
ing resolutions were passed:-
1) That a sub-committee of the Rent Reduction Move-
ment Committee be formed.
2) That in addition to the members of the Executive
Committee of the branch, Koo Lai Chu(馬蘭舟) and two
others be invited to form the sub-committee.
3) That a report on the formation of the sub-committee
be submitted to the Rent Reduction Movement Committee.
4) That rent investigation forms and notifications
to urge the tenants to register at once with the sub-
committee be distributed.

减租运动

昨日下午2时，上海各校校长在大吉路爱群女校（Ai Chung Girls School）举行会议。约有60人出席。通过以下决议：

4) 请求减租运动委员会征求各方意见，并向南京立法院请愿，要求修改《民法》第440条和第450条。

昨日，第一特区市民联合会向其各分会发出通知，告知第一特区减租运动委员会第五次会议将于2月8日（星期四）下午2时举行，并将讨论推进减租运动的措施。

1) 成立减租运动委员会小组委员会。
2) 除分会执行委员会委员外，邀请顾兰舟（Koo Lai Chu，原文注：馬蘭舟）及另外两人组成小组委员会。
3) 向减租运动委员会提交关于成立小组委员会的报告。
4) 分发租金调查表及通知，敦促租户立即向小组委员会登记。

February 6, 1934. Morning Translation.

Dispute Over Increase of Rent

The house owners of the Fan Seng Li (藩生里),
Chaofong Road off East Seward Road, notified the tenants
on January 17 that the rentals of the houses would be
increased by 30% from January. Any tenants refusing
to pay the increase would be forced to remove.
The tenants of the alleyway held a meeting
yesterday and a Branch of the Rent Reduction Committee
was organized. Seven persons were elected to serve
on the Committee.
The following resolutions were also passed:-
1. That the rentals be reduced 20%.
2. That, until the settlement of the rent reduction
dispute, all rents should be deposited in banks;
3. That the General Rent Reduction Committee be requested
to render assistance.

Meeting of Real Estate Owners

At 4 p.m., yesterday the Chinese Real Estate
Owners Association held a meeting to discuss the rent
reduction movement and the water question. Kwei Yien
Fang (桂延芳 ), who presided, made a report on a letter
received from the Water Rate Commission of the S.M.C.
requesting the Association to send representatives to
participate in the next meeting of the Commission.
Discussions over the rent reduction movement
and the water question took place but the results were
not announced.
According to enquiries made by our reporter, the
rent reduction question was the main subject discussed
at the meeting, and it was resolved to notify the members
of the Real Estate Owners Association to suspend the
construction of new houses. As it was evident that the
Water Works Co. had not devised a proper system for collecting
the water rates, a decision was passed that delegates of the
Real Estate Owners Association be sent to attend the meeting
of the Water Rate Commission of the S.M.C. to be held on
February 8.

China Times and other local newspapers :

THE ALLEGED MANSLAUGHT CASE

At a meeting held yesterday by the 30th Branch
of the First Special District Citizens Federation, it
was resolved that regarding the request made by Kan Tse
Kong (甘慈剛) for assistance in connection with the death
of his wife during a police raid at his house, letters be
addressed to various public organizations and a mass meeting
to discuss ways and means to deal with the case be held under
auspices of the Branch.

1934年2月6日。晨间译件。

关于加租之纠纷

东熙华德路（East Seward Road）旁兆丰路（Chaofong Road）藩生里（Fan Seng Li）的房东于1月17日通知租户，自1月份起房屋租金将增加30%。任何拒绝支付增幅的租户将被迫搬离。
该弄堂的租户昨日举行会议，并组织了减租委员会的一个分部。七人当选为委员会委员。
会议还通过了以下决议：
1. 租金减少20%。
2. 在减租纠纷解决之前，所有租金应存入银行；
3. 请求减租委员会总会提供协助。

房地产业主会议

昨日下午4时，中国房地产业主协会举行会议，讨论减租运动及水费问题。主持会议的桂延芳（Kwei Yien Fang）报告了收到工部局水价委员会来函一事，该函要求协会派代表参加委员会的下一次会议。
会上就减租运动和水费问题进行了讨论，但未公布结果。
据本报记者查询，减租问题是会议讨论的主要议题，并决定通知房地产业主协会会员暂停新建房屋。鉴于自来水公司显然未制定适当的水费征收制度，会议通过决议，派遣房地产业主协会代表参加将于2月8日举行的工部局水价委员会会议。

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

所谓过失杀人案

在第一特区市民联合会第三十分会昨日举行的会议上，决议就甘慈剛（Kan Tse Kong）因其妻在警方搜查其住宅期间死亡而请求援助一事，致函各公共团体，并在该分会主持下召开群众大会，讨论处理此案的方法。

减租运动

上海减租运动委员会执行委员会第二次会议于昨日下午3时在总商会举行。约30人出席。经讨论，通过以下决议：
1) 选举金楚湘（Ching Chu Siang）和顾文笙（Koo Wen Sung）为调解小组委员。
2) 在常务委员会指导下成立一个特别小组。
3) 邀请金通明（Ching Tung Ming）律师等五人组成法律咨询组。
4) 批准关于成立减租运动委员会、小组及小组单位的规章。

此前，西藏路（Thibet Road）旁文之里（Wen Tse Li Alleyway）的房东昌华公司（Chong Hwa Company）通知租户，租金将增加30%。
接到通知后，租户立即向上海减租运动委员会求助，并组织了减租运动委员会的一个小组。
由于房东拒绝收取1月份租金，租户已将款项存入上海商业储蓄银行，以待纠纷解决。

昨日下午2时，东熙华德路（East Seward Road）旁蕃生里（Van Sung Li Alleyway）的租户举行会议，讨论反对房东加租30%的方法。经讨论，通过以下决议：
1) 弄堂租户按照减租运动委员会批准的措施，强制实行减租20%。
2) 在房东同意减租之前，租户不支付租金，租金存入上海商业储蓄银行。
3) 推选周补璋（Chow Fu Chang）代表租户。
4) 向减租运动委员会请求援助。

法租界双共和国路（Boulevard des Deux Republiques）和蒙托邦路（Rue Montauban）沿线的房屋建成已有九年。和记公司（Ho Chee Land Investment Company）是这些房产的房东。
一·二八事变后，这些房屋的租户请求免除数月租金，如同其他房东所给予的那样，但该请求未获准许。
鉴于商业极度萧条，租户日前召开会议，通过以下决议：

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

SENTENCE OF YU PAH LOH REDUCED

Convicted on a charge of allowing police constables
Ling Ching Tsiang (林慶祥) and others to fire on a crowd,
Yu Pah Loh (游伯麓), former Chief of the 5th Division
of the Public Safety Bureau, was sentenced to three years'
imprisonment by the Shanghai District Court, while Ling
Ching Tsiang and others were sentenced to various terms of
imprisonment.
An appeal was later filed with the Kiangsu High
Court by the prisoners, but it was disallowed by the Court.
Yesterday the judgment of the Kiangsu High Court,
which reviewed the case on the instructions of the Supreme
Court with which a final appeal was filed by the prisoners
was read. Yu Pah Loh, Ling Ching Tsiang and three others
were sentenced under the new judgment to two years imprison-
ment each.

Sin Wan Pao publishes the following item on Feb. 3, 1934.

"THE BUND":

The Bund is like a paradise, a world distinct
from ours. Imposing buildings, tram cars and automobiles
are found in abundance there.
A Sikh policeman standing in an iron cage in the
air is switching the traffic lights in a mechanical manner.
He does not think of doing his best for his Fatherland. On
the contrary, he shouts ghoulishly in the interest of
Imperialists.

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

游伯麓刑期减轻

前公安局第五分局局长游伯麓（Yu Pah Loh）因被控允许巡捕林庆祥（Ling Ching Tsiang）等人向人群开枪，被上海地方法院判处三年监禁，林庆祥等人也被判处不同期限的监禁。
囚犯随后向江苏高等法院提出上诉，但被法院驳回。
昨日宣读江苏高等法院的判决，该院奉最高法院之命复审此案，囚犯曾向最高法院提起最终上诉。根据新判决，游伯麓、林庆祥及其他三人各被判处两年监禁。

外滩宛如天堂，一个与我们世界截然不同的地方。那里随处可见宏伟的建筑、电车和汽车。

February 3, 1934. Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

The Second Meeting of the Executive Committee
of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee will
take place at 2 p.m. to-day.
Some time ago, the Committee received letters
from the tenants of the Shu Ping Li Alleyway (淑平里),
Ward Road; the Tsiang Hsing Li Alleyway (江興里), Tatung
Road; and the Dong Shu Li Alleyway (東樹里), Chengtu
Road, requesting the Committee to prevent the landlords
from increasing the rents and demolishing the houses.
Upon receipt of these requests, representatives
were detailed to investigate and yesterday warnings were
issued by the Committee to the landlords concerned, asking
them not to increase the rents nor to demolish the houses.

Yesterday a meeting of the First Special
District Citizens Federation was held at 2 p.m. The
following resolutions were passed:-
1) That a letter be addressed to the landlord of
the Pao Kong Li Alleyway (保康里) of the 27th Branch,
requesting him to reduce the rents instead of increasing
them.
2) That Lawyer Li Ling (李銘) be engaged to
assist in the settlement of the dispute between the Lung-
Tai Company (隆泰) of the 30th Branch and the landlord
of the premises.

A meeting was convened of the 4th Branch of the
First Special District Citizens Federation at 2 p.m.
yesterday at the office of the Branch on Ferry Road.
About ten persons attended. After discussion, the following
resolutions were passed:
1) That a sub-committee of the Shanghai Rent
Reduction Movement Committee be organized.
2) That Chen Wei Wen (陳蔚文) and Chen Kwei Fah
(陳奎福) be nominated to represent the sub-committee.

On February 1, at 7 p.m. a meeting of the 34th
Branch of the First Special District Citizens Federation
took place at the Bubbling Well Temple. Some 50 persons
were present. The following resolutions were passed:-
1) That Chang I-Zung (張一麐) and three others
be elected to form a sub-committee of the Rent Reduction
Movement Committee.
2) That Lawyers Tung Shao (董昭) and two others
be engaged as legal advisers to the sub-committee.
3) That a notification be issued to the residents
under the supervision of the Branch urging them to join
the movement.

1) 致函第二十七分部保康里（Pao Kong Li）房东，要求其减租而非加租。

2) 提名陳蔚文和陳奎福代表该分委员会。

2月1日晚七时，第一特区市民联合会第三十四分部在静安寺举行会议。约五十人出席。通过以下决议：-

JAPANESE STREET UNIONS START HOUSE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT
It is reported that the other day the Japanese Street Unions in the northern district appointed ten persons to form a committee in order to investigate the house rent question.
The Japanese Mackally Street Union has already opened negotiations with landlords for a reduction of house rents.
There are 54 Japanese street unions in all, 30 of which comprise 1,300 members residing on the north side of Hongkew Creek.
NIPPO
MR. OKAMOTO AND MR FUNATSU AGREE TO SERVE FOR A FURTHER PERIOD ON S.L.C.
Yesterday at the request of a number of influential Japanese residents Mr. Funatsu agreed to serve on the Municipal Council for a further period although he had intended to resign.
Accordingly the Japanese will recommend Mr. Okamoto and Mr. Funatsu as Japanese candidates.

February 2, 1934. Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers :

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

In compliance with the demand of various bodies
to launch a rent reduction movement, 8 sub-committees
have been established under the auspices of the Shanghai
House Rent Reduction Committee and tenants of over 200
alleys have applied to the Committee for registration and
direction in organizing sub-committees. A meeting of the
Executive Committee will be called at 2 p.m. to-morrow
in the premises of the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce
when movement will be discussed.
The circular notice reads as follows:-
"We shall hold a second meeting of the Executive
Committee at 2 p.m. February 3. Members of the Committee
are requested to attend."
It is understood that the Nantao Branch of the
Shanghai House Rent Reduction Committee has been formed
by citizens at Nantao under the direction of the Flower
Dealers Association and the Shoe-makers Association.
The office is located in the premises of the Flower
Dealers Association on Lee Yuen Road ( 麗園路 ), Hsi
Jao ( 斜橋 ). Notices have been issued inviting the
public to register with the Branch, and a meeting of
representatives is to be held in the near future.
King Yue-ching ( 金幼卿 ), representative of
tenants of the Kien Yue Fong ( 建裕坊 ), Small North
Gate, Nantao, has also formed a sub-committee.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

DISPUTE AT RICE HONGS IN CHAPEI

The rice hongs in the vicinity of the Stone
bridge, Chapei, which suspended business as a
protest against the dispute between wheelbarrow coolies
and rice porters, have now resumed their normal operations.
In an interview with a newspaper reporter a
spokesman of the Chapei Peas and Rice Merchants Association
stated that the rice dealers still demand that the licence
issued to the Hong Tai Transportation Co. by the Public
Safety Bureau be cancelled and that Sz Tong Foh be arrested
in order to prevent further disorder.
It is learned that the Hong Tai Transportation
Company will take action against those responsible for the
assault of its workers.

The tenants of Yu Hsin Fang (· 愉興坊),

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

ARRIVAL OF GENERAL CHIANG KAI SHEK

General Chiang Kai Shek, Chairman of the
Military Affairs Commission, accompanied by Madame Soong
Mei Ling and Dr. H.H.Kung, Minister of Finance, arrived
in Shanghai at 12.20 a.m. to-day. They were welcomed
by Mayor Yu Te Chen, and others.
According to Mayor Wu, General Chiang will
proceed to Hangchow this morning and thence to Fukien.

T.V.Soong Returns

T.V.Soong, Standing Member of the National
Economic Committee, arrived here from Nanking at 7.10 a.m.
yesterday. He was accompanied by Hsao Li Tze, Chairman
of the Shensi Provincial Government, Tseng Yang Fu,
Chief of the Reconstruction Department of the Chekiang
Provincial Government, Tseu Ling, Vice-Minister of
Finance, and Seng Su Yu, Superintendent of the Chinese
Maritime Customs.
Mr. Soong will grant an interview to local
newspaper reporters at 10 a.m. to-day at his office
on Avenue Joffre.

Chang Hsueh Liang At Hangchow

Chang Hsueh Liang, former Chairman of the
Peiping Branch of the Military Affairs Commission,
proceeded to Hangchow at 9.30 a.m. yesterday. He will
meet General Chiang Kai Shek there.
It is reported that he will be appointed
Vice-Commander-in-Chief of the Five Province Bandit
Suppression Army.

February 1, 1934.
Afternoon Translation

Min Pao (Comment) :-

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

Owing to trade depression, high house
rents and the increase of water rates may result in a
critical situation. The present rent reduction
movements have been assisted by foreign residents.
We know full well that the prosperity of
a commercial port depends upon trade and with an increase
in prosperity house rents will also be increased.
But with a depression in trade, the rents should not be
increased. In Shanghai, house rents have been increased
when business has decreased. Capitalists invest money
in the estate business without considering the
consequences.
The real estate dealers often claim that
they do not obtain excessive profits from their business.
They only receive the interest from their capital and
they have to pay construction expenses, insurance fees,
etc. in addition to the price they pay for the land.
This is a reasonable attitude, but why has the value of
land increased? It is not because so many houses are
necessary, but because of competition in the purchase
of land. However, these estate dealers are making the
tenants pay for the price of the land by increasing the
house rents.
We sincerely hope that the Chinese City
Government will mark out residential districts for the
construction of houses. It is also hoped that the
various public organizations will support the house
rent reduction movements.

Min Pao publishes the following brief comment :

SPECIAL PARDON FOR LIEU CHUNG WU & OTHERS REQUESTED

Patriots Lieu Chung Wu and others were
sentenced to terms of imprisonment last year for bombing
the shops of treacherous merchants. An appeal against
the sentences is being filed. The Shanghai Chamber
of Commerce and other public bodies have requested the
Central Authorities to pardon the patriots.
The action of the patriots was illegal and
the judicial authorities must sentence offenders.
However the accused should be pardoned because their
actions were inspired by patriotism.
Special pardons have been given to Zung Chi
Zung and General Tong Ngoh Ling. The former killed a
person in order to avenge his father's death, while the
latter gave up Jehol without resistance. Therefore
patriots Lieu Chung Wu and others may also be pardoned.

《民报》（评论）：

减租运动

由于贸易萧条，高昂的房租以及水费的上涨可能导致局势危急。目前的减租运动得到了外籍居民的协助。我们深知，一个商业港口的繁荣取决于贸易，随着繁荣的增加，房租也会随之上涨。但在贸易萧条之际，房租不应上涨。在上海，商业衰退时房租却在上涨。资本家投资房地产业而不考虑后果。
房地产商常声称他们并未从业务中获取超额利润。他们仅收取资本的利息，此外还需支付建筑费用、保险费等，这些都在地价之外。这种态度看似合理，但为何地价会上涨？这并非因为需要如此多的房屋，而是由于购地竞争所致。然而，这些房地产商通过提高房租，让租户承担地价成本。
我们真诚希望上海市政府能划出住宅区用于建房。同时也希望各公共团体支持减租运动。

《民报》发表如下简短评论：

请求特赦刘钟武等人

爱国人士刘钟武（Lieu Chung Wu，音译）等人去年因轰炸奸商店铺而被判处监禁。目前正针对判决提出上诉。上海总商会及其他公共团体已请求中央当局赦免这些爱国人士。
爱国人士的行动虽属违法，司法当局必须对罪犯判刑。但鉴于其行动出于爱国热情，被告应获赦免。
此前曾对宗志忠（Zung Chi Zung，音译）和佟鄂龄（Tong Ngoh Ling，音译）将军给予特赦。前者为父报仇杀人，后者不战而放弃热河。因此，刘钟武等爱国人士也可获赦免。

and tenants themselves under the direction of the
Shanghai City Government, but unless we have concrete
proposals to guide us in the negotiations for a
reduction in rents, we do not see how we can attain
our object.
"Your Chamber is the leading association
of the people and must be sympathetic with the
aspirations for the recovery of the local market
for which the rent reduction movement has been
launched. We would ask you again to join the move-
ment and to send your proposals to the Rent Reduction
Movement Committee for reference."

Although the rent reduction movement has
affected the whole city of Shanghai, yet no indication
of the attitude of the landlords towards the movement
has been given.
With a view to ascertaining the attitude of
the authorities, a press representative yesterday
interviewed Mr. Kuo (郭), a secretary of the City
Government, who declared that following the institution
of the movement much attention has been paid to it
by the authorities and that since the landlords were
entitled to the profits from rents, no partiality should
be shown in dealing with the movement.
The speaker continued that the question of
reduction in rents was a very complicated one and that
it should be studied by experts.
The Secretary said that the City Government had
set up a committee to study the problem and that a report
might be submitted to the Government by the Committee in
a few days.

尽管减租运动已影响整个上海，但尚未出现房东对该运动态度的任何迹象。
为了查明当局的态度，一名新闻代表昨日采访了市政府秘书郭先生（Mr. Kuo），他宣称，自该运动发起以来，当局已予以高度重视，且由于房东有权获得租金收益，因此在处理该运动时不应有所偏袒。
发言人继续表示，减租问题非常复杂，应由专家进行研究。
该秘书称，市政府已成立一个委员会来研究此问题，委员会可能在几天内向政府提交报告。

1月30日上午8时，当四名受雇于南市四卡棚路源松猪行的工人在四卡棚码头的一艘船上作业时，两名为猪业公会执行特别任务的公安局中国巡捕登上船只，试图调查猪鬃盗窃案。工人们阻挠并殴打了巡捕。
上午10时，猪行工人工会的六名委员在南市四卡棚路87号的办事处举行会议，讨论警方所谓的非法行为。会议进行期间，来自第一区警署的四名中国警察到达会场，中止了会议，并拘留了一名工人。工会的四名代表立即前往当地国民党

Date 31 / 1 / 34

January 31, 1934. Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

Following the inauguration of the Rent
Reduction Movement Committee various districts have formed
sub-committees to support the movement. Yesterday the
tenants of the Chien Yu Fong (建餘坊) alleyway, Small
North Gate, Nantao, and of the Ta Fong Li (大方里)
alleyway, South Chengtu Road applied for permission to
participate in the movement. Yesterday a meeting of the
Chapei Rent Reduction Movement Committee took place at
18 Chaautung Road. After discussion, the following
resolutions were passed:-
1. That sub-committees be formed under the supervision
of the Organization Department of the Committee.
2. That appointments of secretaries to various
departments of the Committee be approved by the Committee.
3. That the regulations governing the formation
of sub-committees be drawn up by the Secretarial Department
of the Committee.
4. That expenses for the Committee be advanced by
members of the Executive Committee.
5. That Wong Ping Yen (黃炳炎) be invited to
be the Hon. Chairman of the Committee.
6. That Lawyers Yen Tse and others be invited to be
the legal advisers of the Committee.

The Shanghai Education Association sent out the
following circular notification to local private and public
schools yesterday:-
"Most premises for local schools of all grades
are leased at high rentals. In view of this, the Association
has resolved to join the House Rent Reduction Committee
and particulars concerning the rents of the schools are to
be noted.
"The Association will convene a meeting of principals
of various local private and public schools at its office
at 1 p.m. February 5 to discuss the rent reduction movement."

Tsu Hsueh Van (朱學範) and Zau Hsu Bah (邵白),
members of the Standing Committee and the Executive Committee
respectively of the General Labour Union, stated in a letter
sent to the Rent Reduction Committee yesterday that they had
to decline to accept the invitation to become members of
the Rent Reduction Committee.

The tenants of the Chien Yu Fong Alleyway, Small
North Gate, yesterday held a meeting at which the following
decisions were reached :
1. That Hoong Zoong Chun, member of the Standing Committee
of the Rent Reduction Movement Committee, be requested to
make a report on the organization of the Committee.
2. That a letter be written to the landlord of the alleyway
with a request that the house rent be reduced 40%.
3. That prior to the settlement of the rent reduction question,
all rents be deposited at the West Gate Branch of the
Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank.

1934年1月31日。晨间译件。

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动。

继减租运动委员会成立之后，各区已成立分会以支持该运动。昨日，南市小北门建余坊弄堂及成都南路大方里弄堂的租户申请获准参加该运动。昨日，闸北减租运动委员会在乍浦路18号举行会议。经讨论，通过以下决议：-
1. 在委员会组织部的监督下成立分会。
2. 委员会各部门秘书的任命须经委员会批准。
3. 由委员会秘书处起草关于成立分会的规章。
4. 委员会的经费由执行委员会委员垫付。
5. 邀请黄炳炎担任委员会名誉主席。
6. 邀请严子等律师担任委员会法律顾问。

上海教育协会昨日向本地私立和公立学校发出如下通告：-
“本地各级学校的校舍大多以高昂租金租赁。鉴于此，本协会决定加入房屋减租委员会，并将记录各校租金详情。
“本协会将于2月5日下午1时在其办事处召开本地各私立和公立学校校长会议，讨论减租运动。”

朱学范和邵白，分别为总工会常务委员会和执行委员会委员，在昨日致减租委员会的信中表示，他们不得不拒绝接受成为减租委员会委员的邀请。

小北门建余坊弄堂的租户昨日举行会议，达成以下决定：
1. 请减租运动委员会常务委员洪宗春报告委员会的组织情况。
2. 致信弄堂房东，要求将房租降低40%。
3. 在减租问题解决之前，所有租金存入上海商业储蓄银行西门分行。
