January 30, 1934. Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

HOUSE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

At a meeting of the Standing Committee held
at 2 p.m. yesterday by the House Rent Reduction Committee,
the following resolutions were passed:-
1. That, regarding the letter from the 30th Branch
of the First District Citizens Federation, a reply
be given to the effect that the house rentals due for
the premises occupied by the Yuan Dah Leather Factory
(源大皮廠), the Yung Kee (永記) and the Yung Sun
Yuen (永生源) be kept in the bank pending the
settlement of the dispute.
2. That the 19th Branch assist in affecting a
reduction of rentals of houses occupied by Yue Foong
(裕豐) and Yuan Kee (雲記).
3. That the Legal Advisory Group be requested to
inquire into the forcible collection of rentals in the
Dah Fong Li (大方里) alleyway.
4. That in compliance with the request of the
9th Branch, a letter be despatched to the owner of houses
in Doeng Shou Li (同壽里) alleyway requesting him
to grant a reduction in rentals.
5. That in reply to the request of the 9th Branch,
a letter be sent to the owner of houses in Ziang Shing
Li ( ) alleyway who is attempting to demolish
the houses.
6. That as requested by the 5th Branch of the
Second Special District Citizens Federation, the Executive
Committee submit a petition to the National Government
requesting them to revise the Civil Code.
7. That the Organization Section detail officials
to attend a meeting to be held by the 11th Branch of
the First District Citizens Federation.
8. That the 4th Branch of the First District be
notified by letter to nominate officials to conduct a
meeting to be held by the sub-branches at the Woo Foh
Li (五福里) and the Ying Sih Li (映雪里) alleyways
on Tonguin Road.
9. That a petition be submitted to the Executive
Yuan and the Judicial Yuan requesting them to order all
Courts not to handle cases regarding disputes over rentals.
10. That a letter be despatched to the Shanghai City
Government and the Shanghai Municipal Council requesting
that rates for unoccupied houses be collected from the
house owners.
11. That two officials be nominated to make
arrangements with various foreign organizations in
connection with the house rent reduction movement.

About 20 lawyers attended a meeting called
at 3 p.m. yesterday by the Legal Advisory Group. Yue
Hwa-loong (余華龍) presided. Questions regarding the
reduction in house rentals, were carefully discussed.

The House Rent Reduction Committee has printed
a form in which the following details are to be filled
in:-

1934年1月30日。晨间译件。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

房屋减租运动。

在昨日下午2时举行的房屋减租委员会常务委员会会议上，通过以下决议：-
1. 关于第一区市民联合会第三十支会的来信，回复称，源大皮厂、永记和永生源所占用房屋的应付租金应存入银行，待纠纷解决后再行处理。
2. 第十九支会协助促成裕丰和云记所占用房屋的租金减免。
3. 请法律咨询组调查大方里弄堂强行收租的情况。
4. 应第九支会的要求，致信同寿里弄堂的房主，要求其给予租金减免。
5. 答复第九支会的要求，致信正在试图拆除房屋的祥兴里（原文不清）弄堂房主。
6. 应第二特区市民联合会第五支会的要求，执行委员会向国民政府提交请愿书，请求修订《民法》。
7. 组织部派遣官员参加第一区市民联合会第十一支会举行的会议。
8. 致函通知第一区第四支会提名官员，主持在通运路五福里和映雪里弄堂举行的分会会议。
9. 向行政院和司法院提交请愿书，请求命令所有法院不受理有关租金纠纷的案件。
10. 致函上海市政府和上海公共租界工部局，请求向房主征收空置房屋的市政捐税。
11. 提名两名官员就房屋减租运动与各外国机构进行接洽安排。

约20名律师参加了昨日下午3时由法律咨询组召集的会议。余华龙主持。仔细讨论了有关房屋租金减免的问题。

房屋减租委员会已印制表格，需填写以下详细信息：-

No. D 32482
Date 29 / 1 / 34

January 29, 1934. Morning Translation

China Times and other local newspapers:

HOUSE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

Shortly after 2 p.m. yesterday, a procession of motor cars was held under the auspices of the House Rent Reduction Committee. The starting point was the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce and each motor car participating in the procession bore a cloth flag with the inscription "Today is the inaugural day of the house rent reduction movement". Posters were also affixed to the cars which were followed by motor-cycle patrols of the Settlement Police.

Apart from holding the procession of motor cars, the Committee has had pamphlets printed bearing slogans and these were issued to the various street unions and various district branches of the Citizens Federation. They were then distributed to various stores, factories and residents yesterday.

The slogans are as follows:-
1. The reasons for reducing the house rent.
2. To reduce house rent is to restore trade and to help the people to live.
3. To-day is the inaugural day of the house rent reduction movement.
4. To reduce house rent is to alleviate the burdens of citizens.
5. House rent must be reduced for Shanghai to prosper.

The House Rent Reduction Legal Advisory Group will hold a meeting at 3 p.m. January 29 at which plans to be adopted to assist in the movement will be discussed. A letter to this effect was despatched yesterday to forty lawyers, members of the Group.

It is reported that a second meeting of the Standing Committee to discuss important problems regarding the movement will be called at the same time.

Apart from detailing representatives to participate in the house rent reduction movement, the Municipal Education Association is reported to have called the supervisors of public and private schools, having leased houses for their school premises, to a meeting to be held at 1 p.m. February 5.

At a meeting held at 1 p.m. yesterday by the tenants of Kien Yue Fong (建裕坊) at Small North Gate, Nantao, the following resolutions were passed:-
1. That house rentals due for January 1934 be kept in the Shanghai Bank pending the settlement of the dispute concerning house rent reduction.
2. That representatives be required to register with the General Committee.
3. That a meeting be held at 7 p.m. January 29 at which measures to be adopted will be discussed.

On January 28, the Branch Associations of the House Rent Reduction Committee, organised by residents on East Seward Road, East Yuhang Road, Tiendong Road, Pingliang Road, Yangtzepoo Road and Broadway issued the following joint manifesto:-

1934年1月29日。晨间译件

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动。

昨日下午二时过后，在减租委员会的主持下举行了一次汽车游行。起点为上海总商会，参加游行的每辆汽车均悬挂一面布旗，上书“今日为减租运动开始之日”。车上还张贴了海报，并由租界巡捕房的摩托巡逻队随行护卫。

除举行汽车游行外，该委员会还印制了载有标语的小册子，并发放给各马路联合会及市民联合会的各区分会。这些小册子于昨日分发至各商店、工厂及住户。

标语如下：
1. 减租之理由。
2. 减租以复兴商业并救济民生。
3. 今日为减租运动开始之日。
4. 减租以减轻市民负担。
5. 上海欲求繁荣，必须减租。

减租法律顾问团将于1月29日下午三时举行会议，讨论并通过协助该运动的计划。昨日已向该团四十名律师成员发出了以此为目的的信件。

据悉，常务委员会将同时召开第二次会议，讨论有关该运动的重要问题。

据报，市教育协会除派遣代表参加减租运动外，还召集了租赁房屋作为校址的公私立学校主管，定于2月5日下午一时举行会议。

在昨日下午一时于南市小北门建裕坊租户举行的会议上，通过了以下决议：
1. 1934年1月份应付之房租暂存于上海银行，待减租纠纷解决后再行处理。
2. 要求代表向总委员会登记。
3. 定于1月29日晚七时举行会议，讨论拟采取的措施。

1月28日，由东华德路、东余杭路、天潼路、平凉路、杨树浦路及百老汇路居民组织的减租委员会各分会发布了以下联合宣言：

page_data.en:
January 29, 1934. Morning Translation.

"Trade in Shanghai has been on the decline since
the January 28 Incident. Not only have the house rents
been increased, but the landlords are intensifying the
oppression on the tenants. The residents are unable to
bear their heavy burdens and have formed the Shanghai
House Rent Reduction Committee.
"We hereby announce the inauguration of the various
Branch Associations of the Rent Reduction Committee in
Hongker to support the movement of the Committee."

The East Seward Road Branch Association of the
Rent Reduction Committee sent the following letter to the
Committee yesterday:-
The Association is in receipt of a report from
the tenants of Fan Seng Li (藩盛里), East Seward Road,
reading as follows:-
"On January 17, we received a letter from our
rent agency, Brandt & Rodgers, Ltd., a British firm,
intimating that our rents would be increased from the
Chinese New Year by 30 per cent. Tenants who opposed
the increase were requested to pay the rent and vacate
the houses at the end of January. It will be recalled
that the houses in the terrace were built in 1922 and the
rents were $22 per month and $50 per month for a single

January 29, 1934.    3    Afternoon Translation

Central China Daily News (Editorial):

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

Owing to trade depression, various public organizations have combined to launch a rent reduction movement. For this purpose, a rent reduction movement committee has been formed and a series of principles drawn up to guide the negotiations for the reduction. In this connection, the writer has something to say about the movement.

Natural calamities and civil warfare have brought about bankruptcy in rural China. All the money from the interior has been transported to large commercial centres and many unemployed people have flocked to these centres to seek a living. These migrations have accounted for the increase in the population of Shanghai and the development in the banking enterprise.

In countries where industries and commercial undertakings have been developed, the money would be employed for improvements, but in China, a country financially backward, the situation is different, for most of the surplus funds are speculated in land investments. The only thing that has resulted from these investments is the erection of large buildings in the commercial centres, while the people of rural China are being oppressed.

So much for the people of the rural country. But what about the life of city dwellers? In Shanghai, in contrast to the development in land investment, prices are on the decline and the purchasing power of the people has decreased. The rents should be reduced, but on the contrary they are increased. The greater the increase in rents, the less will be the purchasing power of the people. If this state of affairs continues, the situation will become more serious. Therefore, the rent reduction movement is necessary from the standpoint of the living of the people and the development of industry and commerce.

According to the statements made by Mr. Kwei Ye Fong (普返芳), member of the Standing Committee of the Shanghai House Owners Association, 90% of the houses in Shanghai are owned by land investment companies and most of the property has been mortgaged to banks. He said that if the tenants wished to reduce the rents, the investment companies would demand from the banks a reduction in interest to compensate for their loss. Thus we know that all these land investments are under the control of the banks. It is unreasonable for the banks to oppose the demand of the people for a reduction in rents as being prejudicial to their interests.

We would advise the banking circles to show sympathy with the people in the rent reduction movement and to sacrifice some of their profits for the benefit of the people.

Chen Pao (Editorial):

We do not believe that the rent reduction movement in Shanghai will meet with success.
We do not mean that local residents should not launch the campaign to secure a reduction of house rents.

《华中日报》（社论）：

减租运动

由于商业萧条，各公共团体联合发起减租运动。为此成立了减租运动委员会，并制定了一系列原则以指导减租谈判。就此，笔者对此次运动略陈己见。

天灾人祸导致中国农村破产。内地的资金全部流向大型商业中心，许多失业者涌向这些中心谋生。这种人口迁移导致了上海人口的增加以及银行业的发展。

在工商业发达的国家，资金会被用于改进生产，但在中国这个金融落后的国家，情况则不同，大部分剩余资金被投机于土地投资。这些投资带来的唯一结果就是在商业中心矗立起高楼大厦，而中国农村居民却遭受压迫。

农村百姓的情况姑且不论，城市居民的生活又如何呢？在上海，与土地投资的发展形成对比的是，物价下跌，民众购买力下降。房租本应降低，反而上涨。房租涨得越高，民众的购买力就越低。如果这种状况持续下去，局势将更加严峻。因此，从民众生活及工商业发展的角度来看，减租运动是必要的。

据上海业主协会常务委员普返芳先生称，上海90%的房屋由土地投资公司拥有，且大部分房产已抵押给银行。他说，如果租户希望减租，投资公司将要求银行降低利息以补偿其损失。由此可知，所有这些土地投资均受银行控制。银行以损害其利益为由反对民众的减租要求，这是不合理的。

我们建议银行界对民众的减租运动表示同情，并为民众利益牺牲部分利润。

《晨报》（社论）：

我们不相信上海的减租运动会取得成功。
这并不意味着本地居民不应发起争取减租的运动。

January 29, 1934.
Afternoon Translation.

The residents must simultaneously start a movement to effect an improvement of the system of land rates in the foreign Settlements. There is a connection between the house rent and the land lease rent and between the land rent and the value of land. Under the existing system, it seems impossible to reduce the land rates in the Settlements and the rent of land in these districts will increase and the house rent will become higher. The Settlement authorities have assessed the value of land at a high rate in order to increase their income.
Another fact; will result in the increase in the house rent--- the concentration of ready money in Shanghai. The economic system in the Interior of China has collapsed and the menace of banditry reigns in many parts of the country. People in possession of wealth can not live in peace and therefore come to Shanghai They will become real estate capitalists in view of the depression in other lines of commerce and industry in this city. Moreover, local bankers have invested their money in the real estate business.
In short, the rent question will not be solved until the rates are lowered. The land law must be enforced in the foreign Settlements to limit speculations in real estate.

In commemorating the January 28 Incident, the editor of the Sin Wan Pao makes the following remarks:-

THE JANUARY 28 INCIDENT AND SHANGHAI

After the January 28 Incident, the Japanese built a large barracks on North Szechuen Road. The place is not within the Settlement and the Japanese have no right to build barracks there, especially as the fortresses at Woosung have been demolished and there are no Chinese soldiers stationed at Chapei. The Japanese are ready to recommence hostilities at any time. We tremble to think of the future of Shanghai.
It was fortunate that the Japanese intention to establish Shanghai as a free city was not realized, but the Japanese are still ambitious and are awaiting an opportunity.
Shanghai is the civic centre of China and its prosperity or ruin will affect the world. China and the whole world should offer protection to Shanghai and no further hostilities should be tolerated.

居民必须同时发起运动，以改善外国租界内的地税制度。房租与地租之间存在联系，地租又与土地价值相关。在现有制度下，租界内的地税似乎不可能降低，而这些地区的地租将会增加，从而导致房租升高。租界当局为了提高收入，对土地价值进行了高估。
另一个事实也将导致房租上涨——即现金集中在上海。中国内地的经济体系已经崩溃，全国多地匪患猖獗。拥有财富的人无法安居，因此来到上海。鉴于本市其他工商业行业的萧条，他们将成为房地产资本家。此外，本地银行家也将资金投资于房地产业。
总之，除非降低地税，否则房租问题无法解决。必须在外国租界实施土地法，以限制房地产投机。

为纪念“一·二八”事变，《申晚报》编辑发表如下评论：

“一·二八”事变与上海

“一·二八”事变后，日本人在北四川路修建了一座大型兵营。该地不在租界范围内，日本人无权在此修建兵营，尤其是吴淞的堡垒已被拆除，闸北也没有中国军队驻守。日本人随时准备重新发动敌对行动。想到上海的未来，我们不禁战栗。
幸运的是，日本将上海建立为自由市的意图未能实现，但日本人仍野心勃勃，伺机而动。
上海是中国的市民中心，其繁荣或毁灭将影响世界。中国和全世界都应保护上海，不容许再发生任何敌对行动。

Yesterday, a reporter secured an interview with Mr. Kwei Yi Fong (姜延芳), member of the Standing Committee of the Shanghai House Owners Association, asking for the opinion of the house owners regarding the movement.
Mr. Kwei stated that it was true that all trades were on the decline. Nevertheless, he continued, 90% of the house owners had mortgaged their property to banks for loans and 9% interest was paid on these loans, while the highest return from land investment only came to 7% after land tax and water charges had been paid.
Mr. Kwei said that most of the property owners were in financial straits and that if the tenants desired to reduce the rents, the landlords would be compelled to demand a reduction in interest, land tax and water rates.
The speaker continued that should the demand presented by the landlords be granted, they would willingly reduce the rents, but that should the tenants refuse to pay rents, financial disaster might follow, for most of the houses were owned by banks and the government bonds would be affected as a result of shortage of money in the banks.

昨日，一名记者采访了上海业主协会常务委员姜延芳先生（Kwei Yi Fong），询问业主对该运动的看法。
姜先生表示，各行各业衰退确是事实。然而，他继续说道，90%的业主已将房产抵押给银行以获取贷款，这些贷款的利息为9%，而在支付土地税和水费后，土地投资的最高回报率仅为7%。
姜先生说，大多数业主处于财务困境中，如果租客希望降低租金，房东将被迫要求降低利息、土地税和水费。
发言人接着说，如果房东提出的要求得到满足，他们愿意降低租金；但如果租客拒绝支付租金，可能会引发金融灾难，因为大多数房屋归银行所有，银行资金短缺将进而影响政府债券。

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

HOUSE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

At a meeting to be held at 2 p.m. to-day
by the House Rent Reduction Movement Committee in the
premises of the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce,
the following measures for a rent reduction will be
discussed:-
The reduction in house rentals is to be
put into effect for four years, from 1934 to the end
of 1937.
It is proposed that:- rentals of houses
built between 1922 and 1924 be reduced 10 %; houses
constructed between 1925 and 1927 be reduced 20%;
houses built between 1928 and 1930 be reduced 30%;
houses built between 1931 and 1933 be reduced 40%.
If the landowners fail to sanction the
reductions, no rentals are to be paid from January 1934.
All tenants concerned should put the rentals due into
a membership bank of the Shanghai Bankers Association.

The various branches of the First Special District
Citizens Federation in Hongkew covering East Seward, Ward,
Broadway, Yangtszepoo and other Roads have decided to join
the rent reduction movement and to hold a meeting in a few
days of representatives of various public organizations
in these districts.
Yesterday the 14th Branch of the Citizens
Federation sent a letter to the Rent Reduction Movement
Committee, which reads as follows:
"With reference to one of the resolutions passed
at a meeting of the Citizens Federation concerning the
launching of a rent reduction movement, we would submit the
following proposals for your consideration:-
1) That units of the various branches of the Citizens
Federation be formed by tenants of alleyways. Instructions
be issued by the Federation to the various branches ordering
them to notify the tenants to register at the branches.
2) That views concerning a reduction in rent be can-
vassed.
3) That blank forms be distributed to the residents
for the purpose of collecting information regarding the
amounts of rent paid."

be requested to forbid these shipments to the territory under
the control of the bogus government.

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动。

减租运动委员会将于今日下午2时在中华总商会会所举行会议，讨论以下减租措施：
房屋租金减免将从1934年起生效，为期四年，至1937年底止。
提议如下：1922年至1924年间建造的房屋租金减少10%；1925年至1927年间建造的房屋减少20%；1928年至1930年间建造的房屋减少30%；1931年至1933年间建造的房屋减少40%。
如果地主不批准减免，则从1934年1月起不再支付租金。所有相关租客应将应付租金存入上海银行公会的会员银行。

虹口第一特区市民联合会涵盖东熙华德路、华德路、百老汇路、杨树浦路等道路的各分支已决定加入减租运动，并将在数日内举行这些地区各公共团体代表的会议。
昨日，市民联合会第十四分会致函减租运动委员会，内容如下：
“关于市民联合会会议上通过的发起减租运动的决议之一，我们提出以下建议供贵方考虑：
1) 由各弄堂的租客组成市民联合会各分支的单位。由联合会向各分支发出指令，命令其通知租客在各分支登记。
2) 征询关于减租的意见。
3) 向居民分发空白表格，以收集有关已付租金金额的信息。”

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

大米运往东北各省。

有传言称，在海关当局禁止大米进口到中国之后，大量谷物正被运往东北三省。
为了获得关于这批运输的权威信息，本报记者昨日 contacted 社会局，获悉该局正在进行调查，如果传言属实，将请求中央政府禁止向伪政府控制下的领土运送这些货物。

January 24, 1934. Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

HOUSE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT IN THE SETTLEMENT.

About 30 persons attended a meeting held
at 2 p.m. yesterday in the premises of the Shanghai
Chinese Chamber of Commerce by the House Rent
Reduction Committee which was formed by the First
Shanghai Special District Citizens Federation.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That a petition be submitted to the Shanghai
City Government and the District Court and a letter
be sent to the House Owners Association.
2. That a Legal Advisory Group be formed to
deal with the house rent reduction movement.
3. That a general meeting of representatives
be called at 2 p.m. January 26 in the premises of the
Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
4. That officials be detailed to attend the
meetings to be held by various bodies regarding the
house rent reduction movement, and letters to this
effect be despatched to various bodies concerned.
5. That regarding the request for assistance of
the Hwa Ping Lee (華品里) Alleyway Tenants
Association, a letter of protest be sent to the house
owner concerned.
6. That January 28 be the inaugural day for the
house rent reduction movement.
It is reported that Sih Tou-bih (薛篤弼),
Moh Chun-sheh (馬君碩), Chu Ah-kwei (朱亞), Weung
Mei-yun (汪曼云) and several others are being
retained as members of the Legal Advisory Group.

Protest against demolition of houses on Ward Road

Following the receipt of a notification from the
Land and Estate Department of Hansons informing the tenants
of the Shu Ping Lee Alleyway, Ward Road, of an increase
in house rent, a meeting took place the other day, at which
it was resolved to retain the services of Lawyer Yuan Niang
An ( ), who has written a letter on behalf of the
tenants to the agents of the landlord opposing the increase.
Yesterday a building contractor went to the
Alleyway and made a survey of the premises. Asked
as to the purpose of his visit, the contractor said that
he had been instructed by the agents to demolish the
houses and that as soon as a permit was obtained, bamboo
scaffolding would be erected.
After hearing the statement made by the contractor
the tenants decided to ask Lawyer Yuan to write a letter
to the Chinese Ratepayers Association and the Shanghai
Municipal Council to protest against the demolition and
simultaneously to insert an advertisement in the press
for the information of the public.

January 24, 1934.    4    Morning Translation.

Rent Reduction Movement in the French Concession

Since the 28th January Incident, trade in the
French Concession has declined. Many shops have closed
down and vacant premises are seen everywhere.
To remedy the situation, the Second Special District
Citizens Federation once proposed to organize a rent
reduction movement, but owing to lack of response from
other quarters, the proposal was abandoned.
Some time ago, a request was received from the
tenants of about 30 alleyways in the French Concession
urging that the movement be revived in cooperation with
the Rent Reduction Movement Committee for the whole city
of Shanghai.
In compliance with the request, the Federation
authorized the establishment of a rent reduction movement
committee for the Second Special District and on the
other hand with a view to obtaining unity permitted various
branches to set up sub-committees of the Federation's
Rent Reduction Movement Committee.

Rent Reduction Movement in Chapei

At a meeting of the Rent Reduction Movement Prepa=
ratory Committee organized by the various public bodies in
Chapei held at the Shang Yu Fellow Provincials Association
yesterday, the following resolutions were passed:-
1) That the committee be designated "The Chapei
Rent Reduction Movement Committee."
2) That Hu I-ping and 6 others be nominated to draw
up the regulations.
3) That Lawyers Wu Ching Ju and others be retained
as legal advisers for the Committee.
4) That no landlords or their agents be permitted
to join the Committee.
5) That the reduction in house rent in the Special
Districts be the basis for the reduction in Chapei.
6) That Wong Tse-tsiang and others be chosen to
get in touch with the Rent Reduction Movement Committee
of the Special Districts.
7) That no reduction in Municipal rates be requested.
8) That all the tenants in Chapei be notified to
send representatives to the Committee and that a manifesto
be issued to the public.

法租界减租运动

自“一·二八”事变以来，法租界贸易衰退。许多商店关门停业，空置房屋随处可见。
为扭转这一局面，第二特区市民联合会曾提议组织减租运动，但因其他方面响应寥寥，该提议被搁置。
不久前，法租界约30个弄堂的租户提出请求，敦促与上海市减租运动委员会合作，重启该运动。
应此请求，联合会授权成立第二特区减租运动委员会，另一方面，为求得统一，允许各分会设立联合会减租运动委员会的下属委员会。

闸北减租运动

在昨日上虞同乡会举行的由闸北各公团组织召开的减租运动筹备委员会会议上，通过了以下决议：-
1) 将该委员会定名为“闸北减租运动委员会”。
2) 提名胡一平等6人起草章程。
3) 聘请吴景儒律师等人为委员会法律顾问。
4) 不允许任何房东或其代理人加入委员会。
5) 以特区减租幅度作为闸北减租的基础。
6) 推选黄子祥等人与特区减租运动委员会取得联系。
7) 不要求减免市政捐税。
8) 通知闸北所有租户选派代表参加委员会，并向公众发布宣言。

New Tsun Cheo ( 新春秋 ), a mosquito 3 day periodical, publishes
the following article on 22 Jan.1934.

SEQUEL TO COURT FIRE

Some days ago, in the early morning, the kitchen
on the roof of the First Special District Court Building
caught fire.
Afterwards an investigation was ordered by the
President of the Court, Kuo Yun Kwan ( 郭雲觀 ) and the
two coolies named Wong Shu Hai ( 黃如海 ) and Wong Yung
Sung ( 黃榮生 ) were found to be at fault. President Kuo
ordered the two servants to be handed over to the Procu-
rator for interrogation.
As a result, the two servants were prosecuted
for infringing Item No.2, Article 187 of the Criminal
Code and were sentenced to two months' imprisonment each.
Considering that according to the Mixed Court
Rendition Agreement the power of the Procurator extends
from Articles 103 to 186 and that since the prosecution
referred to Article 187, the Procurator has acted ultra
vires, the Legal Department of the Shanghai Municipal
Council has lodged a protest with the Procurator.
As the case concerns the judicial power of
China, much significance is attached to the outcome of
the protest.

Min Sin Jih Pao ( 明星日報 ), a mosquito daily, publishes the
following correction on 20 Jan.1934.

"ZIA YUNG CHING AND THE POLICE"

Zia Yung Ching ( 謝雲卿 ) is a good actor, but
his conduct is not above reproach.
Some months ago, he established a club known
as "The 28th January Club" which has aroused the curiosity
of many people and is regarded as a joke.
Some time ago, he encountered a search party
on the street and was insulted by the Police, and Zia
told his friends how in return he had humbled the Police.
One of his audience subsequently wrote an article entitled
Zia Yung Ching and The Police" which was published by
this paper on 15 January.
Following the publication of the article, an
inquiry was set on foot, the result of which disclosed
that the incident mentioned in the article regarding his
Court action against the Police was a figment of his
imagination.
We therefore express regret for publishing
incorrect information.

《新春秋》，一种三日刊的小报，于1934年1月22日刊登以下文章。

法院火灾后续

数日前清晨，第一特区法院大楼屋顶的厨房发生火灾。
事后，法院院长郭雲觀下令调查，发现两名名为黃如海和黃榮生的苦力有过错。郭院长命令将这两名仆役移交检察官讯问。
结果，两名仆役因违反《刑法》第187条第2款被起诉，并各被判处两个月监禁。
鉴于根据《混合法庭交还协定》，检察官的权力范围涵盖第103条至第186条，而此次起诉援引的是第187条，检察官的行为属于越权，上海公共租界工部局法律处已向检察官提出抗议。
由于此案涉及中国的司法权，抗议的结果备受重视。

《明星日报》，一种小报，于1934年1月20日刊登以下更正。

“谢云卿与警察”

谢云卿是一位优秀的演员，但其品行并非无可指责。
数月前，他成立了一个名为“一·二八俱乐部”的社团，引起了众人的好奇，被视为笑谈。
前一段时间，他在街上遇到搜查队，并受到警察的侮辱，谢云卿告诉朋友他是如何反过来羞辱警察的。
他的一位听众随后写了一篇题为《谢云卿与警察》的文章，本报于1月15日刊登了该文。
文章发表后，展开了调查，结果显示文章中提到的他对警察提起诉讼一事纯属虚构。
因此，我们对发布不实信息表示歉意。

SHANGHAI WAR DEVASTATED AREAS FIRE INSURANCE COMPENSATION

Following the January 28th Incident, the

SHANGHAI GENERAL LABOUR UNION SUBMITS PETITION

The Shanghai General Labour Union yesterday
submitted a petition to the 4th Plenary Congress requesting
the National Government to instruct the Legislative Yuan
to revise the laws governing labour unions in order to have
general labour unions recognized in various provinces and
municipalities or to issue regulations to govern the
organization of the Shanghai General Labour Union. The
petition also requests the Central Peoples Movement
Committee to permit the registration of the Union at the
authorities prior to the promulgation of the new laws.

FORMER WORKERS REQUEST REEMPLOYMENT AT CHUNG HWA
VULCANIZING WORKS

The Chung Hwa Vulcanizing Works at Tsi Tao Jao
Road, Nantao, suspended operations in 1932. An agreement
between the management and the workers was concluded at the

Vulcanizing Trade Workers Union and the local Tangpu to
assist them in obtaining employment.
At 10 a.m. yesterday, members of the Union
accompanied by representatives of the operatives called at
the Vulcanizing Works Owners Association.

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

Yesterday about 50 persons representing the shops and residents on Heng Foong Road, Kung Woo Road and Dah Tung Road, Chapei, held a meeting in support of the movement for a reduction of house rentals in Chapei.
It was resolved to convene an inaugural meeting of the Chapei Municipal District House Rent Reduction Movement in conjunction with various public bodies in Chapei.
Upon receipt of a letter from the First Shanghai Special District Citizens Federation, the 13th Branch of the Federation has already detailed officials to make an investigation into the present rates of house rents in the alleyways and terraces under the jurisdiction of the Branch. A report to this effect was submitted yesterday to the First Shanghai Special District Citizens Federation and the House Rent Reduction Committee and they were requested to continue with the house rent reduction movement.

Rent Reduction Movement in French Concession

The Shanghai Second Special District Rent Reduction Movement Committee held a meeting yesterday afternoon at 434 Rue Poppe. More than ten members were present. Mr. Hwang Hsiang Ku presided. The following measures were discussed and passed:-
1. That this Committee be enlarged and that a proposal be submitted to the Executive Committee of the Citizens Federation that 12 committee members should be added to the Rent Reduction Movement Committee.
2. That tenants in the various terraces within this district be notified to submit reports regarding the oppression of the house owners.
3. That the next Committee meeting be held at 3 p.m. January 27.

January 20, 1934. Morning Translation

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

At a meeting held yesterday by the Executive Committee of the 18th District Branch of the First Shanghai Special District Citizens Federation at No. 160 Burkill Road, about 20 persons were present.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That a "Rent Reduction Committee" be formed and an Executive Committee of 17 members be elected; that citizens of this district be notified to register at our office.
2. That Ho Voong-ziang (胡鳳翔), Sung bih-woo (孫碧武) and three others be nominated members of the Standing Committee; that Ho Voong-ziang and Sung Bih-woo be appointed delegates to the meeting to be held by the "Shanghai Municipality Rent Reduction Committee".

China Evening News (Editorial):

Various local public bodies have recently organised the Rent Reduction Committee. According to yesterday's newspaper report, local foreign residents of various countries were about to hold a meeting to discuss the rent reduction movement. From the above, it will be seen that the promotion of the movement is the outcome of the sufferings of the majority of Shanghai residents.
The rents of houses in Shanghai are higher than those in any other part of China. In consequence of the high house rents, a one-story small residence houses as many as five families. The tenants sleep, eat and drink there and the smell in the house is even worse than that in a stable. A large part of the income of a family occupying a small corner of the house goes towards paying the rent, and in case of delay in payment, letters from lawyers or warnings from Court follow. The tenants are forced to remove or a part of their property is detained against the payment of the rent due. It is really difficult for us to reside in Shanghai.
Landlords possess capital and expect to obtain interest. In view of the market depression, they invest in the real estate business. During the past few years, a large number of wealthy people have become real estate dealers and the value of land in this locality has vastly increased. Due to the high cost of land and of the construction of houses, the landlords base the house rents on the value of the land and the houses. The interests of the tenants are ignored. Eager to obtain interest, the landlords pay attention in the construction of houses. Unoccupied houses are found everywhere.
The high costs of house rents and land are chiefly due to the congestion of the residents in the busy districts. In the event that the Municipality of Greater Shanghai will exert every effort to provide facilities in out-side districts and encourage real estate merchants to invest in these regions, house rents in the central districts will naturally decrease.
We request the Municipality of Greater Shanghai to consider the matter carefully.

2. 提名胡凤翔、孙碧武等三人为常务委员；任命胡凤翔和孙碧武为出席“上海市减租委员会”会议的代表。

《中国晚报》（社论）：

近期，各地方公共团体组织了减租委员会。据昨日新闻报道，在沪各国外籍居民拟举行会议讨论减租运动。由此可见，推动该运动是上海大多数居民受苦的结果。
上海的房价高于中国其他地区。由于房租高昂，一栋单层小住宅竟居住着多达五个家庭。租户在此睡觉、饮食，屋内气味甚至比马厩还糟糕。占据房屋一小角落的家庭，其大部分收入用于支付房租，一旦迟付，便会收到律师函或法院警告。租户被迫搬离，或部分财产被扣押以抵偿欠租。在上海居住确实困难。
房东拥有资本并期望获得利息。鉴于市场萧条，他们投资于房地产业。过去几年，大量富人成为房地产商，本地土地价值大幅上涨。由于土地成本和建房成本高，房东根据土地和房屋的价值确定房租。租户的利益被忽视。房东急于获取利息，注重房屋建设。空置房屋随处可见。
高房租和高地价主要是由于繁忙街区居民拥挤所致。如果大上海市政府竭尽全力在外围地区提供设施，并鼓励房地产商在这些地区投资，中心区的房租自然会下降。
我们请求大上海市政府慎重考虑此事。

January 19, 1934. Afternoon Translation

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

VARIOUS TRADE GUILDS TO DEMAND EXEMPTION FROM LAND TAX

Yesterday at 2 p.m. a meeting took place of various trade associations at the premises of the Shoe Guild on Neewoo Road in the city. About 40 persons representing more than 30 trade associations attended.
Loh Wei-chang (洛章), who took the chair, said that the Land Bureau of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai intended to collect land tax in accordance with the new assessments. The tax was 40 times greater than formerly, and the various guilds were unable to pay it.
The Chairman continued that a trade guild was a legal body and that its purpose was to promote the interests of the people in general and the merchants in particular. Formerly, temples which existed for the purpose of propagating superstitious beliefs were exempted from land tax. Since the work of the guilds was for the benefit of the people, it was reasonable to request that the property belonging to these guilds be exempted from the tax.
Following discussion, four resolutions were passed:
1) That a petition be presented in the name of the various trade guilds to the Ministries of Industry, Finance, and Home Affairs, the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, and the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, requesting the authorities to exempt the trade guilds from the land tax.
2) That Chiang Zai-shao and four others be chosen to compose the committee for drawing up the petition.
3) That a meeting of the committee be convened at 2 p.m. on 20 January.
4) That the office of the committee be located in the premises of the Shoe Guild.

THE HOUSE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

With a view to alleviating the burdens of the
people during the present period of depression, a house
rent reduction movement committee was proposed by the
various public organizations.
On 16th January, a meeting of representatives of
the public organizations was convened at the premises of
the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, North Soochow Road, at
which the regulations governing the organization of the
committee were passed and 35 persons were elected members
of the Committee.
It is ascertained that the first meeting of the
Committee will take place at 2 p.m. to-morrow at the Chinese
Chamber of Commerce and a notification has been issued
to the members.

Following the launching of a house rent reduction
movement by the various Chinese public organizations, many
foreign residents associations have decided to call a meeting
in a few days for the purpose of discussing the advisability
of joining the movement.
According to the opinions of foreign residents,
not only should the house rent be reduced, but charges for
electricity, gas, water and telephone service should also
be lowered, for they consider that the prevailing depression
has affected not only Chinese residents but the foreigners
as well. They contend that prices have dropped everywhere
in the world except in Shanghai, where the house rent and
rates for all public utilities have increased.
The reduction movement is being sponsored chiefly
by the Japanese Streets Federation, the White Russian
Merchants Federation, the Indian Federation, the Portuguese
Residents Association and other residents and trade asso-
ciations. Even a number of British residents are supporting
the movement.
In Shanghai, there are about 50,000 foreigners.
The total amount of house rent paid by them is nearly equal
to the amount paid by Chinese tenants (in the International
Settlement the Chinese pay about $3,000,000 while the
foreigners about $2,600,000), whereas the amounts of charges
paid by foreigners for electricity, water and gas are more
than those paid by Chinese.

据悉，委员会第一次会议将于明日下午2时在总商会举行，已向委员们发出通知。

在各华人公共组织发起减租运动之后，许多外侨协会决定在几天内召开会议，讨论加入该运动是否适宜。
据外侨意见，不仅应当降低房租，电费、煤气费、水费和电话服务费也应当降低，因为他们认为目前的萧条不仅影响了中国居民，也影响了外国人。他们主张，世界各地物价均已下跌，唯独上海房租和所有公用事业费率反而上涨。
此次减租运动主要由日人街道联合会、白俄商人联合会、印度人联合会、葡萄牙人居民协会以及其他居民和贸易协会发起。甚至一些英国居民也支持该运动。
在上海，外侨约有5万人。他们支付的房租总额几乎与中国租户支付的金额相等（在公共租界，中国人支付约300万元，而外国人支付约260万元），而外国人支付的电、水、煤气费用则多于中国人。
上海工部局对这些企业的管理拥有发言权，但实际权力掌握在这些公司的主要董事手中。鉴于

Shun Pao (Nanking Telegram):-

LORD MARLEY REQUESTS RELEASE OF NOULENS COUPLE

The Noulens couple are now in the Central
Hospital receiving medical treatment after fasting for
25 days.
Lord Marley will request all the supporters
of the Noulens couple in London to send a joint petition
to the Nanking Government demanding the release of the
couple.
According to the Judicial authorities, the Noulens
have already been convicted and will not be released.
Formerly, the World Anti-Imperialist League made the same
request for the release of Noulens, but it was ignored.
China is an independent country, and the Judiciary Organ
would not give any consideration to the request of the
League. The Noulens couple committed a crime in China,
therefore, they were subject to the jurisdiction of Chinese
Court. Interference cannot be tolerated.

China Times (Comment):

THE HOUSE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

As a result of the Shanghai Hostilities, a great
many people have become unemployed. Those who are still
employed have found that their income has been dwindling.
Nevertheless, the house rent has remained as high as ever.
We can economize on clothes, food and other expenses, but
we must pay the house rent. Should we owe one month's rent,
the rent collector would ask us to remove.
Now let us leave dwelling houses aside and consider
shop premises. In Shanghai, the most prosperous street
is Nanking Road, but it is reported that the turnover of the
firms now is far less than before the 28th January Incident.
Reductions in staff, salaries, etc. have become necessary
in order to maintain business, but a reduction in the
house rent has not been granted. Since business houses on
Nanking Road are in such a depressed state, you can imagine
the conditions of those situated on other roads. A walk
along Paoshan Road (Chapei) and North Szechuen Road will
convince you of the acute depression now prevailing.
Trade is in a deplorable condition and the people
are desperately poor, yet business men, factory owners
and house tenants are required to bear the oppression of
landlords. In fact, everybody is suffering except the
landlords.
If a city is prosperous, the house rents are high.
Conversely, if a city is not prosperous, the house rents
are low. However, in Shanghai, the rent before the war
when prosperity reigned has remained unaltered. The land-
lords alone are reaping the benefits.
Now that the people of Shanghai have found that
they are unable to bear such a burden, they have gathered
together and demanded a reduction of house rent. Such
a movement will no doubt have the sympathy of society,

马利勋爵要求释放努伦斯夫妇

努伦斯（Noulens）夫妇在绝食25天后，目前正在中央医院接受治疗。
马利勋爵（Lord Marley）将请求伦敦所有支持努伦斯夫妇的人士向南京政府发送联合请愿书，要求释放该夫妇。
据司法当局称，努伦斯夫妇已被定罪，不会获释。此前，世界反帝同盟曾提出同样的释放努伦斯的要求，但被忽视。中国是一个独立国家，司法机关不会考虑该同盟的请求。努伦斯夫妇在中国犯罪，因此受中国法院管辖。不容干涉。

《时报》（评论）：

减租运动

由于上海战事，许多人失业。那些仍有工作的人发现收入日益减少。然而，房租却居高不下。我们可以节省衣食和其他开支，但必须支付房租。如果我们欠一个月房租，收租员就会要求我们搬走。
现在让我们撇开住宅不谈，考虑一下店铺。在上海，最繁华的街道是南京路，但据报道，目前各商号的营业额远低于一·二八事变之前。为了维持经营，裁员、减薪等已成为必要，但房租并未降低。既然南京路的商家都处于如此萧条的状态，你可以想象其他道路上的商家状况如何。走在宝山路（闸北）和北四川路上，你会确信目前普遍存在的严重萧条。
贸易状况悲惨，人民极度贫困，但商人、工厂主和房屋租户却被要求承受房东的压迫。事实上，除了房东以外，每个人都在受苦。
如果城市繁荣，房租就高。反之，如果城市不繁荣，房租就低。然而，在上海，战前繁荣时期的房租一直保持不变。只有房东在独享利益。
现在上海人民发现无法承受如此重负，于是聚集起来要求降低房租。这样的运动无疑会得到社会的同情，

January 17, 1934. Morning Translation.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers.

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

At 2 p.m. yesterday, the First Shanghai Special District Citizens Federation held a meeting of representatives in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce building, North Soochow Road, to discuss the rent reduction movement. Over 100 persons representing some 50 local public bodies including the Ningpo Fellow Provincials Association, the Native Goods Factory Owners Federation and many branch associations of the Citizens Federation were present.
Zou Ts Kung ( 鄒志功 ) who presided, delivered the following address:-
"Since the January 28 War in Shanghai, the local market has collapsed and the number of unemployed has increased. Nanking Road was always noted for prosperity. However, due to high house rents, about 80 per cent of shops located on Nanking Road have closed down. Shanghai being the centre of civilization and commerce of China, trade depression in the city will affect the whole country. We should therefore exert every effort to carry out the movement to secure a reduction of house rents. The attendance is requested to express views regarding the campaign."
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That a manifesto be issued.
2. That a Rent Reduction Committee be formed.
3. That the Committee thoroughly discuss the rent reduction question.
4. That the illegal collection of house rents based on the lunar calendar be abolished.
5. That no increase in house rents follow a change in landlords.
6. That the rents of new houses do not exceed those of the old houses on that site.
7. That, regarding the letter received from the tenants in Tai Wu Ka Street ( 太和街 ), requesting that the engagement of a foreign attorney-at-law as agent to collect the house rents be prohibited, lawyers Fessenden and Holcomb be notified of the above.
The manifesto reads as follows:-
"Shanghai is the first commercial port of China and the district is densely populated. During the past few years, trade in this city has been declining and the number of unemployed has increased. Shops and factories have closed, many people have become unemployed, wives and children are sold and suicide is of every day occurrence.
"House rents in Shanghai are higher than those in every other part of China, while a few capitalists and real estate merchants, disregarding the welfare of the public, continually increase the rents. A large part of the income of a family goes towards paying the rent and in case of delay in payment, the landlords order rent collectors to resort to illegal actions and instruct lawyers to prosecute the tenants.
"As most landlords in this city are Chinese they should voluntarily reduce the house rents. Since their numbers are great, everyone will benefit.
"United support will ensure the success of the movement."

减租运动。

昨日下午2时，上海第一特区市民联合会在北苏州路华商总会大楼举行代表会议，讨论减租运动。包括宁波同乡会、国货工厂联合会以及市民联合会的许多分会在内的约50个本地公共团体的100多名代表出席了会议。
主持会议的邹志功（Zou Ts Kung）发表了如下讲话：
“自上海‘一·二八’事变以来，本地市场崩溃，失业人数增加。南京路向来以繁荣著称。然而，由于房租高昂，南京路上约80%的店铺已经关闭。上海作为中国文明和商业的中心，城市的贸易萧条将影响全国。因此，我们要竭尽全力开展争取降低房租的运动。请与会者就此次运动发表意见。”
会议通过了以下决议：
1. 发布宣言。
2. 成立减租委员会。
3. 由委员会彻底讨论减租问题。
4. 废除按农历非法收取房租的做法。
5. 房东变更不得导致房租上涨。
6. 新建房屋的租金不得超过该地块原有房屋的租金。
7. 关于太和街（Tai Wu Ka Street）租户来信要求禁止聘请外国律师作为代理人收取房租一事，通知费森登（Fessenden）和霍尔科姆（Holcomb）两位律师上述情况。
宣言内容如下：
“上海是中国第一大通商口岸，人口稠密。过去几年，本市贸易衰退，失业人数增加。商店和工厂关闭，许多人失业，卖妻鬻子，自杀事件每日发生。
“上海的房租高于中国其他地区，而少数资本家和房地产商不顾公众福利，不断抬高租金。家庭收入的大部分用于支付房租，一旦迟付，房东便命令收租人采取非法行动，并指示律师起诉租户。
“由于本市大多数房东是中国人，他们应自愿降低房租。鉴于其人数众多，人人皆将受益。
“团结一致的支持将确保运动的成功。”

January 16, 1934.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

Upon receipt of requests from various branch federations, a decision was reached at a meeting held by the Executive Committee of the First Shanghai Special District Citizens Federation to the effect that a "Rent Reduction Movement Committee" be organized. Letters have been despatched to the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, the General Labour Union, the Bar Association, the Chinese Ratepayers Association and the Farmers Federation asking for support.

Realizing that a reduction in house rentals is a movement that concerns the people, the various organizations will hold a meeting at 2 p.m. to-day in the premises of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. Measures to secure a rent reduction will be discussed.

The Second Shanghai Special District Citizens Federation is supporting the rent reduction movement. At a meeting held by the Executive Committee some days ago, two representatives were appointed to discuss the question and co-operate with the First Shanghai Special District Citizens Federation.

Forms for ascertaining the amount of house rentals have been printed by various street unions on East Yuhong Road, Broadway, East Seward Road, Pingliang Road and Yangtzepoo Road, and various branch citizens federations on Avenue Road, Burkill Road, Kuling Road, Park Road, Changsha Road, Nanking Road, Peking Road, Ningpo Road, Foochow Road, and Honan Road. Officials were despatched yesterday to various districts to commence registration in order to secure united support for the rent reduction movement.

It is reported that the Six Roads Merchants Union, the West Gate Merchants Union and other public organizations in various municipal districts in Nantao are also devising ways and means to start a movement for the rent reduction in order that the livelihood of the citizens may be maintained.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

DISPUTE OVER INCREASE OF HOUSE RENT

The tenants in Shao Ping Li (寿品里), Ward Road, received a letter from the house owners in November last year stating that their house rents would be increased commencing from January 1, 1934. The tenants held a conference immediately and lawyer Yuan Yiang An (袁仰安) was engaged to oppose the increase.

On January 10, the tenants received another letter from the house owners notifying them to remove before January 20, otherwise, the water rate in the terrace would not be paid by the owners. This notice has also been inserted in the various local newspapers.

The tenants held a meeting yesterday and the local municipal authorities and the various public bodies will be requested to submit a protest regarding the increase.

January 15, 1934. Morning Translation

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE HOUSE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

The following notification was issued yesterday
by the 9th Branch of the First Special District Citizens
Federation:-
"Depression has prevailed as a result of the
Shanghai Hostilities. Prices have dropped. Farming
villages are on the verge of bankruptcy, while the
livelihood of the city dwellers is in danger. Nevertheless
the house rent in this city is still as high as ever
before.
"With a view to alleviating the burdens of the
people, the Branch has started a movement for a reduction
in house rent.
"In order that the movement may obtain united
support, citizens and firms on Avenue, Burkill, Kuling,
Park, Changsha, Nyburgh, Shanhaikuan, Chengtu, Tatung
and Carter Roads are hereby requested to register at
the office of the Branch at 160 Burkill Road."
Yesterday a meeting of the Executive Committee
of the 31st Branch of the Federation took place at 2 p.m.
at the office of the Branch on Elgin Road. Some ten
members were present. After discussion, the following
resolutions were passed:-
1) That a manifesto on the house rent reduction
movement be issued.
2) That a committee for the house rent reduction
movement be organized.
3) That the members of the Executive Committee be
concurrently members of the house rent reduction committee.
4) That a house rent investigation form be distributed.
5) That a notification be issued to the people in
the area subject to the supervision of the Branch to return
the investigation form within three days.
6) That proposals for a reduction in house rent be
brought before the meeting to be held on 16 January of
the various public organizations.
It is learned that the meeting of the various
public organizations to discuss the launching of a house
rent reduction movement will take place to-morrow at the
premises of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, North Soochow
Road.

China Times and other local newspapers:

PEOPLE'S AEROPLANES TO GIVE EXHIBITION ON 28 JAN.

The following letter from the Shanghai Merchants
National Salvation Federation was addressed yesterday to
the Aviation Federation:-
"Your Federation was organized following the
cessation of the Shanghai Hostilities with the object of
improving China's air force. Funds were contributed by
the people and over ten 'planes were purchased.
"Now that the Second Anniversary of the 28th Jan-
uary is near, we would ask you to make arrangements for
these machines to give an exhibition on that occasion in
order to arouse the patriotism of the people and to remind
them of the humiliations suffered at that time."

The Shun Pao Screen Section publishes the following article:-

THE NEW STANDARD OF JAPANESE FILM CENSORSHIP

The Japanese film industry is mostly used
for propaganda purposes. Films produced by any film
company will only be allowed to be screened when they
are in accordance with certain principles. For example,
love pictures and pictures showing social conditions
are not allowed, while military films which serve as
propaganda for the militarists are highly recommended.
Recently, the Education Ministry of Japan,
promulgated new rules governing film censorship of
foreign films and films produced in Japan and the
principle to be applied is that all films should
propagate the doctrine of militarism.
Japan permits few foreign films to be
screened within her territory, because she deems that
most foreign films are unfit for screening in the
country. Therefore, few productions from Hollywood
are seen in Japan. The new regulations of Japanese
film censorship forbid the screening of all love films
and anti-war films also may not be screened in
Japan. For this reason, fewer foreign films than
ever can now be screened there.
The films which depict the wars in the North-
East are highly praised by the Japanese Government.
Most Japanese films are silent.
Hereafter, the Japanese film companies will
be the propaganda organs of the Japanese militarists.

《申报》电影版刊登如下文章：

日本电影审查新标准

日本电影业大多用于宣传目的。任何电影公司制作的影片只有符合某些原则才允许放映。例如，爱情片和社会状况片不被允许，而作为军国主义宣传工具的军事影片则受到大力推荐。
近日，日本文部省颁布了针对外国电影和日本国产电影审查的新规则，其适用原则是所有电影都应宣扬军国主义学说。
日本允许在其境内放映的外国电影很少，因为她认为大多数外国电影不适合在该国放映。因此，在日本很少能看到好莱坞的作品。日本电影审查新规禁止放映所有爱情片，反战电影也不得在日本放映。因此，现在在那里能放映的外国电影比以往任何时候都少。
描绘东北战争的影片受到日本政府的高度赞扬。大多数日本电影是无声片。
此后，日本电影公司将成为日本军国主义者的宣传机构。

January 12, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

Ningpo Jih Pao (寧波日報) publishes the following comment:-

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

Shanghai is the centre of industry and commerce of China and the city is densely populated. Increases in the value of land and the rents of houses must be in accordance with the prosperity of the residents. The movement recently promoted by various local public bodies to secure a reduction in house rents is of much significance.

Trades in this city have been in a state of depression and to maintain business merchants have reduced the prices of all products. The house rents, however, still remain high. A reduction in house rents is essential.

House rents here are extremely high and even a very small room in the International Settlement or the French Concession costs at least $5 or $6 per month. People whose income is small suffer great hardships and the interests of these poor people must be carefully considered. The rent reduction movement will become more powerful and success will be attained if the poor residents join in the struggle.

Residents throughout Shanghai should be urged to participate in the recent rent reduction movement and district representatives should be appointed to carry out the work. An appeal should first be made to the Chinese and the Settlement authorities and then definite steps should be taken to ensure the success of the movement.

《宁波日报》刊登如下评论：-

减租运动。

上海是中国工商业的中心，人口稠密。地价和房租的上涨必须与居民的繁荣程度相称。近期由当地各公共团体发起的旨在降低房租的运动具有重要意义。

本市各行业处于萧条状态，商家为维持生意已降低所有产品的价格。然而，房租依然高企。降低房租势在必行。

此间房租极高，即使在公共租界或法租界，一间很小的房间每月租金也至少需5或6元。收入微薄者深受其苦，必须仔细考虑这些贫困人群的利益。如果贫困居民加入斗争，减租运动将变得更加有力并取得成功。

应敦促全上海居民参与近期的减租运动，并指派各区代表开展相关工作。应先向中方及租界当局提出呼吁，随后采取明确步骤以确保运动成功。

教育部最近委派部总务司司长雷震（La Tseng）来沪，秘密调查暨南大学纠纷。据悉雷氏已完成任务并返回南京。华侨事务委员会教育处处长陈春圃（Chen Chun-pu）昨日在接受上海新闻社记者采访时发表如下声明：“我已对暨南大学的骚乱进行了调查。除非纠纷得到解决，否则年终期末考试将不在该校举行。该校校长郑洪年（Chen Hung-nyien）表示不会辞职。”
昨日，请愿团学生拜访了孙科先生、吴铁城市长及其他暨南大学校董，校董们承诺将在数日内召开校董会议讨论此事。
暨南大学校友会将于1月11日下午2时在汉口路66号举行会议。
昨日下午3时，郑洪年下令锁闭校长室、秘书室及学生注册室。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

租户反对加租。

新闸路传福里（Chuang Fu Li）的房东将从今年2月起将房租提高30%。
鉴于目前经济萧条，当地居民大多要求减租，租户认为此次加租极不合理，租户联合会昨日召开会议，决议请求房东不要加租。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

伪满洲国旅行团离开上海。

所谓由74人组成的伪满洲国参观团于1月2日从长春抵达此处，并于7日离开上海前往伪满洲国。该团中仅有一名中国人，其余均为日本人。

January 10, 1934.
Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

The First Special District Citizens Federation
some time ago set up a Rent Reduction Movement Committee.
In pursuance of a resolution passed at the 7th
meeting of the Executive Committee, the Federation will
call a meeting of representatives of various branches at
2 p.m. to-day at the premises of the Chinese Chamber of
Commerce, North Soochow Road, for the purpose of discussing
the launching of a rent reduction movement.
It is understood that the Rent Reduction Movement
Committee will convene a meeting at the Chinese Chamber of
Commerce on the 13th. The General Labour Union, the
Chinese Chamber of Commerce, the Chinese Bar Association
and other Fellow Provincials Associations have been notified
to send representatives to the meeting.

Special District Citizens' Federation

Committee" of the 1st Special District Citizens' Federation
held a meeting in their office, Chinese Chamber of
Commerce building, 1 North Soochow Road, between 3 p.m.
and 4 p.m. January 8. Chang Ih-zung (怡一塵), a

January 9, 1934.                                  Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:
DISPUTE AMONG STUDENTS AT THE CHINAN UNIVERSITY.
Shortly after 1 p.m. yesterday, Chon Chun-pu
( 陈君朴 ), Chief of the Educational Department of the
Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee, made an investigation
into the dispute among students of the Chinan University.
About 80 graduates of the Chinan University
yesterday issued a notice that a meeting would be held
at 2 p.m. January 11 at No. 68 Hankow Road and graduates
and ex-students of the University are expected to attend.
(Nanking Telegram):
According to information secured from the
Ministry of Education, the report of principal Zung's
resignation is untrue.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:
RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.
At 3 p.m. yesterday, the "Rent Reduction
Movement Committee", formed by the First Shanghai Special
District Citizens Federation, held a meeting in the
premises of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce at which
it was decided to issue a manifesto, address a letter
to the house owners and urge the various branches of
the Citizens Federation to support the movement.

China Times and other local newspapers:
REMOVAL OF THE LOCAL KUOMINTANG HEADQUARTERS
The local Kuomintang Headquarters has decided
to take over the premises until lately occupied by the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai
It is learned that a temporary hospital under
the auspices of the Municipality will be established on
on the old site of the Kuomintang Headquarters.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-
BOLES THROWN TO DYE MERCHANT'S HOUSE
At 6 p.m. yesterday, a bomb was thrown into
the house of a local wealthy dye merchant named Peh
Jung Sen, at No.5, Lane 25, Rue Admiral Bayle.
The bomb exploded in the garden but no one was injured.
The French Police are now making
investigations.

暨南大学学生纠纷。
昨日下午1时许，华侨事务委员会教育处处长陈君朴（Chon Chun-pu，音译）就暨南大学学生纠纷进行调查。
约80名暨南大学毕业生昨日发出通知，定于1月11日下午2时在汉口路68号举行会议，预计该校毕业生及校友将出席。
（南京电）：
据从教育部获得的消息，关于郑校长辞职的报道不实。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：
减租运动。
昨日下午3时，由上海第一特区市民联合会组成的“减租运动委员会”在中国商会会所举行会议，决定发布宣言，致函房东，并敦促市民联合会各分会支持该运动。

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸：
国民党市党部迁移
国民党市党部决定接管原大上海市政府使用的房屋。
据悉，将在国民党市党部旧址设立一所由市立临时医院。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：
炸弹投掷至染料商住宅
昨日下午6时，一枚炸弹被投进位于贝勒路25弄5号的一位名为白荣森（Peh Jung Sen，音译）的本地富有的染料商家中。
炸弹在花园内爆炸，无人受伤。
法国警察正在进行调查。

January 9, 1934.    2    Afternoon Translation.

China Evening News (Tsinan telegram):

TRAIN ROBBERY.

At 1 a.m. January 8 when the third express of the
Tientsin-Pukow Railway was proceeding to Haipong Kow,
some ten bandits, who were already on the train, drew
out pistols. Two compelled the driver to stop the
engine, while more than thirty other bandits lurking in
the vicinity boarded the train. Men of the Peace
Preservation Corps, numbering six in all, offered resistance
but were disarmed. The gangsters ransacked the train
and robbed the passengers of money and all valuables.
One man of the Peace Preservation Corps received a bullet
in the arm and four coolies were injured.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

At a meeting held at 2 p.m. yesterday by the House
Rent Reduction Movement Committee which was recently
formed by the First Special District Citizens Federation,
the following decisions were passed:-
1) That the various Street Unions be advised to
organize sub-committees to support the movement.
2) That the various public bodies be invited to
participate in a meeting to be held at 2 p.m. January 13
to devise ways and means to deal with this matter.
It is reported that in order to strengthen the
house rent reduction movement to be conducted by the
various Street Unions, the Federation will hold a meeting
of representatives at 2 p.m. January 10. A notice to
this effect was sent out yesterday.

China Times and other local newspapers:

PRINCIPALS TO DEMAND SALARIES

Despite the 28th January Event, salaries for the
teachers of the educational institutions established by
the Municipality of Greater Shanghai have been paid until
three months ago.
Yesterday at 10 a.m. principals of the various,
numbering some 70 persons proceeded to the Bureau of
Education at the new Civic Centre to present a petition.
They were received by the Commissioner of Education,
Mr. Pan Kungtsai, and Mayor Wu Te-chen, who promised the
visitors that one month's salary would be issued in a
few days and that the arrears would be cleared before the
end of the China New Year.
The assembly then retired satisfied with the answer.
It is understood that principals of the schools
in the suburban districts are also preparing for a march
to the Municipality to request payment of their salaries.

《中国晚报》（济南电）：

火车抢劫案。

1月8日凌晨1时，津浦铁路第三列特快列车驶向海丰口（Haipong Kow，音译）途中，已在车上的十余名匪徒拔出手枪。两人强迫司机停车，另有三十多名潜伏在附近的匪徒登上列车。共六名保安队队员进行抵抗，但被缴械。匪徒洗劫列车，抢走乘客钱财及所有贵重物品。一名保安队队员手臂中弹，四名苦力受伤。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动。

在由第一特区市民联合会近期成立的房屋减租运动委员会于昨日下午2时举行的会议上，通过了以下决定：
1) 建议各街道工会组织小组委员会以支持该运动。
2) 邀请各公共团体参加将于1月13日下午2时举行的会议，商讨处理此事的方法。
据报道，为了加强由各街道工会开展的房屋减租运动，联合会将于1月10日下午2时召开代表会议。相关通知已于昨日发出。

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸：

校长要求发放薪水

尽管发生了一·二八事变，大上海市政府所属教育机构的教师薪水直至三个月前仍在发放。
昨日上午10时，约70名各校校长前往新市中心教育局呈递请愿书。他们受到教育局长潘公展先生和市长吴铁城的接见，二人向来访者承诺，数日内将发放一个月薪水，并在农历新年前清欠薪。
与会者对答复表示满意后散去。
据悉，郊区学校校长也在准备游行至市政府，要求发放薪水。

January 8, 1934. Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers :-

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

In view of the high rentals of houses, the
First Shanghai Special District Citizens Federation on
January 6 held a meeting at which nine members were
appointed to form a "Rent Reduction Movement Committee."
The Preparatory Committee will hold a meeting
at 2 p.m. today in the premises of the Chinese Chamber of
Commerce at which measures to secure a reduction in rentals
will be discussed.
It is reported that various branches of the
District Citizens Federation will convene a meeting at
2 p.m. tomorrow.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers :-

MEETING OF CHINESE RATEPAYERS ASSOCIATION OF
FRENCH CONCESSION

At a general meeting held at 2 p.m. yesterday
by the Chinese Ratepayers Association in the premises of
the Shantung Guild on Route Forte de l'Ouest, the
following resolutions were passed :-
1. That Messrs Doo Yueh-sun (杜月笙), Zung Tso-sun (臧卓孫),
King Lih-jen (金立人) and 16 others be elected members
of the Executive Committee of the Association.
2. That Messrs Chang Siao-ling (張嘯林), Wong King Yoong
(黃景榮) and three others be appointed members of the
Supervisory Committee.
3. That Messrs Chang Siao-ling, Loh Psh-hung (陸伯鴻),
Chu Yih-tze (朱義之), Zien Yun-tsin (錢雲青) and Woo
Kai-sun (吳凱孫) be nominated Chinese Councillors to
the French Municipal Council.
4. That Zung Tso-sun, King Lih-jen, Tai Chun-foong (戴春風),
King Ting-sun (金定孫), Toong Keh-chong (董克昌), Chen
Tuh-tsang (陳德藏) and Chang Chi-sie (張繼燮) be
nominated as Chinese Committeemen to the Council.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

CHIANG HSUEH-LIANG IS COMING TO SHANGHAI TO-DAY.

Marshal Chang Hsueh-liang is expected to arrive in
Shanghai at 4 p.m. to-day by the S.S. "Conte Verde."
Mr. T.V. Soong, A Standing Committee member of the National
Economic Commission, Mayor Wu Te-chen, General Yang Fu,
Chief of the Peace Preservation Corps, and many North-Eastern
Generals, who came to Shanghai recently, will welcome him
at the Kung Wu Ziang Wharf (公和祥碼頭), Hongkew. Some
noted Italian aviators will arrive on the same vessel.
Upon arrival here, the Marshal will stay at his
temporary residence, No. 2 Rue Moliere, French Concession.
It is learned that Marshal Chang will proceed to
Nanking at the time of the opening of the 4th Plenary Congress,

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动

鉴于房租高昂，上海第一特区市民联合会于1月6日召开会议，任命九名成员组成“减租运动委员会”。

据报道，该区市民联合会各分会将于明日下午2时召开会议。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

法租界华人纳税会会议

昨日下午2时，华人纳税会在西爱咸斯路山东会馆会所举行大会，通过以下决议：
1. 选举杜月笙（Doo Yueh-sun）、臧卓孫（Zung Tso-sun）、金立人（King Lih-jen）等16人为本会执行委员会委员。
2. 委任张啸林（Chang Siao-ling）、黄景荣（Wong King Yoong）等三人为监察委员会委员。
3. 提名张啸林、陆伯鸿（Loh Psh-hung，音译）、朱义之（Chu Yih-tze，音译）、钱云青（Zien Yun-tsin，音译）和吴凯孙（Woo Kai-sun，音译）为法国公董局华董。
4. 提名臧卓孫、金立人、戴春风（Tai Chun-foong，音译）、金定孙（King Ting-sun，音译）、董克昌（Toong Keh-chong，音译）、陈德藏（Chen Tuh-tsang，音译）和张继燮（Chang Chi-sie，音译）为公董局华委。

张学良今日抵沪。

预计张学良将军将于今日下午4时乘“康特·维尔德”号（S.S. "Conte Verde"）轮抵达上海。全国经济委员会常务委员宋子文先生、市长吴铁城、保安总队队长杨虎将军以及近期来沪的多位东北军将领，将在虹口公和祥码头迎接他。几位著名的意大利飞行员也将乘坐同一艘轮船抵达。
抵沪后，将军将寓居法租界莫利哀路2号的临时住所。
据悉，张学良将军将在第四届中央全会开幕时前往南京，

January 7, 1934. Morning Translation

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

DISPUTE BETWEEN RAILWAY WORKERS

Some time ago the workers employed at the Woosung
Workshed of the Shanghai-Nanking and Shanghai-Kowchow-
Ningpo Railway Administration declared a "go-slow" strike
as a protest against the action of Moh Ung, Chief of the
General Affairs Department of the Administration. In
consequence of the advice of various parties the workers
resumed work pending a decision. As no decision has so
far been reached regarding the dismissal of Moh Ung,
yesterday morning the workers submitted petitions to the
S-N & S-K-K Railway Workers Union and Mr. Woo Zao Tseng,
Assistant Director of the Administration.
The latter informed the callers that the case will
be settled at a meeting to be held on January 8 or January 9.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

DISPUTE BETWEEN RICE PORTERS AND WHEELBARROW COOLIES

In connection with the dispute between the rice
porters and the wheelbarrow coolies of rice hongs along the
Soochow Creek at Sin Zah Jao Bridge, Chapei, the Bureau of
Social Affairs held a meeting on January 5 at which it was
decided that the Public Safety Bureau be requested to cancel
the permission issued to the Rice Transport Co.
It is learned that various rice dealers in Chapei
will hold a meeting within the next three days at which
measures to deal with the matter will be devised.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE HOUSE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

At 2 p.m. yesterday the First Shanghai Special
District Citizens Federation held an emergency meeting at the
Chinese Chamber of Commerce for a reduction of house rent.
Over 30 members of the federation were present and one
Chang Ik Zung (张一麐) presided at the meeting. After
discussion the following resolutions were passed :-
1. That Yik Ke Shing and 8 others be appointed to organize
the "House Rent Reduction Committee" and that various
public bodies be requested to participate in the movement.
2. That a meeting of the "House Rent Reduction Committee"
and a general meeting of various branches of the First
Shanghai Special District Citizens Federation be held
on January 8 and January 10 respectively.
3. That the movements of the tenants at Ning Kung Li,
Chekiang Road; Zun An Li, Kunlin Road and Huh Shing Li,
Park Road be supported and that letters be written to the
houseowners opposing the increase of rents.
4. That a meeting of various bodies be held on January 9
with a view to devise measures for the release of Lieu
Zoong Oo and others who were sentenced for patriotic
movements.
5. That a letter be written to the Shanghai Insurance Co.,
a British firm, asking the company to pay compensation to
Tsha Chang Kee (蔡钦记), No.1 Wonglo Road.

《民报》及其他本地报纸：-

铁路工人纠纷

此前，京沪与沪杭甬铁路管理局吴淞工场工人宣布“怠工”罢工，以抗议管理局总务处处长莫昂（Moh Ung，音译）的行为。经各方劝告，工人在等待决定期间恢复了工作。由于至今尚未就解雇莫昂一事作出决定，昨日上午工人们向沪杭甬铁路工会及管理局副局长吴兆曾（Woo Zao Tseng，音译）先生递交了请愿书。
后者告知来访者，该案将在1月8日或1月9日举行的会议上解决。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：-

米业搬运工与独轮车苦力之间的纠纷

关于闸北新渣桥（Sin Zah Jao Bridge，音译）苏州河沿岸米行米业搬运工与独轮车苦力之间的纠纷，社会局于1月5日召开会议，决定请求公安局撤销发给米业运输公司的许可。
据悉，闸北各家米商将在未来三天内举行会议，制定处理此事的措施。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：-

房屋减租运动

昨日下午2时，上海第一特区市民联合会在商会召开紧急会议，商讨减租事宜。联合会30多名成员出席，张一麐（Chang Ik Zung）主持会议。经讨论，通过以下决议：-
1. 任命叶吉生（Yik Ke Shing，音译）等8人组织“房屋减租委员会”，并请求各公共团体参与该运动。
2. “房屋减租委员会”会议及上海第一特区市民联合会各分部大会分别于1月8日和1月10日举行。
3. 支持浙江路宁康里、昆岭路（Kunlin Road，音译）尊安里（Zun An Li，音译）和公园路恒兴里的租户运动，并致函房主反对加租。
4. 于1月9日召开各团体会议，旨在制定措施，释放因爱国运动被判刑的刘宗伍（Lieu Zoong Oo，音译）等人。
5. 致函英商上海保险公司，要求该公司向旺罗路1号蔡钦记（Tsha Chang Kee）支付赔偿金。

January 6, 1933.
Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE HOUSE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

In consequence of the 28th January Incident
and the prevailing economic depression, the local
market has become worse and worse. Everyday factories
and shops close down. The purchase power of the
people has become weaker and weaker and prices have
dropped lower and lower. Nevertheless, the house rent
has remained as high as ever before, and in some cases
has increased.
Being unable to bear the heavy burdens, the
people have clamoured for a reduction in house rents
and in response to their request the First Special
District Citizens Federation has decided to hold an
emergency meeting at 2 p.m. to-day at the Chinese
Chamber of Commerce, North Soochow Road, to discuss
measures for a movement for a reduction of house rent
in cooperation with other public influential organizations
with a view to securing peace for the community.

Sin Wan Pao and other local

As the people are complaining of the high cost
in house rent, the various branches of the First Special
District Citizens Federation at Hongke have formed a
"House Rent Reduction Movement Committee."
It is ascertained from a notification issued
by the Committee that a meeting will be convened at
2 p.m. to-morrow at the office of the 15th Branch, Teh
An Lee alley-way, North Soochow Road, at which a movement
for a reduction of house rent in collaboration with other
public bodies will be discussed.

China Times and other local newspapers:

OWNER OF PUBLIC RICKSHAW MURDERED

Chen Teh Hsing (陳德興), native of Tachow, was
murdered at his home at 11.30 p.m. January 4.
Chen was 33 years of age and engaged in renting
rickshaws for hire. He lived with his wife at No.5, Hai
Yuen Lee alley-way, Ching Yun Road, Chapei.
On the fatal evening, he was awoken by a knock
on the door. When he opened the door, about five or six
persons rushed in, one of whom produced a pistol and shot
at him twice, after which they decamped. Afterwards a
man came into the house and took away an empty trunk from
the room of the dead man.
It is surmised according to the evidence given
by the wife that the motive of the murder was revenge.

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸：

房屋减租运动

受一·二八事变及当前经济萧条的影响，本地市场日益恶化。工厂和商店每日倒闭。民众购买力越来越弱，物价越来越低。然而，房租却居高不下，甚至在某些情况下有所上涨。
因无法承受沉重负担，民众呼吁降低房租。应其请求，第一特区市民联合会决定于今日下午2时在北路苏州路商会举行紧急会议，与其他有影响力的公共组织合作，讨论开展减租运动的措施，以谋求社区安宁。

《新闻报》及其他本地

由于民众抱怨房租高昂，第一特区市民联合会虹口各分部已成立“房屋减租运动委员会”。
据该委员会发出的通知获悉，将于明日下午2时在北路苏州路德安里15分部办事处召开会议，讨论与其他公共团体合作开展减租运动的事宜。

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸：

公共人力车车主被谋杀

泰州籍人陈德兴（Chen Teh Hsing）于1月4日晚11时30分在家中遇害。
陈年33岁，从事出租人力车业务。他与妻子住在闸北青云路海元里5号。
案发当晚，他被敲门声惊醒。当他打开门时，约五六人冲入屋内，其中一人掏出手枪向他开了两枪，随后逃窜。之后，一名男子进入屋内，从死者房间拿走了一只空箱子。
据其妻子提供的证词推测，谋杀动机为报复。

Unrest now exists among the residents of 20
houses of the Huh Shing (合兴里), Park Road, who are

The tenants led by Tao Ping-chwang (陶彬年), Wong

Fishing Industry Protection Office - established
in City

A Fishing Industry Protection Office which was
recently established by the Ministry of Industry at No.56
Kong Ka Loong, Small East Gate, commenced functioning on
January 4 with one Yuan Liang Hwa (袁良驊) as Chief.
The office will be responsible for the protection of
fishing vessels while at sea.

Shanghai Educational Association - Office removed

was removed on January 4 from 1474 Min Kuo Road, West
Gate, to the former offices of the Bureau of Education

THE RENT REMISSION MOVEMENT.

Sandle Wood and Dried Longan Shops on Fokien Road
- agitate against S.M.C.'s instruction to take
out food shop licences

Some eighty persons who claimed to be representatives
of various local bodies were entertained to dinner at 7 p.m.
December 20 in the Dah Kwan Inn Restaurant, No.178 Foochow
Road, by the proprietors of thirteen Sandle Wood and Dried
Longan Shops on Fokien Road. Chiu Liang Neo (邱良友),
manager of the Sing Huh Tsung (新合春) Sandle Wood and
Dried Longan Shop, 11/13 Fokien Road, who presided addressed
the attendance stating that the above shops had been informed
by the Health Department of the S.M.C. that they would be
required to take out from this month (December) a food shop
licence if they wished to continue business. Nevertheless,
the speaker continued, the trade conducted by the shops
which sell sandle wood and longan as well as several other
kinds of dried fruits does not necessitate their holding
such a licence. Finally he urged the attendance to render
assistance to the shops in connection with the dispute.

of Citizens' Federation

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

MOVEMENT FOR A REDUCTION IN HOUSE RENTS.

The 29th Branch Association of the First Special
District Citizens Federation, at a meeting held at 8 p.m.
yesterday, passed the following resolutions:-
1) That the following measures be carried out to
secure a reduction in house rents:-
a) A manifest be issued.
b) Copies of a form on which the amount of house rents
and the names of the landlords are to be filled in
be distributed.
c) Chinese public bodies in this locality be requested
to support the movement.
d) A Rent Reduction Movement Committee be organised.
2) That the Association undertake the settlement
of all disputes among the citizens in the district.

THE NORTH-CHINA SUNDAY NEWS, JULY 10, 1932

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. S. B. REGISTER

RENT REMISSION
DISPUTE

Chinese Authorities'
Proclamation

WAR SUFFERERS NOT
TO PAY

The dispute which has been going
on between residents of the areas
involved in the recent Sino-Japanese
hostilities and their landlords over
the payment of rents for the period
of the fighting and for the two
months immediately following the
cessation of hostilities has resulted
in the City Government of Greater
Shanghai issuing a proclamation
ordering the remission of rents for
periods extending from one to three
months.
In the proclamation, the authori-
ties state:—
"After the outbreak of hostilities
on January 28, people living in the
war zones and the immediate vicinity
suffered heavily. In consequence,
there has been a general demand on
the part of residents for a remission
of house rents for the period of the
trouble, while the attitude of realty
owners is firmly to the contrary.
Disputes have ensued and ,unless
this matter is solved without delay,
both sides will suffer heavily. Alth-
ough cases of this nature are really
within the jurisdiction of the
judicial authorities, the following
arrangements have been made by
the City Government of Greater
Shanghai and must be observed ac-
cordingly:—
"The remission of house rents in
Woosung, Kiangwan, Yinghong,
Chenju, Pangpu, Yingshiangkong,
Chapei, etc. (including the extra-
Settlement roads in the northern
district), should be for a period of
three months;
"Two and a half months for
houses north of Soochow Creek and
west of the North Szechuen Road
Creek;
"Two months for houses east of
North Szechuen Road Creek and in
Yangtzepoo and the vicinity; and
"One month for houses in Nantao,
in the Rubicon and Monument Road
areas, and north of Soochow
Creek."

免租
纠纷

中国当局
公告

战争受灾者
无需支付

近期中日战事涉及地区的居民与其房东之间，就战斗期间及停战后两个月内的租金支付问题一直存在纠纷，这导致大上海市政府发布公告，命令免除一至三个月不等的租金。
在公告中，当局声明：
“1月28日战事爆发后，生活在战区及附近地区的人们遭受了严重损失。因此，居民普遍要求在动荡期间减免房租，而房地产业主的态度则坚决相反。随之产生了纠纷，如果不立即解决此事，双方都将遭受严重损失。虽然此类案件实际上属于司法当局的管辖范围，但大上海市政府已作出以下安排，必须遵照执行：—
“吴淞、江湾、引翔、陈如、彭浦、营房口、闸北等地（包括北区界外道路）的房屋租金，应免除三个月；
“苏州河北岸及北四川路浜以西的房屋，免除两个半月；
“北四川路浜以东以及杨树浦及其附近的房屋，免除两个月；以及
“南市、卢比孔河（Rubicon）及纪念碑路地区，以及苏州河北岸的房屋，免除一个月。”

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, WEDNESDAY JULY 6, 1932V
S. B. REGISTER
3482
717132

Landlords Complete Victors
In Important "Test Case"

Thirteen Tenants In Chekiang Road District
Instructed To Pay Arrears, Judge Yang
Holding "Not In War Zone"

A "test" case which will probably influence verdicts in lawsuits involving between 15 to 20 million dollars ended yesterday in the First Special District Court when Judge Yang Bang handed down judgment in favour of Messrs. Algar and Company, in the suits brought by them against 13 tenants who had refused to pay rent for the months of February and March, owing to the Sino-Japanese hostilities.

The total sum of awards totalled merely Tls. 3,186, but the case has been followed with intense interest by landowners and tenants of the city. Landlords and renting agents consider it one of the most important legal battles of the year.

Mr. Andrew C. Y. Law, well-known local solicitor, declared, after the verdict had been rendered, that he would appeal the case.

Judge Yang differentiated, in the argument that followed his statement of the principal judgment, between cases where tenants were unable to make use of leased property, as in Chapei, where they had already been exempted from rental payment during the period of hostilities, and those of International Settlement lessees, who were able to continue residence and accumulation of profits.

**Not War Zone**

"According to Article 441 of the Civil Code," his judgment states, "the tenant shall be exempt from paying rent if he has been unable to use or profit from the object leased. But this is limited to circumstances where he finds himself unable to use the object leased as, for instance, when he must remove himself from a war zone. In this particular instance, the tenants did use the houses leased. Despite the fact that profits may have been reduced, as defendants assert, because of the war conditions, such rents cannot be exempted. The houses leased by the defendants are in the Central District. Both parties have agreed that the houses were in places of safety. Since there are no actual facts shown to prove that the defendants were unable to use their leased property during the war period, their refusal to pay the rent for February and March is unreasonable."

**May Get Refund**

The Court went on to throw out a motion made by the defence that, inasmuch as the question of exempting rents was now being considered by the Municipality of Greater Shanghai acting as intermediary between landlords and tenants, the question of these particular cases be held in abeyance. However, the Court stated, if the Municipality officials did decide in favour of the tenants at a later date, then the proper authorities would issue a legal order to that effect and the tenants would be able to deduct the money paid from new, accumulating rents.

He also pointed out that the tenants had been unable to show that they had an agreement, verbal or otherwise, with the lessors stating that they would be allowed to go three months into rent arrears. The defence had argued that these suits were in violation of that agreement, because amounts owed were for only two months.

Representing Algar and Company, who, in turn, are agents for the Cathay Land Company, was Mr. A. M. Preston, vice-chairman of the Shanghai Property Owners' Association.

**Thirteen Traders**

The properties involved are rented by 13 traders doing business at Chekiang and Pakhoi Roads behind Wing On and Company on Nanking Road.

Amounts of the judgments, to which will be added proportionate court costs, are as follows:
Yung Kong, Tls. 240; Ko Dah Dispensary, Tls. 315; Chen Chuen-foh, Tls. 120; Mei Dah Barber Sheng and Chang Zai-bu, Tls. 225. Dong Book Store, Tls. 435; Yao Chen-kee, Tls. 96; Soochow Hotel, Tls. 360; Wong Hsn-yuen and Kwong Kee Hospital, Tls. 285; Liang Hup-kee, Tls. 300; Hua Shon Press. Tls. 675: Woo Hung-sung, Tls. 60, and Chun Dziang, Tls. 75.

Judge Yang had had the case under advisement since June 30, when argument ceased.

JR

S. B. 登记簿
3482
717132

房东大获全胜
重要“测试案例”

浙江路地区十三名租户
奉命支付欠租，杨法官裁定
“非战区”

一起可能影响涉及金额达1,500万至2,000万美元诉讼判决的“测试”案件，昨日在第一特区地方法院审结。杨邦法官就阿尔加公司（Algar and Company）起诉13名因中日战事而拒绝支付二月和三月租金的租户一案，作出了有利于阿尔加公司的判决。

判赔总额仅为规平银3,186两，但此案引起了本市房东和租户的极大关注。房东和租赁代理人认为这是今年最重要的法律战役之一。

当地著名律师罗安德先生（Mr. Andrew C. Y. Law）在判决宣布后表示，他将对此案提出上诉。

杨法官在陈述主要判决理由后的辩论中指出，应将租户无法使用租赁物业的情况（如闸北，那里已在敌对行动期间免除租金支付）与国际租界承租人的情况区分开来，后者能够继续居住并积累利润。

**非战区**

判决书称：“根据《民法典》第441条，如果承租人无法使用或从租赁物中获利，则免付租金。但这仅限于其发现自己无法使用租赁物的情况，例如必须从战区撤离。在本案中，租户确实使用了租赁房屋。尽管被告声称由于战争状况导致利润可能减少，但此类租金不能免除。被告租赁的房屋位于中央区。双方均同意这些房屋位于安全地带。既然没有确凿事实证明被告在战争期间无法使用其租赁物业，他们拒绝支付二月和三月的租金是不合理的。”

**或可退款**

法院随后驳回了辩方提出的一项动议，该动议认为，鉴于大上海市政府正作为房东与租户之间的中介审议免租问题，这些特定案件应暂缓审理。然而，法院指出，如果市政官员日后决定支持租户，有关当局将就此发布法律命令，租户便可以从新产生的累积租金中扣除已支付的款项。

他还指出，租户未能证明他们与出租人之间存在口头或其他形式的协议，允许他们拖欠三个月租金。辩方曾辩称，这些诉讼违反了该协议，因为欠款仅涉及两个月。

代表阿尔加公司出庭的是上海业主协会副主席A. M. Preston先生，该公司又是汇业地产公司（Cathay Land Company）的代理人。

**十三家商户**

涉案物业由13家在南京路永安公司背后、浙江路和北海路经商的租户租用。

判决如下金额，并将按比例加上诉讼费：
Yung Kong，规平银240两；Ko Dah Dispensary，规平银315两；Chen Chuen-foh，规平银120两；Mei Dah Barber Sheng 和 Chang Zai-bu，规平银225两。Dong Book Store，规平银435两；Yao Chen-kee，规平银96两；Soochow Hotel，规平银360两；Wong Hsn-yuen 和 Kwong Kee Hospital，规平银285两；Liang Hup-kee，规平银300两；Hua Shon Press，规平银675两；Woo Hung-sung，规平银60两；以及 Chun Dziang，规平银75两。

自6月30日辩论结束以来，杨法官一直对该案进行审议。

JR
